npc.gnomission.greet_msg_1: Olá |PLAYERNAME|. Você provavelmente está ansioso para entrar no {warzones}.
npc.gnomission.multi_1: Você pode trocar espólios de guerra especiais para obter permissão para usar os teletransportadores de guerra para a área do chefe correspondente sem a necessidade de cristais de missão. ...
npc.gnomission.multi_2: Qual você gostaria de negociar: o {snippet} do golpe mortal, o {hat} do gnomevil ou o abissador {lash}?
npc.gnomission.multi_3: Existem três zonas de guerra. Em cada zona de guerra você encontrará inimigos temíveis. No final você encontrará seu mestre malvado. Os mestres estão bem protegidos. ...
npc.gnomission.multi_4: Certifique-se de falar com nosso agente gnômico para obter detalhes sobre sua proteção. ...
npc.gnomission.multi_5: Ah, e para poder entrar na segunda zona de guerra você tem que vencer a primeira. Para entrar no terceiro você tem que vencer o segundo. ...
npc.gnomission.multi_6: E você pode entrar em cada um deles apenas uma vez a cada vinte horas. Seus cristais de teletransporte normais não funcionarão nesses teletransportadores. Você terá que obter cristais {mission} de Gnomally.
npc.gnomission.say_1: Eu sou responsável pela nossa guerra {missions}, para {trade} com soldados experientes e uma guerra recompensadora {heroes}. Você precisa estar no rank 4 para entrar no {warzones}.
npc.gnomission.say_10: Não posso deixar você entrar no teletransportador da zona de guerra três de graça, a menos que você me dê um chapéu de Gnomevil. Mas ainda pode sempre usar um cristal de teletransporte vermelho.
npc.gnomission.say_11: Você precisa derrotar o segundo chefe da zona de guerra para ter acesso gratuito à terceira zona de guerra.
npc.gnomission.say_12: Parece que você nem sequer colocou um pé grande na zona de guerra, sinto muito.
npc.gnomission.say_13: Tudo bem, concedo-lhe permissão para entrar nas zonas de guerra. Porém, esteja avisado: isso não será um piquenique. Melhor trazer alguns amigos com você. Trazer muitos deles parece uma boa ideia.
npc.gnomission.say_15: Desculpe, você ainda não ganhou renome suficiente para arriscarmos sua vida em uma missão tão perigosa.
npc.gnomission.say_16: Somente se você tiver matado 20 dos nossos principais inimigos nas zonas de guerra, eu poderei negociar com você.
npc.gnomission.say_2: Como herói de guerra, você pode usar o teletransportador de zona de guerra gratuitamente!
npc.gnomission.say_3: Não posso deixar você entrar no teletransportador da zona de guerra de graça, a menos que você me dê um fragmento do Deathstrike. Mas ainda pode sempre usar um cristal de teletransporte vermelho.
npc.gnomission.say_5: Como herói de guerra, você pode usar o teletransportador três da zona de guerra gratuitamente!
npc.gnomission.say_6: Não posso deixar você entrar no teletransportador da zona de guerra dois de graça, a menos que você me dê um chicote de abissador. Mas ainda pode sempre usar um cristal de teletransporte vermelho.
npc.gnomission.say_7: Você precisa derrotar o primeiro chefe da zona de guerra para ter acesso gratuito à segunda zona de guerra.
npc.gnomission.say_9: Como herói de guerra, você pode usar o segundo teletransportador da zona de guerra gratuitamente!
npc.gnommander.say_1: Sou responsável pela segurança e premio os heróis da nossa causa. Se você está procurando missões, fale com Gnomilly, Gnombold e Gnomagery.
npc.gnommander.say_11: Você quer comprar o primeiro addon por 2.000 Gold?
npc.gnommander.say_12: Você ainda não tem nível suficiente.
npc.gnommander.say_13: Você não tem a roupa Cave Explorer.
npc.gnommander.say_15: Você quer comprar o segundo addon por 3.000 Gold?
npc.gnommander.say_2: Posso vender peças de roupas especiais. Se sua fama for alta o suficiente, você pode receber {worthy} essa recompensa.
npc.gnommander.say_3: Você ainda não é digno de uma recompensa especial.
npc.gnommander.say_4: Você pode adquirir o traje {basic} por 1.000 ouro, o complemento {first} por 2.000 ouro e o complemento {second} por 3.000 ouro. Qual você quer comprar?
npc.gnommander.say_5: Você ainda não tem nível suficiente.
npc.gnommander.say_7: Quer comprar a roupa básica por 1000 Gold?
npc.gnommander.say_8: Você ainda não tem nível suficiente.
npc.gnommander.say_9: Você não tem a roupa Cave Explorer.
npc.gnommander.speech_1: Sou o comandante operacional do Spike, a mais recente grande conquista da raça gnômica.
npc.gnommander.speech_2: O Spike é uma estrutura cristalina, criada pelos nossos maiores especialistas em cristal. Ele cresceu de um cristal do tamanho do meu punho até a estrutura que você vê aqui e agora.
npc.gnommander.speech_3: É claro que isso não aconteceu de um dia para o outro. É fruto do trabalho de diversas gerações gnômicas. Seu propósito mudou ao longo do tempo.
npc.gnommander.speech_4: Inicialmente, foi concebido como um nó de recursos de rápido crescimento. Em seguida, foi planejado para se tornar o protótipo de um novo tipo de base de alta segurança.
npc.gnommander.speech_5: Agora tornou-se uma base militar e uma arma. Com os nossos inimigos ocupados noutro local, podemos preparar o nosso ataque nas profundezas da terra.
npc.gnommander.speech_6: Este cristal pode suportar pressões e temperaturas extremas e está se tornando cada vez mais profundo enquanto falamos.
npc.gnommander.speech_7: Contudo, os tempos de crescimento mais rápido chegaram ao fim e temos de abrandar para não arriscar a integridade estrutural do Spike. Mas estamos a caminho e temos que fazer todo o possível para defender o Spike.
npc.gnomole.greet_msg_1: Olá! Estou pronto para informá-lo com conselhos de {tactical}.
npc.gnomole.multi_1: Como vocês são aventureiros experientes, vou pular o básico e ir direto para a parte importante! Este sistema de cavernas é invadido pelos asseclas de... ah, bem, a maior vergonha da raça dos gnomos. ...
npc.gnomole.multi_2: Aquele gnomo traidor, conhecido como Gnomevil, que foi meu aluno antes de sua mudança para o lado negro do mundo gnomo, abandonou toda a ética gnômica e uniu forças com nossos inimigos. ...
npc.gnomole.multi_3: É difícil dizer o que levou à sua queda. No final, ele parece ter esquecido o princípio de que com a pequena estatura vem uma grande responsabilidade. ...
npc.gnomole.multi_4: Ele foi contaminado e corrompido pelo mal, obviamente o suficiente para crescer em tamanho, o que é sempre um indicador do mal, é claro. ...
npc.gnomole.multi_5: Agora ele comanda seus exércitos em nome daqueles que estão abaixo e se esconde em seu covil protegido por camadas de cristal espesso que só ele pode formar e mudar devido aos seus poderes corrompidos! ...
npc.gnomole.multi_6: Porém, há uma coisa que pode causar sua queda! Sua corrupção se espalhou para seus asseclas e em seu covil há alguns chorões infectados e cheios de parasitas. ...
npc.gnomole.multi_7: Esses parasitas espalharão um fluido que enfraquecerá a integridade dos cristais na frente do covil de Gnomevil quando eles morrerem. A entrada é marcada com colunas de cristal, então você não pode perder. ...
npc.gnomole.multi_8: Você tem que matar parasitas suficientes DIRETAMENTE na frente dos cristais. Eventualmente, as colunas entrarão em colapso e permitirão que você entre no covil de Gnomevil. ...
npc.gnomole.multi_9: Porém, tome cuidado, devido ao poder de Gnomevil, os cristais crescerão novamente muito rápido. Gerencie melhor os parasitas em rápida sucessão ou tudo será em vão. ..., Entre em seu covil e acabe com seu reinado desprezível!
npc.gnomus.greet_msg_1: Saudações, membro da Brigada Pé Grande. Nós realmente precisaríamos de algum {help} seu agora. Você deveria provar {worthy} para nossa aliança.
npc.gnomus.multi_1: Muito bom. Preparamos muitos mapas, pois o mapeamento completo deste sistema provavelmente exigirá muita pesquisa. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_10: Como estamos ocupados com muitas coisas agora, poderíamos precisar de alguém para mapear as partes desconhecidas deste labirinto subterrâneo...
npc.gnomus.multi_11: Estou especialmente interessado nas estruturas escuras espalhadas por estas partes. Você faria isso?
npc.gnomus.multi_12: Excelente, basta seguir o caminho para leste até chegar a um beco sem saída, existe um buraco que dá acesso a uma pequena gruta por baixo que o levará direto ao antigo trilho. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_13: Ajude quem você puder e devolva-os para a saída da caverna salva - ah, e já que você está nisso... alguns deles terão animais de carga. Se você puder resgatá-los também, eu lhe darei um bônus. Boa sorte!
npc.gnomus.multi_14: INCRÍVEL! Você não apenas salvou todos os nossos amigos - você também resgatou os animais! Aqui está sua recompensa e bônus! ...
npc.gnomus.multi_15: Os outros já estão contando histórias sobre você. Por favor, volte para mim mais tarde se quiser ajudar mais um pouco!
npc.gnomus.multi_16: Estou constantemente esperando a chegada de material bélico. Muitos gnomos pretendem viajar até aqui para nos ajudar, mas o principal caminho de acesso à nossa base não é mais seguro. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_17: Tragicamente, perdemos vários gnomos após um surto do que só posso descrever como uma força vinda de baixo. Ficamos completamente surpresos com o ataque deles e recuamos para este posto avançado. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_18: Todos os nossos reforços chegam ao teletransportador de cristal a leste do sistema de cavernas. Precisamos de alguém para orientar os recém-chegados através dos perigos das cavernas perigosas. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_19: Criaturas horríveis e lava quente tornam a viagem extremamente perigosa. E além disso há também o perigo constante de queda de pedras na área. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_2: Pegue uma da pilha aqui ao meu lado e mapeie o máximo de estruturas possível. No entanto, precisamos de pelo menos três locais para entender esse layout antigo. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_21: Estou constantemente esperando a chegada de material bélico. Muitos gnomos pretendem viajar até aqui para nos ajudar, mas o principal caminho de acesso à nossa base não é mais seguro. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_22: Tragicamente, perdemos vários gnomos após um surto do que só posso descrever como uma força vinda de baixo. Ficamos completamente surpresos com o ataque deles e recuamos para este posto avançado. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_23: Todos os nossos reforços chegam ao teletransportador de cristal a leste do sistema de cavernas. Precisamos de alguém para orientar os recém-chegados através dos perigos das cavernas perigosas. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_24: Criaturas horríveis e lava quente tornam a viagem extremamente perigosa. E além disso há também o perigo constante de queda de pedras na área. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_26: Que sorte! Há alguns trignometros espalhados ao lado daquele dispositivo atrás de mim. Pegue um e segure-o próximo a fontes de calor de alta temperatura. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_27: Se você coletou dados suficientes, você realmente sentirá o cheiro no dispositivo. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_28: Volte para mim com os resultados depois. Boa sorte, contamos com você!
npc.gnomus.multi_29: Excelente, você voltou com mais dados! Deixe-me ver... hum. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_3: Se você conseguir mapear uma de cada estrutura em torno dessas partes - presumo que deva haver pelo menos duas vezes mais por aqui - eu lhe darei um bônus!
npc.gnomus.multi_30: Bem, precisamos de mais dados sobre isso, mas primeiro terei que mostrar isso ao nosso grande horticultor. Obrigado por conseguir isso para nós!
npc.gnomus.multi_31: O calor aqui não é o único problema que temos, mas uma das nossas maiores preocupações. Não só é quase insuportável para nós, como também parece estar a aumentar. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_32: Precisamos descobrir se isso é verdade e o que isso significa para este lugar – e para nós, gnomos. Você pode nos ajudar a fazer isso pegando um de nossos trigômetros e coletando o máximo possível de dados sobre o calor nesta área. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_33: Precisaríamos de pelo menos 5 medições. Você está disposto a fazer isso?
npc.gnomus.multi_34: O calor aqui não é o único problema que temos, mas uma das nossas maiores preocupações. Não só é quase insuportável para nós, como também parece estar a aumentar. ...

npc.gnomus.multi_4: Ao explorar essas cavernas em busca de locais para coletar esporos e cultivar cogumelos, encontramos várias estruturas estranhas. Estou convencido de que este sistema já foi o lar de seres inteligentes. ...
npc.gnomus.multi_5: No entanto, as criaturas de baixo estão agora perturbando a nossa pesquisa, bem como alguns anões particularmente irritantes que simplesmente não nos deixam em paz. ...

npc.gnomus.say_17: So you want to know what we all think about your deeds? What leader's opinion are you interested in, the {gnomes} (Gnomus), the {dwarves} (Klom Stonecutter) or the {scouts} (Lardoc Bashsmite)?
npc.gnomus.say_18: You want to offer {} suspicious device{}. Which leader shall have it, (Gnomus) of the {gnomes}, (Klom Stonecutter) of the {dwarves} or the {scouts} (Lardoc Bashsmite)?
npc.gnomus.say_19: The gnomes are still in need of your help, member of Bigfoot's Brigade. Prove your worth by answering their calls! ({}/10)
npc.gnomus.say_20: The dwarves are still in need of your help, member of Bigfoot's Brigade. Prove your worth by answering their calls! ({}/10)
npc.gnomus.say_21: The scouts are still in need of your help, member of Bigfoot's Brigade. Prove your worth by answering their calls! ({}/10)
npc.gnomus.say_3: Não preciso da sua ajuda por enquanto. Volte mais tarde.
npc.gnomus.say_5: Os outros já estão contando histórias sobre você. Por favor, volte para mim mais tarde se quiser ajudar mais um pouco!
npc.gnomus.say_6: Não preciso da sua ajuda por enquanto. Volte mais tarde.
npc.gnomus.say_8: Muito obrigado! Com essas estruturas mapeadas poderemos completar o quebra-cabeça rapidamente!
npc.gnomus.say_9: Se você me trouxer quaisquer dispositivos suspeitos sobre criaturas que você matou aqui, farei valer a pena contando aos outros sobre sua generosidade. Quantos você deseja oferecer?
npc.gnomus.stdmod_1: Se você estiver disposto a nos ajudar, podemos precisar de uma escolta para chegar {ordnance}, ajuda com {charting} o sistema de cavernas e alguém precisa se aquecer {measurements} rápido.
npc.gnomus.stdmod_3: Sou o principal contato gnômico desta base. Coordeno nossos esforços com os dos anões para garantir que tudo corra bem.
npc.gnomus.stdmod_4:
Você já é conhecido entre os gnomos, membro da Brigada Pé Grande. Garantirei que a aliança saiba de seus feitos, mas você ainda precisará ajudar os anões e gnomos deste posto avançado a mostrar seu valor. ...\z
	Também encontramos {suspicious devices} carregado por todos os tipos de criaturas aqui embaixo. Aqui embaixo, eles são de extremo valor para nós, pois podem conter a chave do que está acontecendo ao nosso redor. ...\z
	Se você puder adquirir algum, devolva-o para mim e eu contarei aos outros sobre sua generosidade. Volte para mim depois para verificar seu {status} atual.
npc.gnomus.stdmod_5:
Nossas pesquisas na área nos mostraram alguns picos de calor e atividade sísmica em locais muito específicos. ...\z
	Concluímos que isso não é coincidência e que o inimigo está usando dispositivos para bombear lava e inundar a área. Já vimos isso antes e tivemos que recuar todas as vezes. ...\z
	Desta vez, porém, podemos ter um contra-ataque preparado - para que eu consiga romper suas defesas.
npc.gnomus.stdmod_6:
Os suprimentos e a engenhosidade gnômica ajudaram a estabelecer e fortalecer este posto avançado. ...\z
	Nosso conhecimento do inimigo e suas táticas seriam mais úteis se os anões nos ouvissem um pouco mais. Mas os gnomos aprenderam a conviver com a imperfeição das outras raças.
npc.gnomux.say_1: Sou responsável por reabastecer aventureiros tolos com equipamentos que eles possam ter perdido. Se você é um deles, pergunte-me sobre um {trade}.
npc.gnomux.say_2: O que eu poderia dizer sobre os gnomos que ninguém saberia? Quero dizer, afinal somos interessantes, se não fascinantes.
npc.gnomux.say_3: Eu vim aqui como fazendeiro de cristal e conheço o Spike desde quando ele era um pequeno bebê de cristal. Admito que sinto um pouco de orgulho paternal pelo quão grande e saudável ela se tornou.
npc.gnomux.say_4: I'm responsible for resupplying foolish adventurers with equipment that they may have lost. If you're one of them, just ask me about a {trade}.
npc.gnomux.say_5: What could I say about gnomes that anyone would not know? I mean, we're interesting if not fascinating, after all.
npc.gnomux.say_6: I came here as a crystal farmer and know the Spike all the way back to when it was a little baby crystal. I admit I feel a little fatherly pride in how big and healthy it has become.
npc.gnomux.say_7: When most other crystal experts left for new assignments, I decided to stay and help here a bit.
npc.gorn.greet_msg_1: Ah, por favor entre, |PLAYERNAME|. O que você precisa?
npc.gorn.say_1: Você quer comprar uma bola de futebol por 111 ouro?
npc.gorn.sendtrade_msg_1: Claro, basta navegar pelos meus produtos. {Footballs} deve ser adquirido separadamente.
npc.gorn.stdmod_1: Venda de bens em geral e papelaria!
npc.gorn.stdmod_10: Ela é a líder da guilda dos paladinos.
npc.gorn.stdmod_11: O velho Baxter já foi um desordeiro. Na nossa juventude compartilhamos algumas aventuras e mulheres.
npc.gorn.stdmod_12: Bah! Vá embora com esse bozoguy.
npc.gorn.stdmod_14: Tivemos um ou dois confrontos antigamente.
npc.gorn.stdmod_15: Mesmo os cavaleiros fortes precisam do meu equipamento em suas viagens Tibia.
npc.gorn.stdmod_18: Você pode encontrá-lo na guilda dos feiticeiros.
npc.gorn.stdmod_19: Esse Oswald não tem o suficiente para trabalhar e muito tempo para espalhar boatos.
npc.gorn.stdmod_2: Vendo equipamentos de todos os tipos. Você precisa de alguma coisa?
npc.gorn.stdmod_20: Ele aconselha os recém-chegados a comprar na minha loja. Eu amo aquele cara!
npc.gorn.stdmod_21: Forte como um boi, poderia lutar com um minotauro, aposto.
npc.gorn.stdmod_3: O rei apoia muito a economia de Tibia.
npc.gorn.stdmod_4: Magia? Pergunte a um feiticeiro ou druida sobre isso.
npc.gorn.stdmod_5: Eu sou Gorn. Meus produtos são conhecidos em todo Tibia.
npc.gorn.stdmod_6: É exatamente |TIME|. Talvez você queira comprar um relógio?
npc.gorn.stdmod_7: Esses druidas são pessoas legais, você os encontrará no leste da cidade.
npc.gorn.stdmod_8: Mesmo os cavaleiros fortes precisam do meu equipamento em suas viagens Tibia.
npc.gorn.stdmod_9: Você pode encontrá-lo na guilda dos feiticeiros.
npc.gorn.voice_1: Venda de bens em geral e papelaria!
npc.graubart.farewell_msg_1: Adeus e não se esqueça de mim!
npc.graubart.greet_msg_1: Olá, jovem |PLAYERNAME|. Procurando trabalho no meu navio?
npc.graubart.stdmod_1: Meu nome é Graubart, capitão do grande SeaHawk!
npc.graubart.stdmod_10: Bruno é um dos melhores velejadores que conheço. Ele é quase tão bom quanto eu. *ri alto*
npc.graubart.stdmod_2: Ah, todo meu orgulho: meu navio chamado SeaHawk. Passamos tantas noites de tempestade juntos. Acho que não conseguiria viver sem isso.
npc.graubart.stdmod_3: Ah, todo meu orgulho: meu navio chamado SeaHawk. Passamos tantas noites de tempestade juntos. Acho que não conseguiria viver sem isso.
npc.graubart.stdmod_4: Eu sou um comerciante. Navego por todo o mundo com meu navio e negocio com muitas raças diferentes!
npc.graubart.stdmod_5: Um comerciante é alguém que comercializa mercadorias com outras pessoas e tenta obter algum lucro. *risos*
npc.graubart.stdmod_6: Eu troco quase tudo, por exemplo, armas, comida, água e até runas mágicas.
npc.graubart.stdmod_7: Você sabe; elfos, anões, homens-lagarto, minotauros e muitos outros.
npc.graubart.stdmod_9: Pssst. Marlene não está por perto agora...? Você sabe... ela é uma mulher adorável, mas fala demais! Então eu sempre procuro manter distância dela porque ela não para de falar.
npc.gregor.say_1: Desculpe, mas não tenho nada para você no momento.
npc.gregor.say_10: Você realmente conseguiu cumprir a tarefa e me trouxe 100 presas gigantescas perfeitas?
npc.gregor.say_11: Você não está falando sério perguntando isso, está? Eles vêm de gigantes, é claro. A menos que haja coelhos gigantes. Dã.
npc.gregor.say_12: Você recuperou o capacete de Ramsay, o Imprudente?
npc.gregor.say_13: Esses macacos irritantes roubam tudo em que conseguem colocar as mãos sujas.
npc.gregor.say_14: Você conseguiu um frasco com puro suor de guerreiro?
npc.gregor.say_15: O suor do guerreiro pode ser extraído magicamente do capacete usado por um verdadeiro guerreiro, mas apenas em pequenas quantidades. Dizem que os Djinns são bons em extrações mágicas.
npc.gregor.say_16: Ah, você trouxe o aço real?
npc.gregor.say_17: O aço real só pode ser refinado por ferreiros muito habilidosos.
npc.gregor.say_18: Bah. Então você terá que esperar o dia em que esses capacetes serão vendidos nas lojas, mas isso não acontecerá antes que o inferno congele.
npc.gregor.say_19: Tudo bem então. Volte para mim depois de coletar 100 presas de gigante perfeitas.
npc.gregor.say_2: Desculpe, mas nossas tarefas são apenas para guerreiros premium.
npc.gregor.say_20: Você gostaria que eu repetisse os requisitos da tarefa então?
npc.gregor.say_21: Mentir não é exatamente honroso, |PLAYERNAME|. Você devia se envergonhar.
npc.gregor.say_22: Estou profundamente impressionado, corajoso Knight |PLAYERNAME|. Eu não esperava nada menos de você. Agora, por favor, recupere o capacete de Ramsay.
npc.gregor.say_23: Não há necessidade de pressa de qualquer maneira.
npc.gregor.say_24: Mentir não é exatamente honroso, |PLAYERNAME|. Você devia se envergonhar.
npc.gregor.say_25: Bom trabalho, corajoso Knight |PLAYERNAME|! Mesmo danificado, tem muito valor sentimental. Agora, por favor, traga-me suor de guerreiro.
npc.gregor.say_26: Não há necessidade de pressa de qualquer maneira.
npc.gregor.say_27: Mentir não é exatamente honroso, |PLAYERNAME|. Você devia se envergonhar.
npc.gregor.say_28: Isso é uma surpresa agradável, corajoso Knight |PLAYERNAME|! Resta apenas uma tarefa agora: obter aço real para refinar seu capacete.
npc.gregor.say_29: Não há necessidade de pressa de qualquer maneira.
npc.gregor.say_3: Quer dizer que você gostaria de provar que merece usar esse capacete?
npc.gregor.say_30: Mentir não é exatamente honroso, |PLAYERNAME|. Você devia se envergonhar.
npc.gregor.say_31: Você realmente merece usar um capacete adornado, corajoso Knight |PLAYERNAME|. Por favor, fale com Sam e diga a ele que enviei você. Tenho certeza que ele ficará feliz em refinar seu capacete.
npc.gregor.say_32: Não há necessidade de pressa de qualquer maneira.
npc.gregor.say_33: Well then, listen closely. First, you will have to prove that you are a fierce and restless warrior by bringing me 100 perfect behemoth fangs. ...
npc.gregor.say_34: Secondly, please retrieve a helmet for us which has been lost a long time ago. The famous Ramsay the Reckless wore it when exploring an ape settlement. ...
npc.gregor.say_35: Third, we need a new flask of warrior's sweat. We've run out of it recently, but we need a small amount for the show battles in our arena. ...
npc.gregor.say_36: Lastly, I will have our smith refine your helmet if you bring me royal steel, an especially noble metal. ...
npc.gregor.say_37: Did you understand everything I told you and are willing to handle this task?
npc.gregor.say_4: Sua tarefa atual é me trazer 100 presas gigantes perfeitas, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.gregor.say_5: Sua tarefa atual é recuperar o capacete de Ramsay, o Imprudente de Banuta, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.gregor.say_6: Sua tarefa atual é obter um frasco de suor de guerreiro, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.gregor.say_7: Sua tarefa atual é me trazer aço real, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.gregor.say_8: Por favor, fale com Sam e diga a ele que enviei você. Tenho certeza que ele ficará feliz em refinar seu capacete, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.gregor.say_9: Você já completou a tarefa e pode se considerar um poderoso guerreiro, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.gregor.stdmod_1: Reúnam-se ao meu redor, jovens cavaleiros! Vou te ensinar alguns feitiços!
npc.gregor.stdmod_10: Linda Tibia. E com a nossa ajuda todos estão salvos.
npc.gregor.stdmod_11: É hora de se juntar aos Cavaleiros!
npc.gregor.stdmod_12: Cavaleiros são os guerreiros de Tibia. Sem nós, ninguém estaria seguro. Todo homem ou mulher corajoso e forte pode se juntar a nós.
npc.gregor.stdmod_13: Algum dia alguém fará algo acontecer com ele...
npc.gregor.stdmod_14: Um arco pode ser uma ótima arma para alguém que não é forte o suficiente para empunhar uma arma REAL.
npc.gregor.stdmod_15: Eu e meus alunos frequentemente dividimos um barril de cerveja ou vinho na cabana de Frodo.
npc.gregor.stdmod_16: Sempre preocupado com seu lucro. Que perda! Ele estava se aventurando com Baxter nos velhos tempos.
npc.gregor.stdmod_18: Antes de se tornar padre, ela ganhou o concurso Miss Tibia três vezes seguidas.
npc.gregor.stdmod_2: Nesta categoria tenho '{Wound Cleansing}' e '{Cure Poison}'.
npc.gregor.stdmod_20: Um belo jogo para caçar. Mas tenha cuidado, ele trapaceia!
npc.gregor.stdmod_21: Bah, vá embora com esses truques de feiticeiro. Só os covardes usam truques.
npc.gregor.stdmod_23: Nunca entenderei esses monges e padres pacíficos.
npc.gregor.stdmod_24: Ele tem músculos, mas não tem coragem.
npc.gregor.stdmod_3: Nesta categoria tenho '{Light}', '{Find Person}' e '{Great Light}'.
npc.gregor.stdmod_4: Eu posso te ensinar {healing spells} e {support spells}. Que tipo de feitiço você deseja aprender? Você também pode me dizer para qual nível gostaria de aprender um feitiço, se preferir.
npc.gregor.stdmod_5: Eu sou o primeiro cavaleiro. Eu treinei alguns dos maiores heróis de Tibia.
npc.gregor.stdmod_6: Claro, você já ouviu falar deles. Os cavaleiros são os melhores lutadores em Tibia.
npc.gregor.stdmod_8: Você está brincando, hein? Claro, você me conhece. Eu sou Gregor, o primeiro cavaleiro.
npc.gregor.voice_1: Reúnam-se ao meu redor, jovens cavaleiros! Vou te ensinar alguns feitiços!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_10a: Superb work. However, there is something else I want you to do. It is said that there is a quara general named 'Thul' who is responsible for the attacks on Liberty Bay. Find and kill the general and bring peace back to Liberty Bay! ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_10b: If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}. Be aware that you can only have one 'Thul' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_11: Well THAT was a hunt. Good job. Have you heard about the 'Old Widow'? It must have a hideout. Try to find it and slay the beast. You can ask about new {tasks} by the way. Be aware that you can only have one 'Old Widow' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_12a: What an impressive hunt. Nicely done. By the way there is still something I want you to do for me. 'Hemming' a furious werewolf is up to mischief. Find its hideout and bring it down! ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_12b: If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}. Be aware that you can only have one 'Hemming' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_13a: Thumbs up, nice performance. Have you heard about 'Tormentor'? Find it and slay the beast. ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_13b: If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}. Be aware that you can only have one 'Tormentor' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_14: Well THAT was a hunt. Good job. Have you heard about 'Flameborn'? It must have a hideout. Try to find it and slay the beast. You can ask about new {tasks} by the way. Be aware that you can only have one 'Flameborn' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_15a: What an impressive hunt. Nicely done. Have you heard about 'Fazzrah'? Try to find it and slay the beast. ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_15b: You can ask about new {tasks} by the way. Be aware that you can only have one 'Fazzrah' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_16a: Nicely done. However, there is something else I want you to do. I have heard that there is a stampor the hunters in the Muggy Plains call 'Tromphonyte'. It is an extremely dangerous example of its kind! ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_16b: I believe you are equal to the task, |PLAYERNAME|! Find and kill it and bring peace back! ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_16c: If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}. Be aware that you can only have one 'Tromphonyte' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_17: If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}. Be aware that you can only have one 'Sulphur Scuttler' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_18: If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}. Be aware that you can only have one 'Bruise Payne' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_19: If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}. Be aware that you can only have one 'Many' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_1a: Spiffing work, old chap. Now I have a special task for you. Recently several citizens of Port Hope vanished. It is rumoured that they were killed by a crocodile. The people call it 'Snapper'. Hunt down and kill that evil man-eating beast. ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_1b: Ask me about new {tasks} if you're up for a further hunting mission. Be aware that you can only have one 'Snapper' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_2: Nicely done! Now I shall assign you a special task. Rumour has it that there is an ancient and evil tarantula who preys on humans. She is called 'Hide'. Track her down and kill her! Good luck, old chap.
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_20a: My - you can be proud of yourself! However, you're not finished yet. There are rumours about a being called 'The Noxious Spawn' which was seen deep down in the ruins of Banuta. Try to find its hideout. ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_20b: You can ask about new {tasks} bye the way. Be aware that you can only have one 'Noxious Spawn' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_21: If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}. Be aware that you can only have one 'Gorgo' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_22a: Such marvellous hunting skills! Perhaps you can help me with this one. Have you heard about 'Stonecracker'? ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_22b: It's the oldest and most dangerous of all behemoths and was last seen under the Cyclopolis in Edron. What do you think? Are you hunter enough? I think you are!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_23a: Good job, old chap! Are you up for a challenge? Have you heard of the legendary sea serpent called the 'Leviathan'? It must be somewhere near the spot you found. ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_23b: This is a true test of your hunting skills - find it and kill it. Good hunting! ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_23c: You can ask about new {tasks} by the way. Be aware that you can only have one 'Leviathan' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_24a: Outstanding! You do have impressive hunting skills. Have you already heard about Kerberos the oldest and most dangerous of all hellhounds? He must have a hideout somewhere. Try to find him and slay the beast. ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_24b: You can ask about new tasks by the way. Be aware that you can only have one Kerberos task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_25: If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}. Be aware that you can only have one 'Ethershreck' task active at the same time!

npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_28: If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}. Be aware that you can only have one 'Zanakeph' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_3a: Well done, old chap. Now i shall assign you a special task. Rumour has it that there is an old carniphila somewhere in the jungle. Find Deathbine's hideout and kill it! Good luck, old chap ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_3b: Ask me about new {tasks} if you're up for further hunting mission. Be aware that you can only have one 'Deathbine' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_4: Jolly good job you did there, but now I have a special task for you. The citizens of Svargrond live in fear because of a frightfully bad-tempered mammoth they call 'Blood Tusk'. Go there and put an end to him. Happy hunting!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_5a: As I see it, you need more of a challenge! I have heard that there is an ice golem the hunters in Svargrond call 'Shardhead'. It is an extremely dangerous example of its kind! ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_5b: I believe you are equal to the task, |PLAYERNAME|! If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}. Be aware that you can only have one 'Shardhead' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_6a: Very good work, old chap. Lucky you are here - I have just been told of a task which is perfect for you. ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_6b: The Yalaharians are having a spot of bother with a huge mutated rat. They call it 'Esmeralda' and you should find her somewhere in the sewers. Good hunting!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_7a: Very good work, old chap. Lucky you are here - I have just been told of a task which is perfect for you. ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_7b: The people of Ankrahmun are having a spot of bother with a huge ancient scarab. They call it 'Fleshcrawler' and you should find and kill it. Good hunting! ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_7c: If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}. Be aware that you can only have one 'Fleshcrawler' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_8a: Very good work, old chap. Have you heard about 'Ribstride'? It must have a hideout. Try to find it and slay the beast. ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_8b: If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}. Be aware that you can only have one 'Ribstride' task active at the same time!

npc.grizzly_adams.boss_start_deathbine: Find Deathbine, the old carniphila, somewhere in the jungle. Find its hideout and kill it!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_start_default: Okay. Go forth and kill him.
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_start_many: Keep your head and focus when you confront her!
npc.grizzly_adams.carniphilas_1: Interesting kind and not so easy to find. The fun begins when you want to hunt {Tiquanda's Revenge}. It's strong and smart like no other carniphila.
npc.grizzly_adams.carniphilas_2: Damn walking weed-thingies! You'll find them deeper in the jungle. Weed out 150 carniphilas for our society. Alright?

npc.grizzly_adams.say_72: From now on I'll buy more trophies from you!
npc.grizzly_adams.say_73: Spiffing! You gained 70 hunting points! From now on you can call yourself a 'Trophy hunter'. As a reward I have this special backpack for you and in addition, you can sell some more rare trophies to me. ...
npc.grizzly_adams.say_74: Ask me for {special} tasks from time to time.
npc.grizzly_adams.say_75: Congratulations, |PLAYERNAME|! You have gained the highest rank: 'Elite hunter'. If you haven't done yet, ask me for the {special} task.
npc.grizzly_adams.say_76: You have not enough points for promotion.
npc.grizzly_adams.say_77: You can choose between the {Snapper}, {Hide}, {Deathbine} and the {Bloodtusk}.
npc.grizzly_adams.say_78: You can choose between the {Snapper}, {Hide}, {Deathbine}, the {Bloodtusk}, {Shardhead}, {Fleshcrawler}, {Ribstride}, {Bloodweb} and {Esmeralda}

npc.grizzly_adams.say_97: Have you heard about {Tiquanda's Revenge}? It is said that the jungle itself is alive and takes revenge for all the bad things people have done to it. ...
npc.grizzly_adams.say_98: I myself believe that there is some truth in this clap-trap. Something 'real' which must have a hideout somewhere. Go find it and take revenge yourself! Ask me about the {special} task when you're done.
npc.grizzly_adams.say_99: You have already started the task. Go find Tiquandas Revenge and take revenge yourself!
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_ancient_sca: They can be found in tombs beneath the desert around Ankrahmun. Hunt 250 ancient scarabs of them. Interested?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_apes: You'll find the apes deeper in the jungle. Hunt 300 merlkins, kongras or sibangs to complete this task. Alright?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_badgers: You'll find them in the surrounding of Svargrond. Hunt 300 badgers and you'll get a reward. Interested?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_behemoths: Behemoths must be kept away from the settlements at all costs. You'll find them east of here in the taboo-area or under Cyclopolis in Edron. Go there and hunt a few of them - shall we say... 700? Are you up for that?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_bonebeasts: In this task you must defeat 300 bonebeasts. Are you sure that you want to start this task?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_brimstone_b: You can find them on the Zaoan landmass. Kill 500 brimstone bugs to complete this task. Are you in?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_crocodiles: They are a nuisance! You'll find them here in the jungle near the river. Hunt 300 crocodiles and you'll get a nice reward. Interested?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_crystal_spi: In this task you must defeat 300 crystal spiders. Are you sure that you want to start this task?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_destroyers: You can find those dark creatures on several places all over Tibia. For this task I want you to kill 650 destroyers. Are you in?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_drakens: Go to the Zaoan landmass and reduce their number! Kill 900 drakens, I'll accept: draken abomination, draken elite, draken spellweaver and draken warmaster. Are you in?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_gargoyles: They can be found all over Tibia. Hunt 300 gargoyles of them. Interested?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_ghastly_dra: Ghastly dragons are devastating creatures which can be found in many dangerous places all over Tibia. Kill 500 of them. Are you in?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_giant_spide: Never liked spiders. Simply too many legs. And I always find them in my bath! Those nasty creepy-crawlies are a threat to the hygiene of every living being in Tibia. Hunt 500 of them. Okay?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_gnarlhounds: This particular species is found in Zao Steppe. Hunt 300 gnarlhounds of them. Understood?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_hellhounds: These harbingers of darkness can be found in many deep dungeons all over Tibia. Kill 250 of them. Are you in?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_hellspawns: Recently, I heard of a disturbing development - hellspawns. If they spread to the rest of Tibia... <shudders> My task for you is to contain their numbers. Hunt 600 of them. What do you say?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_high_class_: I want you to decrease the number of high class lizards on the Zaoan landmass. Hunt 800 of them. I accept lizard chosens, lizard dragon priests, lizard high guards, lizard legionnaires and lizard zaoguns. Are you interested?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_hydras: The hydras are located in the eastern jungle of Tiquanda and there are several mountain caves that are inhabited by them. Your task is to hunt a mere 650 hydras. Are you willing to do that?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_ice_golems: The ice golems on the glacier of Hrodmir are becoming a threat to the civilians in Svargrond. Travel to the Ice Islands and hunt 300 ice golems. Do you accept this task?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_killer_caim: Killer caiman populations can be found on the landmass of Zao. Hunt down 250 of them for this task. Interested?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_lancer_beet: Lancer beetle populations can be found on the landmass of Zao. Hunt down 300 of this crawlers for this task. Alright?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_mammoths: This particular species is found in Svargrond. Impressive beasts, but you wouldn't want one in your backyard. Hunt 300 mammoths of them. Alright?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_medusae: They live deep in the old ruins of Banuta and they are nasty! I think a mere 500 medusae should do the trick. What do you say?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_mutated_bat: Recently, I heard of a disturbing development in Yalahar - a plague of monstrous mutated bats! If they were to spread to the rest of Tibia... <shudders> My task for you is to contain their numbers in Yalahar. Hunt 400 of them. What do you say?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_mutated_rat: Recently, I heard of a disturbing development in Yalahar - a plague of monstrous Mutated rats! If they were to spread to the rest of Tibia.. <shudders> My task for you is to contain their numbers in Yalahar. Hunt 400 mutated rats of them. What do you say?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_mutated_tig: In this task you must defeat 300 mutated tigers. Are you sure that you want to start this task?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_nightmares: Nightmares and nightmare scions can be found all over Tibia. For this task kill 400 of them. Interested?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_quara_scout: The {scouts} can be found on Malada, one of the Shattered Isles. Your task is to kill 400 quara scouts. I accept quara constrictor scouts, quara hydromancer scouts, quara mantassin scouts, quara pincher scouts and quara predator scouts, are you in?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_sea_serpent: The sea serpent threat increases! Captain Haba knows where to find them. ...
Go to Svargrond and talk to him. 900 sea serpents, including the young ones, should be enough to reduce the threat. Got it?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_serpent_spa: Very dangerous, nasty and slimy creatures. They live deep in the old ruins of Banuta. I think a mere 800 serpent spawns should do the trick. What do you say?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_stampors: Stampors can be found in a dungeon on the Zaoan landmass. Hunt 600 of them. Are you interested?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_stone_golem: They can be found all over Tibia. You'll find them in mountain caves or rocky dungeons. Hunt 200 stone golems of them and come back to me. Understood?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_tarantulas: There is a veritable plague of tarantulas living in the caves north of the river to the east. Can you squish 300 tarantulas for the Hunting Elite. What do you say?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_terramites: This particular species can be found beneath Zao Steppe. Hunt 300 terramites of them. Understood?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_thornback_t: You'll find them on the Laguna Islands. Hunt 300 thornback tortoises of them. Interested?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_undead_drag: You are a thrill seeker? Undead dragons belong to one of the most powerful races that can be found in Tibia. Kill 400 of them. Are you in?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_underwater_: As you wish. Seek out a quara settlement and hunt 600 underwater quara, it doesn't matter which type you hunt. Alright?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_wailing_wid: Wailing widow populations can be found on the landmass of Zao. Hunt down 400 of them. Alright?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_werewolves: Those nasty creatures can be found on the island of Vengoth. Hunt 300 of them. Are you in?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_wyverns: They can be found all over Tibia. Hunt 300 wyverns. Interested?
npc.grizzly_adams.task_complete_1: Nice work, old chap. If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}.
npc.grizzly_adams.task_complete_2: Jolly good job you did there, old chap. If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}.
npc.grizzly_adams.task_complete_3: Well done! If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}.
npc.grizzly_adams.task_complete_4: That took some time, huh? Good hunting though. If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}.

npc.grof_the_guard.say_1: I think it'll rain soon and I left some laundry out for drying.
npc.grof_the_guard.say_2: Yes I'm pretty sure they have failed to send the laundry police to take care of it, you fool.
npc.grof_the_guard.stdmod_1: It's my duty to protect the city.
npc.grombur.greet_msg_1: STOP RIGHT THERE!..... Oh, just a human. What's up big guy?
npc.grombur.say_1: Oh well, I liked Nokmir. He used to be a good dwarf until that day on which he stole the ring from {Rerun}.
npc.grombur.say_2: Yeah, he's the lucky guy in this whole story. I heard rumours that emperor Rehal had plans to promote Nokmir, but after this whole thievery story, he might pick Rerun instead.
npc.grombur.say_3: Got any dwarven brown ale?? I DON'T THINK SO....and Bolfana, the tavern keeper, won't sell you anything. I'm sure about that...she doesn't like humans... I tell you what, if you get me a cask of dwarven brown ale, I allow you to enter the mine. Alright?
npc.grombur.say_4: HOW?....WHERE?....AHHHH, I don't mind....SLUUUUUURP....tastes a little flat but I had worse. Thank you. Just don't tell anyone that I let you in.
npc.grombur.say_5: Haha, fine! Don't waste time and get me the ale. See you.
npc.guard_saros.farewell_msg_1: Good bye, |PLAYERNAME|. I really hope we'll talk again soon.
npc.guard_saros.greet_msg_1: Suon's and Bastesh's blessings! Welcome to {Issavi}, traveller.
npc.guard_saros.greet_msg_2: Suon's and Bastesh's blessings! Welcome to {Issavi}, traveller.
npc.guard_saros.say_1: I would never have guessed that.
npc.guard_saros.say_11: I am a little sad, that you seem to have forgotten me, handsome. I am Aruda.
npc.guard_saros.say_13: Oh, I like it, how you say my name.
npc.guard_saros.say_14: Please don't be so rude to look for the time if you are talking to me.
npc.guard_saros.say_15: I am deeply sorry, I can't help you.
npc.guard_saros.say_16: UH! What a terrifying topic. Please let us speak about something more pleasant, I am a weak and small woman after all.
npc.guard_saros.say_17: What gives you the impression, I am the kind of women, you find in sewers?
npc.guard_saros.say_18: You should ask about that in one of the temples.
npc.guard_saros.say_19: The king, that lives in this fascinating castle? I think he does look kind of cute in his luxurious robes, doesn't he?
npc.guard_saros.say_2: Oh, sorry, I was distracted, what did you say?
npc.guard_saros.say_20: He is soooo strong! What muscles! What a body! Did you ask him for a date?
npc.guard_saros.say_21: He is soooo strong! What muscles! What a body! On the other hand, compared to you he looks quite puny.
npc.guard_saros.say_22: He is a little simple minded but always nice and well dressed.
npc.guard_saros.say_23: He should really sell some stylish gowns or something like that. We Tibians never get some clothing of the latest fashion. It's a shame.
npc.guard_saros.say_24: I don't understand this lonely monks. I love company too much to become one. Hehehe!
npc.guard_saros.say_25: Oh, isn't he funny? I could listen to him the whole day.
npc.guard_saros.say_26: As far as I know, he is working in the castle.
npc.guard_saros.say_27: I am a little shy and so don't hear many rumors.
npc.guard_saros.say_28: Oh, you little devil, stop talking like that! <blush>
npc.guard_saros.say_29: I know only little about weapons. Can you tell me something about them, please?
npc.guard_saros.say_3: Oh, I just remember I have some work to do, sorry. Bye!
npc.guard_saros.say_30: I believe that love is stronger than magic, don't you agree?
npc.guard_saros.say_31: Oh, sorry, I have to hurry, bye!
npc.guard_saros.say_32: I would like to visit the beach more often, but I guess it's too dangerous.
npc.guard_saros.say_33: I love this castle! It's so beautiful.
npc.guard_saros.say_34: Powerful sorcerers frighten me a little.
npc.guard_saros.say_35: I personally think it's inappropriate for a woman to become a warrior, what do you think about that?
npc.guard_saros.say_36: Druids seldom visit a town, what do you know about druids?
npc.guard_saros.say_37: I like brave fighters like him.
npc.guard_saros.say_39: I like dogs, the little ones at least. Do you like dogs, too?
npc.guard_saros.say_4: Take some time to talk to me!
npc.guard_saros.say_40: Oh, I am just a girl and know nothing about magic swords and such things.
npc.guard_saros.say_41: I ... don't know someone named like that.
npc.guard_saros.say_42: Yenny? I know no Yenny, nor have I ever used that name! You have mistook me with someone else.
npc.guard_saros.say_5: Well ... I have met him for a little while .. but this was nothing serious.
npc.guard_saros.say_6: I remember that grapes were his favourites. He was almost addicted to them.
npc.guard_saros.say_7: Thank you very much. How kind of you to care about me. I am fine, thank you.
npc.guard_saros.say_8: This is the continent you are currently visiting. You will find vast, dry steppes here as well as high mountains, the river Nykri and the big city {Issavi}.
npc.guard_saros.say_9: Issavi is the capital of {Kilmaresh}, also called the Golden City. This city has a motto: An open gate for those of peace. This means, anyone is welcome here as long as they respect our laws, be it humans, elves, minotaurs or even a medusa.
npc.guard_saros.voice_1: Praised be Suon, the Benevolent King!
npc.guard_saros.walkaway_msg_1: I hope to see you soon.

npc.guide_edna.greet_msg_1: Meow, welcome to Yalahar |PLAYERNAME|! Even though I might not look like it, I can give you {information} and a {map} guide. Need some?

npc.guide_edna.stdmod_2: Currently, I can tell you all about the town, its temple, the bank, shops, spell trainers and the depot, as well as about the world status.
npc.guide_edna.stdmod_3: The temple is just south west of here. Actually, it's a temple raft and the priestess is somewhat... meow... you'll see what I mean.
npc.guide_edna.stdmod_4: Our bank clerk Znozel is somewhat... special. You can find him north of this harbour and then to the right, past the tavern.

npc.guide_edna.stdmod_6: The depot is a place where you can safely store your belongings. You are also protected against attacks there. I escort newcomers there, but it's just north of here.
npc.guide_edna.stdmod_7: I'm the only feline guide in Tibia. I might not have fingers anymore, but with my paw I can still mark important locations on your map and give you some information about the town and the world status.
npc.guide_edna.stdmod_8: Yalahar is a very old city of gigantic size, consisting of a city centre and eight quarters. The beings that are closest to be called rulers of the city are the Yalahari.
npc.guide_edna.voice_1: Want to know the status of all the world changes? Ask me.

npc.gurbasch.farewell_msg_1: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! Lovely steamboat, ain't it? I can even offer you a {passage} if you like.
npc.gurbasch.greet_msg_1: Where do you want me to take you? To {Kazordoon}, {Farmine} or {Gnomprona}?
npc.gurbasch.stdmod_1: Passages to Kazordoon! Gotta try the beer there.
npc.gurbasch.stdmod_10: Would you like to travel to Gnomprona for |TRAVELCOST|?
npc.gurbasch.stdmod_3:
Well, you might be just the hero they need there. To tell you the truth, some our most reliable ore mines have started to run low. ... \z
	This is why we developed new steamship technologies to be able to further explore and cartograph the great subterraneous rivers. Our brothers have established a base on a continent far, far away. ... \z
	We call that the far, far away base. But since it will hopefully become a flourishing mine one day, most of us started to call it {Farmine}. The dwarfs there could really use some help right now.
npc.gurbasch.stdmod_4: Do you seek a ride to Farmine for |TRAVELCOST|?
npc.gurbasch.stdmod_7: Do you want to go to Kazordoon to try the beer there? |TRAVELCOST|?
npc.gurbasch.voice_1: Passages to Kazordoon! Gotta try the beer there.
npc.habdel.greet_msg_1: Welcome |PLAYERNAME|! See the fine {weapons} I sell.
npc.habdel.multi_1: Listen, um... I know that Ishina has been wanting a comb for a long time... not just any comb, but a mermaid's comb. She said it prevents split ends... or something. ...
npc.habdel.multi_2: Do you think you could get one for me so I can give it to her? I really would appreciate it.
npc.habdel.say_1: My scimitar? Yes, that is a true masterpiece. Of course I could make one for you, but I have a small request. Would you fulfil a task for me?
npc.habdel.say_2: Have you brought a mermaid's comb for Ishina?
npc.habdel.say_3: Brilliant! I will wait for you to return with a mermaid's comb then.
npc.habdel.say_5: Yeah! That's it! I can't wait to give it to her! Oh - but first, I'll fulfil my promise: Here is your scimitar! Thanks again!
npc.habdel.stdmod_1: I sell the finest weapons in town. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.hairycles.greet_msg_1: Oh! Hello! Hello! Did not notice!
npc.hairycles.greet_msg_2: Be greeted, friend of the ape people. If you want to {trade}, just ask for my offers. If you are injured, ask for healing.
npc.hairycles.multi_1: So listen, please. Plague was not ordinary plague. That's why Hairycles could not heal at first. It is new curse of evil lizard people ...
npc.hairycles.multi_10: Me sure to make cure so strong to drive away all plague. But to create great cure me need powerful components ...
npc.hairycles.multi_11: Me need whisper moss. Whisper moss growing south of human settlement is. Problem is, evil little dworcs harvest all whisper moss immediately ...
npc.hairycles.multi_12: Me know they hoard some in their underground lair. My people raided dworcs often before humans came. So we know the moss is hidden in east of upper level of dworc lair ...
npc.hairycles.multi_13: You go there and take good moss from evil dworcs. Talk with me about mission when having moss.
npc.hairycles.multi_14: Finally my people are safe! You have done incredible good for ape people and one day even me brethren will recognise that. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_15: I wish I could speak for all when me call you true friend but my people need time to get accustomed to change. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_16: Let us hope one day whole Banuta will greet you as a friend. Perhaps you want to check me offers for special friends... or shamanic powers.
npc.hairycles.multi_17: You have proven yourself a friend, me will grant you permission to enter the deepest catacombs under Banuta which we have sealed in the past. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_18: Me still can sense the evil presence there. We did not dare to go deeper and fight creatures of evil there. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_19: You may go there, fight the evil and find the monument of the serpent god and destroy it with hammer me give to you. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_2: I think curse on little one was only a try. We have to be prepared for big strike ...
npc.hairycles.multi_20: Only then my people will be safe. Please tell Hairycles, will you go there?
npc.hairycles.multi_21: Now that the false cult was stopped, we need to strengthen the spirit of my people. We need a symbol of our faith that ape people can see and touch. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_22: Since you have proven a friend of the ape people I will grant you permission to enter the forbidden land. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_23: To enter the forbidden land in the north-east of the jungle, look for a cave in the mountains east of it. There you will find the blind prophet. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_24: Tell him Hairycles you sent and he will grant you entrance. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_25: Forbidden land is home of Bong. Holy giant ape big as mountain. Don't annoy him in any way but look for a hair of holy ape. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_26: You might find at places he has been, should be easy to see them since Bong is big. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_27: Return a hair of the holy ape to me. Will you do this for Hairycles?
npc.hairycles.multi_28: Mighty life charm is protecting us now! But my people are still in danger. Danger from within. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_29: Some of my people try to mimic lizards to become strong. Like lizards did before, this cult drinks strange fluid that lizards left when fled. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_3: Me need papers of lizard magician! For sure you find it in his hut in their dwelling. It's south east of jungle. Go look there please! Are you willing to go?
npc.hairycles.multi_30: Under the city still the underground temple of lizards is. There you find casks with red fluid. Take crowbar and destroy three of them to stop this madness. Are you willing to do that?
npc.hairycles.multi_31: Last ingredient for charm of life is thing to lure magic. Only thing me know like that is mushroom called witches' cap. Me was told it be found in isle called Fibula, where humans live. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_32: Hidden under Fibula is a secret dungeon. There you will find witches' cap. Are you willing to go there for good ape people?
npc.hairycles.multi_33: So much there is to do for Hairycles to prepare charm that will protect all ape people. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_34: You can help more. To create charm of life me need mighty token of life! Best is egg of a regenerating beast as a hydra is. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_35: Bring me egg of hydra please. You may find it in lair of Hydra at little lake south east of our lovely city Banuta! You think you can do?
npc.hairycles.multi_36: Ah yes that scroll. Sadly me not could read it yet. But the holy banana me insight gave! In dreams Hairycles saw where to find solution. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_37: Me saw a stone with lizard signs and other signs at once. If you read signs and tell Hairycles, me will know how to read signs. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_38: You go east to big desert. In desert there city. East of city under sand hidden tomb is. You will have to dig until you find it, so take shovel. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_39: Go down in tomb until come to big level and then go down another. There you find a stone with signs between two huge red stones. ...
npc.hairycles.multi_4: So listen, little ape was struck by plague. Hairycles not does know what plague it is. That is strange. Hairycles should know. But Hairycles learnt lots and lots ...
npc.hairycles.multi_40: Read it and return to me. Are you up to that challenge?
npc.hairycles.multi_41: Whisper moss strong is, but me need liquid that humans have to make it work ...
npc.hairycles.multi_42: Our raiders brought it from human settlement, it's called cough syrup. Go ask healer there for it.
npc.hairycles.multi_5: Me sure to make cure so strong to drive away all plague. But to create great cure me need powerful components ...
npc.hairycles.multi_6: Me need whisper moss. Whisper moss growing south of human settlement is. Problem is, evil little dworcs harvest all whisper moss immediately ...
npc.hairycles.multi_7: Me know they hoard some in their underground lair. My people raided dworcs often before humans came. So we know the moss is hidden in east of upper level of dworc lair ...
npc.hairycles.multi_8: You go there and take good moss from evil dworcs. Talk with me about mission when having moss.
npc.hairycles.multi_9: So listen, little ape was struck by plague. Hairycles not does know what plague it is. That is strange. Hairycles should know. But Hairycles learnt lots and lots ...
npc.hairycles.say_1: These are dire times for our people. Problems plenty are in this times. But me people not grant trust easy. Are you willing to prove you friend of ape people?
npc.hairycles.say_10: You brought Hairycles witches' cap from Fibula?
npc.hairycles.say_11: You do please Hairycles again, friend. Me hope madness will not spread further now. Perhaps you are ready for other mission.
npc.hairycles.say_12: Please destroy three casks in the complex beneath Banuta, so my people will come to senses again.
npc.hairycles.say_13: You brought hair of holy ape?
npc.hairycles.say_14: Get a hair of holy ape from forbidden land in east. Speak with blind prophet in cave.
npc.hairycles.say_15: Me know its much me asked for but go into the deepest catacombs under Banuta and destroy the monument of the serpent god.
npc.hairycles.say_16: No more missions await you right now, friend. Perhaps you want to check me offers for special friends... or shamanic powers.
npc.hairycles.say_17: Oh you bring cookie for old Hairycles?
npc.hairycles.say_18: Me truly proud of you, friend. You learn many about plants, charms and ape people. Me want grant you shamanic power now. You ready?
npc.hairycles.say_19: You already are shaman and doctor. Me proud of you.
npc.hairycles.say_2: Oh, you brought me whisper moss? Good hairless ape you are! Can me take it?
npc.hairycles.say_20: You not have finished journey for wisdom yet, young human.
npc.hairycles.say_21: You look for food and rest.
npc.hairycles.say_22: You look for food and rest.
npc.hairycles.say_23: To become friend of ape people a long and difficult way is. We do not trust easy but help is needed. Will you listen to story of Hairycles?
npc.hairycles.say_24: Hairycles sad is now. But perhaps you will change mind one day.
npc.hairycles.say_26: Stupid, you no have the moss me need. Go get it. It's somewhere in dworc lair. If you lost it, they might restocked it meanwhile. If you need to hear background of all again, ask Hairycles for {background}.
npc.hairycles.say_27: Ah yes! That's it. Thank you for bringing mighty whisper moss to Hairycles. It will help but still much is to be done. Just ask for other mission if you ready.
npc.hairycles.say_28: Strange being you are! Our people need help!
npc.hairycles.say_29: No no, not right syrup you have. Go get other, get right health syrup.
npc.hairycles.say_3: Please hurry. Bring me whisper moss from dworc lair. Make sure it is from dworc lair! Take it yourself only! If you need to hear background of all again, ask Hairycles for {background}.
npc.hairycles.say_30: You so good! Brought syrup to me! Thank you, will prepare cure now. Just ask for {mission} if you want help again.
npc.hairycles.say_32: Me sad. Me expected better from you!
npc.hairycles.say_33: Good thing that is! Report about your mission when have scroll.
npc.hairycles.say_34: Me sad. Me expected better from you!
npc.hairycles.say_35: That's bad news. If you lost it, only way to get other is to kill holy serpents. But you can't go there so you must ask adventurers who can.
npc.hairycles.say_36: No! That not scroll me looking for. Silly hairless ape you are. Go to village of lizards and get it there on your own!
npc.hairycles.say_37: You brought scroll with lizard text? Good! I will see what text tells me! Come back when ready for other mission.
npc.hairycles.say_38: That's bad news. If you lost it, only way to get other is to kill holy serpents. But you can't go there so you must ask adventurers who can.
npc.hairycles.say_39: Good thing that is! Report about mission when you have read those signs.
npc.hairycles.say_4: You brought me that cough syrup from human healer me asked for?
npc.hairycles.say_40: Me sad. Me expected better from you!
npc.hairycles.say_41: Oh, so clear is all now! Easy it will be to read the signs now! Soon we will know what to do! Thank you again! Ask for mission if you feel ready.
npc.hairycles.say_42: Me need to see it in your mind, other there is no way to proceed.
npc.hairycles.say_43: You brave hairless ape! Get me hydra egg. If you lose egg, you probably have to fight many, many hydras to get another.
npc.hairycles.say_44: Me sad. Me expected better from you!
npc.hairycles.say_45: You not have egg of hydra. Please get one!
npc.hairycles.say_46: Ah, the egg! Mighty warrior you be! Thank you. Hairycles will put it at safe place immediately.
npc.hairycles.say_47: Please hurry. Hairycles not knows when evil lizards strike again.
npc.hairycles.say_48: Long journey it will take, good luck to you.
npc.hairycles.say_49: Me sad. Me expected better from you!
npc.hairycles.say_5: Little ape should be healthy soon. Me so happy is. Thank you again! But me suspect we in more trouble than we thought. Will you help us again?
npc.hairycles.say_50: Not right mushroom you have. Find me a witches' cap on Fibula!
npc.hairycles.say_51: Incredible, you brought a witches' cap! Now me can prepare mighty charm of life. Yet still other {missions} will await you, friend.
npc.hairycles.say_52: Please try to find me a witches' cap on Fibula.
npc.hairycles.say_53: Hairycles sure you will make it. Good luck, friend.
npc.hairycles.say_55: Hairycles proud of you. Go and find holy hair. Good luck, friend.
npc.hairycles.say_57: You no have hair. You lost it? Go and look again.
npc.hairycles.say_58: Incredible! You got a hair of holy Bong! This will raise the spirit of my people. You are truly a friend. But one last mission awaits you.
npc.hairycles.say_59: You no have hair. You lost it? Go and look again.
npc.hairycles.say_6: You got scroll from lizard village in south east?
npc.hairycles.say_60: Hairycles sure you will make it. Just use hammer on all that looks like snake or lizard. Tell Hairycles if you succeed with mission.
npc.hairycles.say_62: Friend of the ape people! Take my gift and become me apprentice! Here is shaman clothing for you!
npc.hairycles.say_64: You have no cookie that I'd like.
npc.hairycles.say_65: Thank you, you are ... YOU SON OF LIZARD!
npc.hairycles.say_7: Ah yes, you read the signs in tomb? Good! May me look into your mind to see what you saw?
npc.hairycles.say_8: You still don't know signs on stone, go and look for it in tomb east in desert.
npc.hairycles.say_9: You bring Hairycles egg of hydra?
npc.hairycles.stdmod_1: Me great {wizard}. Me great doctor of {ape people}. Me know many plants. Me old and me have seen many things.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_2: We see many things and learning quick. Merlkin magic learn quick, quick. We just watch and learn. Sometimes we try and learn.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_3: Things not good now. Need helper to do {mission} for me people.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_4: We be {kongra}, {sibang} and {merlkin}. Strange hairless ape people live in city called Port Hope.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_5: Kongra verry strong. Kongra verry angry verry fast. Take care when kongra comes. Better climb on highest tree.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_6: Sibang verry fast and funny. Sibang good gather food. Sibang know {jungle} well.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_7: Merlkin we are. Merlkin verry wise, merlkin learn many things quick. Teach other apes things a lot. Making {heal} and making {magic}.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_8: We see many things and learning quick. Merlkin magic learn quick, quick. We just watch and learn. Sometimes we try and learn.
npc.hairycles.stdmod_9: Jungle is dangerous. Jungle also provides us food. Take care when in jungle and safe you be.
npc.hal.say_1: Hicks! I... I... <he is obviously drunk and his report more than confusing>.
npc.hal.say_2: You can {pass} either to the {Arena Quarter} or {Alchemist Quarter}. Which one will it be?
npc.halvar.greet_msg_1: Hello competitor! Do you want to {fight} in the arena or shall I explain the {rules} first?
npc.halvar.say_1: So you agree with the {rules} and want to participate in the {challenge}? The {fee} for one try in {{}} is {} gold pieces. Do you really want to participate and pay the {fee}?
npc.halvar.say_13: You already paid the fee, go and fight!
npc.halvar.say_15: You've already completed the arena in all {difficulty levels}.
npc.halvar.say_16: As you wish! You can pass the door now and enter the teleporter to the pits.
npc.halvar.say_17: You do not have enough money.
npc.halvar.say_18: Come back when you are ready then.
npc.halvar.stdmod_1: What do you want to know? Something about the three different {difficulties}, the {general} rules or the {prices}? Maybe you also want to know what happens when you {die}?
npc.halvar.stdmod_10: Basically you pay me a {fee}, and you are sent into an arena with 10 different stages. If you succeed you will be rewarded accordingly.
npc.halvar.stdmod_11: My job is to explain about the rules and to get the fee from the competitors.
npc.halvar.stdmod_12: Well I would rather call it an {Ultimate Challenge} than a mission.
npc.halvar.stdmod_2: There are three difficulties: Greenhorn, Scrapper and Warlord. On each challenge you will be confronted with ten monsters increasing in strength.
npc.halvar.stdmod_3: There are three difficulties: Greenhorn, Scrapper and Warlord. On each challenge you will be confronted with ten monsters increasing in strength.
npc.halvar.stdmod_4: There are three difficulties: Greenhorn, Scrapper and Warlord. On each challenge you will be confronted with ten monsters increasing in strength.
npc.halvar.stdmod_5: That is the easiest way in our arena. The {fee} is 1000 gold. We were setting this up for of our children to challenge some easy monsters and train them for the future.
npc.halvar.stdmod_6: The most common difficulty for us. The {fee} is 5000 gold. So if you are experienced in fighting middle class monsters this is your challenge!
npc.halvar.stdmod_7: Only the strongest among us will take this challenge. The {fee} is 10000 gold. If you pass that I promise you the respect of all citizens here. You will be a hero!
npc.halvar.stdmod_8: The fee is either 1000, 5000 or 10000 gold for one try. Remember that if you {die}, it is YOUR problem and you won't be able to get back to your corpse and your backpack.
npc.halvar.stdmod_9: It would be better not to die! In every pit there is an emergency exit, the portal to the south. If you die in a pit... well... your corpse and backpack are gone, so you enter the arena at your own risk.
npc.hamish.greet_msg_1: Hi there, fellow adventurer. \z What's your need? Say {trade} and we'll soon get you fixed up. Or ask me about {potions}, {wands}, or {runes}.
npc.hamish.say_1: Small and deceptively friendly-looking island. Well, I used to study the plants and herbs here for my potions.
npc.hamish.say_2: Nowadays, I leave that to Oressa, she has a better way with that horrible wildlife here. I prefer to distil potions in the quiet of my lab. If you need some potions, runes or other magic equipment, ask for a trade.
npc.hamish.say_3: Dawnport is not far off from the coast of the Tibian Mainland. Lots of cities, monsters, bandits, brigands, mean folk and people of low understanding with no sense of respect towards alchemical genius. <mutters to himself>
npc.hamish.say_4: Ahem. Once you're level 8, you should be experienced enough to choose your definite vocation and leave Dawnport for Main - and Tibia definitely needs more skilled adventurers to keep those monsters in check which roam our lands!
npc.hamish.say_5: I wish I had thought of changing my name to that of a hero. Would have smoothed my way no end!
npc.hamish.say_6: Anyway, whatever he was before he joined, Tybald now fits the bill of the legendary hero. He even has a crush on lady Oressa. Cute. <chuckles>
npc.hamish.say_7: Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
npc.hamish.sendtrade_msg_1: Take your pick! Or maybe you want to look only at {potions}, {wands} or {runes}?
npc.hamish.stdmod_10: Mana potions to refill your magic power!
npc.hamish.stdmod_2: Potions! Wands! Runes! Get them here!
npc.hamish.stdmod_3: You levelled up but your wand is old? Come and buy a new one here!
npc.hamish.stdmod_4: Ran out of mana or a little kablooie? Come to me to resupply!
npc.hamish.stdmod_5: Low on magic and need a little extra? Get yourself a rune!
npc.hamish.stdmod_6: Pack of monsters give you trouble? Throw an area rune at them!
npc.hamish.stdmod_7: Health potions to refill your health in combat!
npc.hamish.stdmod_8: Taking back empty potion flasks! Get your deposit back here!
npc.hamish.stdmod_9: Careful with that! That's a highly reactive potion you have there!

npc.hanna.greet_msg_1: Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What do you need? Have a look at my wonderful {offers} in gems and jewellery.
npc.hanna.say_1: Pretty, isn't it? My friend Amber taught me how to make it, but I could help you with one if you like. What do you say?
npc.hanna.say_2: Oh, you're back already? Did you bring a legion helmet, 100 chicken feathers and 50 honeycombs?
npc.hanna.say_4: Okay, here we go, listen closely! I need a few things... a basic hat of course, maybe a legion helmet would do. Then about 100 chicken feathers... and 50 honeycombs as glue. That's it, come back to me once you gathered it!
npc.hanna.say_5: Aw, I guess you don't like feather hats. No big deal.
npc.hanna.say_6: Sorry, but I can't see a legion helmet.
npc.hanna.say_7: Sorry, but you don't enough chicken feathers.
npc.hanna.say_8: Sorry, but you don't have enough honeycombs.
npc.hanna.say_9: Great job! That must have taken a lot of work. Okay, you put it like this... then glue like this... here!
npc.hanna.stdmod_1: Gems and jewellery! Best prices in town!
npc.hanna.stdmod_2: I am a jeweler. Maybe you want to have a look at my wonderful offers.
npc.hanna.voice_1: Gems and jewellery! Best prices in town!
npc.hardek.farewell_msg_1: Good bye. Visit me whenever you want to sell something.
npc.hardek.greet_msg_1: Hello |PLAYERNAME|! Do you need my services?
npc.hardek.stdmod_1: Buying and selling all sorts of weapons and armors!
npc.hardek.voice_1: Buying and selling all sorts of weapons and armors!
npc.hardek.walkaway_msg_1: Good bye. Visit me whenever you want to sell something.
npc.harlow.greet_msg_1: What do you want, |PLAYERNAME|? I'm a {busy} man.
npc.harlow.say_1: What the heck, stop bothering me with your questions.
npc.harlow.stdmod_1: So you are saying you're looking for someone to take you to Vengoth?
npc.harlow.stdmod_3: I could do that, it's not far from here. I don't run a charity organisation, though. Tell you what. Give me 100 gold pieces, and me and my boat are yours for the trip. Okay?
npc.harlow.stdmod_6: Want me to bring you to Vengoth again for 100 gold?
npc.harlow_vengoth.greet_msg_1: Want to go back to {Yalahar} for 50 gold? Just ask me.
npc.harlow_vengoth.stdmod_1: Do you seek a passage to Yalahar for |TRAVELCOST|?
npc.harog.farewell_msg_1: It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.harog.sendtrade_msg_1: Keep in mind you won't find better offers here. Just browse through my wares.
npc.haroun.farewell_msg_1: Farewell! May the serene light of the enlightened one rest shine on your travels.
npc.haroun.multi_2: |PLAYERNAME|, that almost sounded like the word of greeting. Humans - cute they are!
npc.haroun.say_1: Whoa! A human! This is no place for you, |PLAYERNAME|. Go and play somewhere else.
npc.haroun.say_11: I'm sorry, human. But you need Gabel's permission to trade with me.
npc.haroun.say_2: Be greeted, human |PLAYERNAME|. How can a humble djinn be of service?
npc.haroun.say_3: Do you want to trade Boots of haste for Enchanted Chicken Wing?
npc.haroun.say_4: Do you want to trade 4 Warrior Helmet for Warrior Sweat?
npc.haroun.say_5: Do you want to trade 2 Royal Helmet for Fighting Spirit
npc.haroun.say_6: Do you want to trade 3 Fire Sword for Magic Sulphur
npc.haroun.say_7: I trade Enchanted Chicken Wing for Boots of Haste, Warrior Sweat for 4 Warrior Helmets, Fighting Spirit for 2 Royal Helmet Magic Sulphur for 3 Fire Swords
