npc.jack_fate_goroma.stdmod_4: This is where we are... the volcano island Goroma. There are many rumours about this place.
npc.jack_springer.greet_msg_1: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! There is much we have to {discuss}.
npc.jack_springer.greet_msg_2: Hello, stranger! You look suspicious to me. I don't think we have anything to discuss.
npc.jack_springer.greet_msg_4: Hello, stranger! Sorry, but I never heard about you. I'm looking for more experienced help.
npc.jack_springer.multi_1: You have to travel to the isle of the kings. There, hidden beneath the isle of the kings is the shamefully hidden grave of king Zelos. It is him, they are trying to raise. ...
npc.jack_springer.multi_10: Don't forget that you'll need very potent holy water for your task. If you need some, just ask me for a {trade}.
npc.jack_springer.multi_11: [EN] Don't forget that you'll need very potent holy water for your task. If you need some, just ask me for a {trade}.
npc.jack_springer.multi_12: Don't forget that you'll need very potent holy water for your task. If you need some, just ask me for a {trade}.
npc.jack_springer.multi_2: With some luck you will arrive before the ritual's completion. But be warned. At least four risen lich-knights will be present, to raise 'their king'. ...
npc.jack_springer.multi_3: Hopefully the ritual will bind some of their powers but they will still be formidable foes. You will have to act quick because with each moment you take to defeat the knights ...
npc.jack_springer.multi_4: The ritual will progress and the king will become stronger up to a point where you might be unable to defeat him. Due to the efforts and sacrifices of the death cultists, the king will be active at some capacity and you will have to confront him. ...
npc.jack_springer.multi_5: Remember, the further the ritual progresses when you face him, he will become considerably more powerful. So time is of the essence. ...
npc.jack_springer.multi_6: All I can do right now is to wish you good luck and may the gods bless you.
npc.jack_springer.multi_7: It became obvious that their goal is to raise an ancient and fallen king, to lead their lich-knights and raise even more of them. ...
npc.jack_springer.multi_8: [EN]  With each lich-knight being able to raise and control lesser undead, this would lead to a chain-reaction. If they succeed, we might face an undead {threat} not seen since the corpse wars.
npc.jack_springer.multi_9: [EN] Don't forget that you'll need very potent holy water for your task. If you need some, just ask me for a {trade}.
npc.jack_springer.say_1: By now the cultists of the Shiron'Fal seem to have abandoned their search. But this is sadly no good news. It seems they gathered enough lich-knights to proceed with their {ultimate} plan.
npc.jack_springer.say_2: Sadly, I have no news yet. But I can give you information about the {locations} of the graves that we learned about. If you need more holy water just ask me for a {trade}.
npc.jack_springer.say_3: Here is your second addon for your efforts!
npc.jack_springer.say_4: Here is your first addon for your efforts!
npc.jack_springer.say_5: Incredible! You averted a crisis that would have utterly crippled our defences aganist any other threat that is arising. Let me grant you the honor to be one of the hands of the inquisition alongside with the according outfit as a reward.
npc.jack_springer.say_6: Indeed you averted us a great danger! We will ever be greatful to you hand of the inquisition!
npc.jack_springer.say_7: You need to travel to the isle of the kings and end this threat before they raise king Zelos!
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_10: Here is where you come into play. We could identify the most recent plot of the Shiron'Fal and already had some {clashes}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_11: In our efforts to hinder their plot, we achieved mixed results at best. But now things are escalating fast and we have to {hurry}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_12: Our resources are already stretched thin, so we need your help with the most recent {problem}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_13: The legion tries to use a new form of twisted rituals to raise the bodies of well-known {knights}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_14: These powerful undead were a terrible threat on their own but it seems even they are just part of some larger {scheme} that we cannot make out yet.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_15: We are still working feverishly to uncover their goals but for now more imminent {threats} are at hand.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_18:
For this purpose, the members gather knowledge, artefacts and powerful individuals. The members are formidable at certain fields of expertise. They are cunning and powerful and act with no regard for others, with no remorse or mercy. ... \z
	As they are doing this since ages, they must have acquired tremendous powers and knowledge. Their members often operate alone but are usually well funded with the necessary resources. ... \z
	Whatever their endgame might be, each of their operations pose a grave danger to the whole world and have to be {stopped}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_19:
Reaching the graves will not be without danger and if you encounter the death cultists you will have to fight them. Even worse, they might have even succeeded in some cases. ... \z
	As a newly risen lich-knight is not able to leave the site of its resurrection for some time, you might have to fight some of them. ... \z
	Let us pray that you never come too {late} or else some of the fiends might be able to leave their crypts.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_2: I need your help in a matter of utmost {urgency}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_20:
We have located twelve graves that have to be secured: In the old northern Edron graveyard, in the dark cathedral of the plains of havoc, in the ghostlands, on Cormaya, Somewhere in the Femor Hills, on Vengoth, ... \z
	in the graveyard of Darashia, in the old temple north of Thais, at the entrance to the orcland, one is on the southern ice islands, in a mountain on Kilmaresh, one on an island north-east of Ankrahmun.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_21:
Well, in Rathleton there was an individual at work, looking for some ancient artefact of power. ... \z
	To cover its escape the creature left another creature, known as the ravager to cover his tracks. But there is {more}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_22:
Only recently someone was trying to manipulate the elven dream courts into releasing a monstrosity of nightmares, probably planning to control or recruit this creature. .... \z
	But those incidents were just some of {many}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_23:
There is a scheming going on behind the scenes. Powerful good people were corrupted. Evil-doers got backup and resources from a hidden ally. ... \z
	Powerful malignant creatures, gathering their kind under their banner and so much more. These things are not happening by chance. There is a pattern, a guiding {hand}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_24:
It has a rather complex meaning and as far as we can tell it translates to 'army of those who are many, dedicated to the ultimate time of mayhem and despair'. ... \z
	Other, more handy names are army of the last battlefield, army of the last days, legion of mayhem, dread legion or simply the {legion}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_25:
We know little for sure. You can look into our books to see some of our sources. But most are vague and some even contradictory. ... \z
	To summarise what we know, let me tell you this: The Shiron'Fal is an extremely old organisation. It seeks to accumulate power for some unknown but certainly sinister {goal}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_26:
The knights they aim at were tainted in life by their actions or happenstance. ... \z
	This leaves their bodies vulnerable to their special breed of necromancy that would raise them as powerful {lich}-knights.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_3: I need your help in a matter of utmost {urgency}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_4: The situation is complicated and it's even hard to say where to {start} best, just to describe it to you.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_5: You see, several incidents in history can be traced back to a single {source}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_6: Things get murkier the further you go down in history, but that's not even necessary. Even today we can discern a certain pattern in recent {events}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_7: The recent rise of lycanthropy, the robbery of certain forbidden arcane texts and the vanishing of at least three dangerous individuals, targeted by the inquisition are just the tip of the {iceberg}.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_8: This outside force is moving behind the scenes since ages. Our research suggests that this force probably even {predates} the rise of humanity.
npc.jack_springer.stdmod_9: Well, we are sure that the puppeteer behind all these events is an organisation. So old that even its name, the Shiron'Fal, has lost its meaning, because the {language} it originates from is long dead.
npc.jacob.multi_1: A sacrificial site? Damn, sounds like some freakish cult or something. Just great. And this ancient structure you talked about that's not part of the sewers? You'd better see the local historian about that, man. ...
npc.jacob.multi_2: He can make more sense of what you found there. His name is Barazbaz. He should be in the magistrate building.
npc.jacob.multi_3: Wow, you already did it, that's fast. I'm used to a more laid-back attitude from most people. It's a shame to risk losing you to some collapsing tunnels, but a deal is a deal. ...
npc.jacob.multi_4: I hereby grant you the permission to enter the abandoned part of the sewers. Take care, man! ...
npc.jacob.multi_5: If you find something interesting, come back to talk about the {abandoned sewers}.
npc.jacob.multi_6: You want to enter the abandoned sewers? That's rather dangerous and not a good idea, man. That part of the sewers was not sealed off for nothing, you know? ...
npc.jacob.multi_7: But hey, it's your life, bro. So here's the deal. I'll let you into the abandoned sewers if you help me with our {mission}.
npc.jacob.say_1: I'm glad to see you back alive and healthy. Did you find anything interesting that you want to {report}?
npc.jacob.say_2: The sewers need repair. You in?
npc.jacob.say_3: Elliott's keeps calling it that. It's just another job! You fixed some broken pipes and stuff? Let me check, {ok}?
npc.jacob.say_4: If you want to redo this task just say {abandoned sewers} to repeat it.
npc.jacob.say_5: Good. Broken pipe and generator pieces, there's smoke evading. That's how you recognise them. See how you can fix them using your hands. Need about, oh, twenty of them at least repaired. Report to me or Jacob
npc.jacob.say_6: Good. Thanks, man. That's one vote you got for helping us with this.
npc.jacob.say_7: You already reported this mission, go to the next.
npc.jakahr.farewell_msg_1: It was an honour to serve you, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.jakahr.greet_msg_1: Hello, mourned pilgrim. How may I help you |PLAYERNAME|?
npc.jakahr.sendtrade_msg_1: Here. Don't forget that you need to buy a label too if you want to send a parcel. Always write the name of the {receiver} in the first line.
npc.jakahr.walkaway_msg_1: It was an honour to serve you.
npc.jamesfrancis.greet_msg_1: Gerimor is right. As an expert for minotaurs I am researching these creatures for years. I thought I already knew a lot but the monsters in this cave are {different}. It's a big {mystery}.
npc.jamesfrancis.greet_msg_3: You say the minotaurs were controlled by a very powerful boss they worshipped. This explains why they had so much more power than the normal ones. ...
npc.jamesfrancis.greet_msg_4: I'm very thankful. Please go to the Druid of Crunor and tell him what you've seen. He might be interested in that.
npc.jamesfrancis.say_1: The minotaurs I faced in the cave are much stronger than the normal ones. What I were able to see before I had to flee: all of them seem to belong to a cult worshipping their god. Could you do me a {favour}?
npc.jamesfrancis.say_10: Very nice. Return to me if you've finished your job.

npc.jean_pierre.greet_msg_1: Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|. What are you doing out here?
npc.jean_pierre.multi_1: Time to have a sweet drink! Let's pour the bug milk into my cauldron and heat it over fire until it's boiling... <starts slicing mangoes in the meantime> there! ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_10: Now, carefully, we add the demonic blood... <and time seems to stand still as seemingly for the first time ever he does something slowly, pouring a single drop of concentrated demonic blood onto each ball> ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_100: [EN] One fresh dead bat, three jalapeño peppers, five brown breads, two eggs, one powder herb and five red mushrooms.
npc.jean_pierre.multi_101: One fresh dead bat, three jalapeño peppers, five brown breads, two eggs, one powder herb and five red mushrooms.
npc.jean_pierre.multi_102: [EN] We'll add some other vegetables and spices for the delicate and distinctive taste. Bring me the following ingredients and I'll show you how it's done. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_103: [EN] Two hydra tongue plants, two tomatoes, one cucumber, two eggs, one troll green and one vial of wine.
npc.jean_pierre.multi_104: Two hydra tongue plants, two tomatoes, one cucumber, two eggs, one troll green and one vial of wine.
npc.jean_pierre.multi_105: [EN] The name is just for the effect it has on people. <winks> Bring me the following ingredients and I'll show you how it's done. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_106: [EN] Two pieces of meat, two vials of beer, twenty potatoes, one onion, one bulb of garlic and five ounces of flour. Make sure that the ingredients are fresh and smell good.
npc.jean_pierre.multi_107: Two pieces of meat, two vials of beer, twenty potatoes, one onion, one bulb of garlic and five ounces of flour. Make sure that the ingredients are fresh and smell good.
npc.jean_pierre.multi_11: Here you go, but beware possible side effects! You never know for sure what will happen and so far all of those I tried had awesome effects, so of course I don't hope for nasty surprises! Enjoy!
npc.jean_pierre.multi_12: Awesome! Let's go! Let's start with preparing the sandcrawlers <starts boiling water on a stove and tosses the sandcrawler shells in there> ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_13: I understand your scepticism, but believe me, all will be well! As you can see, they change colour from dark to light red, and that's when they also start turning soft. <stirs with one hand while he slices carrots and peppers with the other hand> ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_14: Now add whole potatoes and let everything cook at high temperature until the potatoes are so soft they're basically falling apart. <mashes really fast, creating something of a dark brownish colour that doesn't really look tasty> ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_15: Yes yes, I know, don't give me that look! You'll be surprised! Now just add the chopped carrots and chili for a healthy portion of vitamins and spices, keep stiring and mashing and let it simmer for about an hour. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_16: You're wondering why I chose a simple recipe like that for my famous menu? You'll know when you taste it! ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_17: Heeeeeere you are - just a few spoons of this great stew make you so full that the bowl I give you will last for a long time until it's finally depleted. Enjoy!
npc.jean_pierre.multi_18: Yum! Just the thought of it makes me drool. <tosses the shrimps into a bowl and soaks them in coconut milk as he goes on chopping all mushrooms in the blink of an eye> ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_19: I see you brought real Zaoan rice balls! That saves us a lot of time as we don't have to cook the rice anymore. Now we just flatten them out nice and medium thick on this baking tray. <squeezes and smoothes the rice piles with his fingers> ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_2: Now we're breaking all of the eggs into there - 1, 2, 10, 20, 40 <ticktickcrack> crumble the honeycombs and toss the sliced mangoes into the hot mix. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_20: In the meantime, our shrimps have absorbed some of the coconut milk and we can now add them on top of the rice. <spreads them evenly across the rice and pours the coconut milk from the bowl over the rice> ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_21: Now we just need to add the mushrooms <tosses them all over the tray>, pour the rest of the coconut milk over it and put it into the oven! ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_23: Aaaaaaand there you go! Sweet coconut goodness! And psst - the shrimps add some submarine flavour to this dish. You should definitely eat it while walking underwater and wearing a helmet of the deep. Just in case. Enjoy!
npc.jean_pierre.multi_24: So, now for our final dish - a grand dessert from the amazon girls at Carlin! <grates carrots during his explanations> ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_25: It's easy as it can be - mix a normal cake dough with milk, flour and eggs, then add some cookie crumbs for the crunchy effect later on. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_26: Stir in the grated carrots and tiny peanut pieces and bake it for about thirty minutes! Now we'll make a great topping with sugar and lemon juice, pour it over the cake and decorate it. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_27: And voilà, we're done! The girls of Carlin swear that it sharpens their eyesight, at least for a while. I'm sure it will somehow aid you in your battles. Enjoy! ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_28: Oh, which reminds me - my little apprentice, we are finished with our cooking course. I think you did great and if it was my decision, you could open your own tavern. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_29: But anyway, it's up to you what you make of your newly discovered skills! In case you forget my recipes, please feel free to take a copy of the cookbook upstairs. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_3: Now we just have to let it simmer and stir using a blessed wooden stake <stirs so vigorously that you can barely see his arms anymore> for thirty minutes. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_30: You can drop by and practice cooking those dishes, at least during the time that I'm at home. I promise that I will cook each dish once with you, but then I have to take care of my other apprentices. Cheers to you!
npc.jean_pierre.multi_31: Great! After all this meat, we shouldn't neglect to prepare some fish. <carefully removes heads, tails and bones from the fishes and peels shrimps at incredible speed> ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_32: [EN] Simply cut the rolls in half, shortly fry one slice of each fish type, put in the shrimps and spice up with grinded fern, which, by the way, tastes slightly like dill. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_33: [EN] Nicely decorate it on a plate, and voilà, we're done already! Can't tell you much about the effects, but fishermen in Svargrond seem to love it. Enjoy!
npc.jean_pierre.multi_34: Nicely decorate it on a plate, and voilà, we're done already! Can't tell you much about the effects, but fishermen in Svargrond seem to love it. Enjoy!
npc.jean_pierre.multi_35: Here we go! <pounds with his bare hands on the steak> This will break through the meat fibres, making our steak more tender for this fine Daramanian dish. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_36: It's easy to prepare, just chop and sweat the onions and add small pieces of pumpkin, beetroot, plums and peppers. Put the steak into the pan too to let it absorb some of the sweet and fruity flavour. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_37: Finally, remove the fruits and onions from the pan and fry the steak from both sides until it's crisp and crusty. Put on a plate and decorate with the fruit mix. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_38: The people of Darashia say that it has magical abilities and will help you if you feel totally drained. Enjoy!
npc.jean_pierre.multi_39: Okay! So after all of these heavy dishes, we're going to create a fast little snack. <starts preparing the peppers as he speaks> ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_4: By now, the power of the blessed wooden stake will have been transferred into our elixir, so let's put out the fire and let it cool down. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_40: First of all, remove the top of the jalapeño peppers and clean their inside, so that you have space for the filling. Now for the filling, we grate the cheese and mix it with the mead and the eggs, until it has a nice consistency. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_41: We add the grinded herbs and blend it well. Push a spoonful in each jalapeño pepper until they are nicely stuffed. Now, we shortly fry the jalapeño peppers in a pan to heat them up. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_42: The filling will melt nicely, just be careful that it doesn't drip out! And voilà, we're done! ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_43: This famous dish from Ankrahmun is quite hot and spicy, so only eat one at a time. It's also possible that you get the urge to run really fast afterwards. Enjoy!
npc.jean_pierre.multi_44: So let's start! <rubs hands together and chops the vegetables> This is a dish especially famous in the area around Ab'Dendriel! Chop the onions into little cubes and sweat them in a pan until they are glassy. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_45: Add garlic and mushrooms and fry gently until the mushrooms have shrunk up. Now, we add the peeled tomatoes and corn and have it all nicely cook together. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_46: Put in carrot pieces and cucumber at the very end, so they will stay crisp! Finally put the cheese over it like a little blanket have it melt on the oven until it's slightly brownish. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_47: And voilà, we're done! This dish will help you in your battles and supply you with enough power to hit really hard! Enjoy!
npc.jean_pierre.multi_48: Great! Let's get it done! <mixes and shakes faster than any human could> An easy one again, but you'll get right into holiday mood, like the Meriana beach dwellers I got that recipe from. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_49: Melt the chocolate in a hot-water bath and add the grinded herbs - did you know, those herbs have a flavour like cinnamon and vanilla, yummy! Keep at gentle heat and add the milk. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_5: <carefully pours the cooled elixir into a small bottle or glass> There! Its inventor said it had amazing effects on the ring you're wearing, as long as the ring is based on time, not on charges. Enjoy! ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_50: Mash the banana and stir it really well into the chocolate-milk mixture. Gosh, do you smell that? Pure goodness! Now finally, we take just a bit of the creamcake and fold it in. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_51: Voilà, we're done! To be honest, I don't know what this drink does, but at least it makes me really happy. Drink together with a loved one and enjoy!
npc.jean_pierre.multi_52: This is a recipe right from the jungles of Tiquanda! <grinds and chops during his talk> Grind the stone herb and mix it with the coconut milk, then bathe the chicken in it for a while. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_53: In the meantime, peel the oranges and mangos, chop them into pieces and add them to the mix. Take the chicken out of its bath and fry it, preferably over open fire. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_54: Take the fruits out of the spicy coconut milk and heat them on an oven. Once the chicken is fried, add the fruits and spray some squeezed lemon over it. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_55: Voilà, we're done! They say that this dish has magical abilities and can awaken secret powers in you during your battles. Enjoy!
npc.jean_pierre.multi_56: Let's get started! <starts grinding and chopping at amazing speed> The trick with this one is the crunchy crust around the wings. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_57: First, we grate the dry brown bread into very small crumbs and mix that with the two eggs. Add grinded peppers for the spicy taste and the powder herb for a hint of curry flavour. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_58: Carefully separate the bat wings, clean them of any possible hairs and coat them in our mixture. Roast them in a pan together with sliced mushrooms and serve. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_59: Voilà, we're done! This recipe is from the area around Thais and should help you protect yourself in your battles. Enjoy!
npc.jean_pierre.multi_6: And by the way... since those were all the recipes from this year and you cooked them so nicely, you may take the cookbook containing them from upstairs, if you like!
npc.jean_pierre.multi_60: Okay, here we go! <cuts the ingredients so fast that his hands seem almost blurry> This one is easy, just chop the hydra tongues, tomatoes and cucumber into tiny pieces. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_61: Now for the sauce - our base is wine, in which we mix the raw eggs until it got a nice smooth consistency. Add grinded troll green, whose flavour is quite similar to basil and shake the sauce in a mug. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_62: Pour it over the salad, and voilà, we're done! This is a Venorean recipe and very tasty. I recommend eating it when you're suffering from some kind of dangerous condition. Enjoy!
npc.jean_pierre.multi_63: Aah, so let's see! <prepares the food quickly while he explains it to you> We cook the meat in a large pot together with the chopped onion until it's separated from the bones. Now we also have a fine meat broth! ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_64: Cut the potatoes into small pieces and add them to the pot. Add some flour to thicken the stew. Finally, spice it up with some garlic and add beer for the typical dwarvish taste! ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_65: And voilà, we're done. I developed this recipe while talking to Maryza in the Jolly Axeman. She said to eat it when one's health is low. Enjoy!
npc.jean_pierre.multi_66: Did you dare eat all of your Demonic Candy Balls...? Hehehe! Well, I almost forgot one of the most essential parts for a perfect dinner. A drink! I have one for you, almost a designer drink you could say. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_67: Its inventor seems to have done some scientific research in order to achieve his desired effect, which is - charging magical rings. You have to drink it while you're wearing one for a miraculous effect! ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_68: Bring me the following ingredients and we'll get started: Fourty eggs, twenty mangos, ten honeycombs, one bottle of bug milk and one blessed wooden stake. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_69: Oh yes, I understand your worries about the eggs, but just make sure they're fresh and all should be fine for our {Sweet Mangonaise Elixir}!
npc.jean_pierre.multi_7: Very nice! I'm ready for action! <quickly grabs all the candies, candy canes and gingerbread men and crushes them with amazing speed> ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_70: Weren't you surprised by the great taste of our main dish? In case you still have some space left in your tummy, we're in for a sweet and fun dessert - but beware unwanted side effects! ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_71: It was introduced to me by a fearless knight who invented this recipe rather by accident when a bottle of demonic blood broke in his backpack and spilled its contents over his bag of candy balls. ...

npc.jean_pierre.multi_74: In any case, bring me the following ingredients and we'll make some {Demonic Candy Balls}, if you like: Three candies, three candy canes, two bars of chocolate, fifteen gingerbread men and one concentrated demonic blood.
npc.jean_pierre.multi_75: After this wonderful and tasty starter we're all set for a special dish I learnt from a brave adventurer who almost starved when he got lost in the mountains between Ankrahmun and Port Hope, or so he told me. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_76: Luckily, he was saved by nomads - can you imagine? - and they fed him a special local dish that's very cheap and easy to prepare, yet rich in vitamins and spending energy for hours. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_77: Now don't be shocked, but - they do put sandcrawlers in there. When I tried to prepare that dish at first, I was repelled by its awful appearance, but since it smelled so good I did take a sip and was pleasantly surprised of the great taste. ...
npc.jean_pierre.multi_78: According to the adventurer, this meal works well with any kind of vegetables or any kind of edible creepy-crawlers, depending on what the nomads get their hands on, but we'll stick to the original for now! ...

npc.jean_pierre.say_5: Fine, young human. Ask me for a {recipe} anytime and I'll teach you what I know.
npc.jean_pierre.say_6: Make sure that you have all the ingredients with you.
npc.jean_pierre.say_7: It seems you have already cooked this dish this year. Please come back next year in August.
npc.jean_pierre.say_8: Make sure that you have all the ingredients with you.

npc.jefrey.greet_msg_1: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
npc.jefrey.voice_1: Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.jerom.greet_msg_1: Hello. Sorry, but I'm not in the best {mood} today.
npc.jerom.multi_1: I'm not sure but I suppose that an evil troll lives in the mountains here! I saw him rummaging in the ruins of my house. ...
npc.jerom.multi_2: I took a closer look and found my family casket ripped open. It contained a precious necklace. If I had it back, I could sell it and start over! ...
npc.jerom.multi_3: Could you look for this mean beast, find out why he did and either get me some money ormy necklace to rebuild my business?
npc.jerom.say_1: Thank you sooo much <sniffs>. Well, you know I lost everything, but recently I found this strange rope here. I don't need it, here take it!
npc.jerom.say_2: Great! Finally, some light at the end of the tunnel! Come back and ask me for the quest when you solved this mystery!
npc.jerom.stdmod_10: I like it here, at least the town. I was warned that there are nasty creatures outside the town walls but I didn't expect anything to happen so close to town!
npc.jerom.stdmod_11: I was always good with animals. My parents had a farm, the McRonalds farm. Maybe you know it. Anyway, I had the idea that people may like to have animals as companions and so one led to another.
npc.jerom.stdmod_12: I'd go mad listening to this 'ribbit' the whole time. But each to his own!
npc.jerom.stdmod_13: I'm new here in Edron. I wanted to open up a pet shop. But now I'm ruined, uahahahaha <sniffs>.
npc.jerom.stdmod_14: I need to write a letter to the king. I'm not sure if those 2 million gold coins that Daniel Steelsoul demanded from me weren't too much.
npc.jerom.stdmod_15: I'm there from time to time, catching frogs. People like their bright colours.
npc.jerom.stdmod_16: My name is Jerom but no need to remember my name. All my belongings are destroyed and stolen. I'll be gone soon!
npc.jerom.stdmod_17: Raymond Striker offered me a contract to export parrots from Meriana but I won't need them anymore now that I'm ruined.
npc.jerom.stdmod_18: Not a very good spot to catch animals. At least no animals that pass off as pets.
npc.jerom.stdmod_19: Yesterday I would have said that I like all creatures of Tibia but TODAY my life has changed! When I catch this stinking troll!!
npc.jerom.stdmod_2: Dear gods! My precious house, DESTROYED!!
npc.jerom.stdmod_20: True, why not keep a rat as a pet! They can eat your trash, live inside your walls and you don't have to worry if one dies ! Could be a huge success....if I weren't ruined!!!!
npc.jerom.stdmod_21: That would be a mission for a hero.
npc.jerom.stdmod_22: Well, I don't see any other way than going back to my home country now.
npc.jerom.stdmod_23: Good idea! Easy to catch and once the owner has been bitten, he can't sue me anymore, hehehe!!.... but wait....I forgot....I'm ruined, uahahahaha <sniffs>.
npc.jerom.stdmod_24: I never make profit in Thais and most of the time I get robbed. I stopped visiting Thais for business some years ago.
npc.jerom.stdmod_3: Oh no!! What am I supposed to do now?!?
npc.jerom.stdmod_4: The only animal to catch there is the cobra and most people don't like to keep one as a pet.
npc.jerom.stdmod_5: Who wants such an animal as a pet?!?!
npc.jerom.stdmod_6: Those amazons denied making business with me. You know the reason?!? I tell you, the reason was that I am MALE! Ridiculous!
npc.jerom.stdmod_7: For sure, I would have offered cats!
npc.jerom.stdmod_8: He gave me the permission to open up a pet shop here. I paid him almost everything I got!
npc.jerom.stdmod_9: I made contact with Svargrond! A guy named Buddel wanted to sell me a three-headed dog. I haven't seen it yet, but imagine how much money I could make by breeding such a pet!!
npc.jerom.voice_2: Dear gods! My precious house, DESTROYED!!
npc.jerom.voice_3: Oh no!! What am I supposed to do now?!?
npc.jeronimo.voice_1: Change your Bar of Gold's for Items here!
npc.jessica.greet_msg_1: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
npc.jessica.voice_1: Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.jezzara.greet_msg_1: Be mourned pilgrim in flesh. Talking of flesh, maybe you'd enjoy some {food}?
npc.jezzara.sendtrade_msg_1: Sure, take a look at my offers.
npc.jezzara.voice_1: Food of various kinds, have a look.
npc.jondrin.multi_1: A necrometer? Have you any idea how rare and expensive a necrometer is? There is no way I could justify giving a necrometer to an inexperienced adventurer. Hm, although ... if you weren't inexperienced that would be a different matter. ...
npc.jondrin.multi_2: Did you do any measuring task for Doubleday lately?
npc.jondrin.say_2: Indeed I heard you did a good job out there. <sigh> I guess that means I can hand you one of our necrometers. Handle it with care.
npc.jorge.multi_1: In this category I can offer you a Norseman doll, an abacus, a key of numerous locks, a friendship amulet, a mexcalibur sword, an orc shredder, a frozen heart, a phoenix statue, a dragon eye and a noble sword. Or: ...
npc.jorge.multi_2: A hand puppet, a music box, an encyclopedia, a Durin doll, a medusa skull, a newspaper, a bag of spices or an Exhiti imortus. ...
npc.jorge.multi_3: A mathmaster shield, a draken doll, an emblem, a crimson doll, an old radio, a bookworm doll, a golden falcon and an assassin doll. ...
npc.jorge.multi_4: A dragon goblet, a pigeon trophy, a loremaster doll and a jade amulet. ...
npc.jorge.multi_5: All listed souvenirs are at 20 silver raid tokens each. Which one of them do you want?
npc.jorge.say_1: You just swapped 20 silver raid tokens for 1 {}.
npc.jorge.say_2: I'm sorry, I need at least 20 silver tokens for that. Please come back when you have them.
npc.julius.greet_msg_1: Be greeted, adventurer |PLAYERNAME|. I assume you have read the {note} about the {vampire} threat in this city.
npc.julius.greet_msg_2: Be greeted, adventurer |PLAYERNAME|. Please excuse me if I appear {distracted}!
npc.julius.multi_1: Here is the map. When you are standing near a remarkable spot, use it to mark that spot on the map. Don't forget, come back with at least five marks! ...
npc.julius.multi_10: You know, I came to think that the spell didn't work because there is another, greater power behind all of this. I fear that if we don't find the source of the vampire threat we can't defeat them. ...
npc.julius.multi_11: I heard that there is an island not far from here. Unholy and fearsome things are said to happen there, and maybe that means vampires are not far away. ...
npc.julius.multi_12: I want you to try and convince someone with a boat to bring you to this island, Vengoth. I'll give you an empty map. Please map the area for me and pay special attention to unusual spots. ...
npc.julius.multi_13: Mark them on my map and come back once you have found at least five remarkable places on Vengoth. Can you do that for me?
npc.julius.multi_14: Listen, I thought of something. If we could somehow figure out who among those five is their leader and manage to defeat him,the others might give up too. ...
npc.julius.multi_15: Without their leader they will at least be much weaker. Before I explain my plan, do you think you could do that?
npc.julius.multi_2: Also, they say there is a castle on this island. That mark HAS to be included, it's far too important to leave it out. Good luck!
npc.julius.multi_3: Great, now here's my plan. As I said, my strength lies not on the battlefield, but it's theory and knowledge. While you were distributing cookies I developed a spell. ...
npc.julius.multi_4: This spell is designed to reveal the identity of the master vampire and force him to show his true face. It is even likely that it instantly defeats him. ...
npc.julius.multi_5: I want you to go to the five vampires you detected and try out the magic formula on them. One of them - the oldest and most powerful - will react to it, I'm sure of it. The words are: '{Alori Mort}'. Please repeat them.
npc.julius.multi_6: As I already told you, anyone in this city could really be a vampire, even the most unsuspicious citizen. I want you to find that brood. ...
npc.julius.multi_7: You can possibly identify the vampires by using a trick with hidden garlic, but better put it into something unsuspicious, like... cookies maybe! ...
npc.julius.multi_8: Just bake a few by using holy water on flour, then use that holy water dough on garlic, use the garlic dough on a baking tray and finally place the tray on an oven. Then just play little girl scout and distribute some cookies to the citizens. ...
npc.julius.multi_9: Watch their reaction! If it's suspicious, write down the name and let me know. Then we'll work something out against them. Agreed?
npc.julius.say_1: Our nightly blood-sucking visitors put the inhabitants of Yalahar in constant danger. The worst thing is that anyone in this city could be a vampire. Maybe an outsider like you could help us. Would you try?
npc.julius.say_10: Fine then. Talk to me again about your mission once you have the garlic bread. You can get holy water from a member of the inquisition.
npc.julius.say_11: Fine. Good luck! Talk to me again about your mission once you have confirmed the names of five suspects.
npc.julius.say_12: Alright, wait a moment. Tell me one name at a time so I can note them down carefully. Who is a suspect?
npc.julius.say_13: Well, you need to mix flour with holy water and use that dough on garlic to create a special dough. Bake it like normal bread, but I guarantee that no vampire can eat that. Are you following me?
npc.julius.say_14: I guess Armenius, Lisander, Maris, Ortheus and Serafin are all the names we can get for now. Let me think for a moment what we are going to do, talk to me about your mission again later.
npc.julius.say_15: No, no, I was asking for one of the names.
npc.julius.say_16: Very well. I think I can trust you now. Sorry that I had to put you through this embarassing procedure, but I'm sure you understand. So, are you ready for your first real task?
npc.julius.say_17: No, no, you didn't eat it! Vampire Brood! Say '{aaah}' once you have eaten the bread or get out of her instantly!
npc.julius.say_18: He really doesn't look like the man of the sea he pretends to be, does he? Noted down! Any other name?
npc.julius.say_19: You already reported that name. Any new ones?
npc.julius.say_2: Hmm, I see, I see. That necklace is only a small indication though... I think I need another proof, just to make sure. Say... have you ever baked {garlic bread}?
npc.julius.say_20: Hm. You don't look so sure about that one. You should not report suspects that you did not confirm yourself! Any others?
npc.julius.say_21: I always thought that there is not really a poor beggar hidden under those ragged clothes. Noted down! Any other name?
npc.julius.say_22: You already reported that name. Any new ones?
npc.julius.say_23: Hm. You don't look so sure about that one. You should not report suspects that you did not confirm yourself! Any others?
npc.julius.say_24: Nice angelic name for a vampire. But he didn't escape your attention, well done. Noted down! Any other name?
npc.julius.say_25: You already reported that name. Any new ones?
npc.julius.say_26: Hm. You don't look so sure about that one. You should not report suspects that you did not confirm yourself! Any others?
npc.julius.say_27: Yes, that pale skin and those black eyes speak volumes. Noted down! Any other name?
npc.julius.say_28: You already reported that name. Any new ones?
npc.julius.say_29: Hm. You don't look so sure about that one. You should not report suspects that you did not confirm yourself! Any others?
npc.julius.say_3: I fear that will not do. Sorry.
npc.julius.say_30: Ahh, I always thought something was suspicious about him. Noted down! Any other name?
npc.julius.say_31: You already reported that name. Any new ones?
npc.julius.say_32: Hm. You don't look so sure about that one. You should not report suspects that you did not confirm yourself! Any others?
npc.julius.say_34: Hm. You don't look so sure about that one. You should not report suspects that you did not confirm yourself! Any others?
npc.julius.say_35: Good. Don't play around with the spell, only use it when standing in front of those vampires. Come back and report to me about your progress later.
npc.julius.say_36: I see... so Armenius is the master, and the spell didn't even cause a scratch on him... Well, that went worse than expected. Let me think for a moment and then ask me about a mission again.
npc.julius.say_4: I fear that will not do. Sorry.
npc.julius.say_5: Let me check - yes indeed, there's garlic in it. Now eat one, in front of my eyes. Right now! Say '{aaah}' when you've chewed it all down so that I can see you're not hiding it!
npc.julius.say_6: So, are you ready for your first real task?
npc.julius.say_7: Are you back with confirmed names of possible vampires?
npc.julius.say_8: Oh! You look horrible - I mean, rather weary. What happened? Who is the master vampire?
npc.julius.say_9: Well, there's one problem. How would I know I can trust you? You might be one of them... hm. Can you think of something really unlikely for a vampire? If you know a way to prove it to me, ask me about your {mission}.
npc.julius.sendtrade_msg_1: I'll reward you for every pair of vampire teeth you bring me.
npc.julius.stdmod_1: I come from a family of {vampire} hunters, but to be honest, I'm more into the theoretic part and strategic planning.
npc.julius.stdmod_2: A better name would be Gomorrah, if you ask me.
npc.julius.stdmod_4: Storkus? Oh yes, I know him. A long time ago we used to hunt together... sometimes.
npc.julius.stdmod_5: It's about time you showed the vampires that they should never bother the citizens again.
npc.julius.stdmod_6: Another vampire raid last night. But then again, that's nothing new.
npc.julius.stdmod_7: Well, I should be the one to thank you I guess.
npc.junkar_mines.greet_msg_1: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! You are lucky that the service is running right now. Save your coal for the days to come though!
npc.junkar_mines.stdmod_1: So much to do. So many things to be fixed.
npc.junkar_mines.voice_1: So much to do. So many things to be fixed.

npc.kais.greet_msg_1: Hmm... surely you are in need of {help} - will you let me? I am {Kais} the Bound and I can lend you a hand in {healing} your body and soul or even grant an {enhanced} blessing!
npc.kais.keyword_1: So receive the blood of the mountain, master.
npc.kais.stdmod_1: I have the power to grant you the blood of the mountain's blessing. But I must ask of you to sacrifice |BLESSCOST| gold. Are you prepared for that?
npc.kais.stdmod_10: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.kais.stdmod_11: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.kais.stdmod_12: Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
npc.kais.stdmod_2: So receive the blood of the mountain, master.
npc.kais.stdmod_3: Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.kais.stdmod_4: You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.kais.stdmod_5: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.kais.stdmod_6: I am Kais, Kais the Bound. Eternally {fixed} to the wretched place, unless... unless I prove my worth in aiding all those who seek my {help}.
npc.kais.stdmod_7: Well, as I am quite in a fix currently, my only hope to escape this situation may be to grant you {healing} or an {enhanced} blessing if you wish. You must desire SOMETHING, right? Sure you do.
npc.kais.stdmod_8: Besides the {enhanced} blessing available from me, I know of one other, granted by a solitary {nomad} far west of Svargrond. There are also five different other blessings available, each in a sacred place. ...\nThese blessings are: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}.
npc.kais.stdmod_9: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.kallimae.say_1: Some residents are in need of ingredients to finish a ritual. You can help?
npc.kallimae.say_2: Search for the NPCs Yonan, Narsai, Shimun and Tefrit.
npc.kallimae.say_4: Did you help some residents with ingredients?
npc.kallimae.say_5: Thanks. I need you to go to 4 places indicated by Goddess Bastesh.
npc.kallimae.say_7: Did you check all the points and bring the Symbol of Sun and Sea?
npc.karith.greet_1: Hello! Tell me what's on your mind. Time is money.
npc.karith.greet_msg_1: Hello! Tell me what's on your mind. Time is money.
npc.karith.greet_msg_2: Hello! Tell me what's on your mind. Time is money.
npc.karith.multi_1: The evergreen flower pots are an amusing item that might find some customers here. Do you want a passage to Carlin for 185 gold?
npc.karith.multi_10: A city full of mad death worshippers, no thanks. Or did you find something interesting there?
npc.karith.multi_11: Another port full of smelly humans, fittingly located in a swamp. Or did you find something interesting there?
npc.karith.multi_12: Of course it is merely superstition that the darashian sand wasp honey brings back youth and vitality, but as long people pay a decent price, I couldn't care less. Do you want a passage to Darashia for 210 gold?
npc.karith.multi_13: From all what I have heard, it is an unremarkable pile of huts in the desert. Or did you find something interesting there?
npc.karith.multi_14: Do you want a passage to Ab'Dendriel for 160 gold?
npc.karith.multi_15: I've never been there. I doubt the elves there came up with something noteworthy. Or did you find something interesting there?
npc.karith.multi_16: For the sake of profit, we established ship routes to {Ab'Dendriel}, {Darashia}, {Venore}, {Ankrahmun}, {Port Hope}, {Thais}, {Liberty Bay} and {Carlin}.
npc.karith.multi_17: I see no reason to establish ship routes to other cities. There is nothing that would be worth the effort. ...
npc.karith.multi_18: But since you won't stop bugging me, let's make a deal: If you can prove that at least five of your so-called 'cities' are not worthless, I might reconsider my position. ...
npc.karith.multi_19: Bring me something SPECIAL! The local bar tenders usually know what's interesting about their city.
npc.karith.multi_2: An unremarkable town compared to the wonders of Yalahar. Or did you find something interesting there?
npc.karith.multi_3: Do you want a passage to Liberty Bay for 275 gold?
npc.karith.multi_4: Which sane captain would sail his ship to a pirate town? Or did you find something interesting there?
npc.karith.multi_5: Astonishing enough the royal satin seems to suit the exquisite taste of the Yalahari. Do you want a passage to Thais for 200 gold?
npc.karith.multi_6: Thais must be a hell hole if only half of the stories we hear about it are true. Or did you find something interesting there?
npc.karith.multi_7: Ivory is highly prized by the artisans of the Yalahari. Do you want a passage to Port Hope for 260 gold?
npc.karith.multi_8: Another pointless human settlement. Or did you find something interesting there?
npc.karith.multi_9: The Yalahari seem to be obsessed with conserving their dead, so I guess the embalming fluid will be a great success in Yalahar. Do you want a passage to Ankrahmun for 230 gold?
npc.karith.say_1: The swamp spice will turn out very lucrative considering that it helps to make even the most disgusting dish taste good. Do you want a passage to Venore for 185 gold?
npc.karith.say_2: What's that? Bug milk? Hm, perhaps I can find some customers for that!
npc.karith.say_3: Sand wasp honey? Hm, interesting at least!
npc.karith.say_4: Some special spice might be of value indeed.
npc.karith.say_5: I can hardly imagine that someone is interested in embalming fluid, but I'll give it a try.
npc.karith.say_6: Of course! Ivory! Its value is quite obvious.
npc.karith.say_7: This royal satin is indeed of acceptable quality.
npc.karith.say_8: I doubt that the esteemed Yalahari will indulge into something profane as rum. But who knows, I'll give it a try.
npc.karith.say_9: I doubt that these flowers will stay fresh and healthy forever. But if they do, they could be indeed valuable.
npc.karith.stdmod_1: This weather is killing me. If I only had enough money to retire.
npc.karith.stdmod_2: I am the captain of this ship.
npc.karith.stdmod_3: I am the captain of this ship.
npc.karith.stdmod_4: I'm Karith. I don't belong to a caste any longer, and only serve the Yalahari.
npc.karith.voice_1: This weather is killing me. If I only had enough money to retire.
npc.karl.farewell_msg_1: Please come back, but don't tell others.
npc.karl.greet_msg_1: Pshhhht! Not that loud ... but welcome.
npc.karl.say_1: Do you bring me a barrel of beer??
npc.karl.say_2: Do you want to buy a bottle of our finest whisper beer for 80 gold?
npc.karl.say_4: You don't have any barrel of beer!
npc.karl.say_5: Here. Don't take it into the city though.
npc.karl.walkaway_msg_1: Please come back, but don't tell others.
npc.kasmir.greet_msg_1: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
npc.kasmir.keyword_1: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_1: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_11: I think you have forgotten to bring your stake, pilgrim.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_12: Yes, I was informed what to do. Are you prepared to receive my line of the prayer?
npc.kasmir.stdmod_13: So receive my prayer: 'Let there be honour and humility'. Now, bring your stake to Rahkem in Ankrahmun for the next line of the prayer. I will inform him what to do.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_15: You should visit Rahkem in Ankrahmun now, pilgrim.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_16: You already received my line of the prayer.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_17: A blessed stake? That is a strange request. Maybe Quentin knows more, he is one of the oldest monks after all.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_18: You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_19: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_2: Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_20: Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_21: There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_22: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_23: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_24: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_25: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_26: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_27: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_28: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_29: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_30: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.kasmir.stdmod_32:
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
npc.kasmir.stdmod_4: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?

npc.kawill.stdmod_13: Ah, a weapon to be feared by man, beast and god alike, jawoll. He who wields it will be both blessed and cursed at the same time.
npc.kawill.stdmod_14: The day will come when he finally bites the dust.
npc.kawill.stdmod_15: By using the powers of fire and earth we forced the river that once wound its way through the big old one in other directions, and created our home.

npc.kawill.stdmod_19: I fear the sorcerers focus on the destructive forces of fire. They forget about the protection earth could provide.
npc.kawill.stdmod_2: So receive the blessing of the life-giving earth, pilgrim.
npc.kawill.stdmod_20: He is a jolly fellow and one of the oldest dwarves alive.
npc.kawill.stdmod_21: He is a fine smith and his armour may save your neck one day.
npc.kawill.stdmod_22: She is a fine cook, jawoll.
npc.kawill.stdmod_23: Uzgod is a blacksmith and understands the ways of his element well.
npc.kawill.stdmod_24: The emperor has rarely visited the temple district in the last years. He should care more about spirituality then about politics. Jawoll.
npc.kawill.stdmod_25: The emperor has rarely visited the temple district in the last years. He should care more about spirituality then about politics. Jawoll.
npc.kawill.stdmod_26: The celestial paladin, the protector of our race. The only divine being we care for and the only one who still cares for dwarfs.
npc.kawill.stdmod_27: Where earth is giving, fire is taking. That is the way of the elements.
npc.kawill.stdmod_28: The lifegiving earth protects us, feeds us and takes us home after death.
npc.kawill.stdmod_29: The mountain we live in is called the big old one. It's the mountain of mountains, and it isand like a friend and protector to our race.
npc.kawill.stdmod_3: Ok. If you don't want it...
npc.kawill.stdmod_4: The gods are treacherous and vain. They want to use us like they did in the past. Only the elements can be trusted, because all they want is for nature to run its set course.
npc.kawill.stdmod_5: I am the great geomancer of dwarvenkind.
npc.kawill.stdmod_6: We investigate the will of the earth. It is our duty to make sure things to work in their natural way.
npc.kawill.stdmod_7: Life is born by earth and fed by earth.
npc.kawill.stdmod_8: I am Kawill Marbleeye, Son of Earth, from the Molten Rock.
npc.kawill.stdmod_9: There's nothing I need, better ask others.

npc.kazzan.multi_2: He knows many things about the djinn race and he may have some hints for you.
npc.kazzan.multi_3: Alright. The problem is that I want to know at least one of them on my side. You never know. I don't mind if it's the evil Efreet or the Marid. ...
npc.kazzan.multi_4: Your mission will be to visit one kind of the djinns and bring them a peace-offering. Are you interested in that mission?

npc.kazzan.say_3: Do you know the location of the djinn fortresses in the mountains south of here?
npc.kazzan.say_4: Well, I don't blame you for that. I am sure you did your best. Now we can just hope that peace remains. Here, take this small gratification for your effort to help and Daraman may bless you!

npc.kevin.say_1: You are not a member of our guild yet! We have high standards for our members. To rise in our guild is a difficult but rewarding task. Are you interested in joining?
npc.kevin.say_10: Fine, fine. I think that should do it. Tell Hugo that we order those uniforms. The completed dress pattern will soon arrive in Venore. Report to me when you have talked to him.
npc.kevin.say_11: So Waldo is dead? This is grave news indeed. Did you recover his posthorn?
npc.kevin.say_12: You did it? I hope you did not catch a flu in the cold! Anyway, there's another mission for you. Are you interested?
npc.kevin.say_13: You have delivered that letter? You are a true postofficer. All over the land bards shallpraise your name. There are no missions for you left right now.
npc.kevin.say_14: There are no missions for you left right now. You already have the title of Archpostman.
npc.kevin.say_15: There are no missions for you left right now. But you are worthy indeed. Do you want to advance in our guild?
npc.kevin.say_16: So are you ready for another mission?
npc.kevin.say_17: So are you ready for another mission?
npc.kevin.say_18: So are you ready for another mission?
npc.kevin.say_19: Excellent! Another job well done! Would you accept another mission?
npc.kevin.say_2: So you have finally made it! I did not think that you would have it in you ... However: are you ready for another assignment?
npc.kevin.say_20: Excellent! Another job well done! Would you accept another mission?
npc.kevin.say_21: You have made it! We have enough bones for the fund! You remind me of myself when I was young! Interested in another mission?
npc.kevin.say_22: You have made it! We have enough bones for the fund! You remind me of myself when I was young! Interested in another mission?
npc.kevin.say_23: You truly got him? Quite impressive. You are a very promising candidate! I think I have another mission for you. Are you interested?
npc.kevin.say_24: So are you ready for another mission?
npc.kevin.say_25: So are you ready for another mission?
npc.kevin.say_26: Oh yes, where did we get that from ...? Let's see, first ask the great technomancer in Kazordoon for the technical details. Return here afterwards.
npc.kevin.say_27: The mail with Talphion's instructions just arived. I remember we asked Queen Eloise of Carlin for the perfect colours. Go there, ask her about the UNIFORMS and report back here.
npc.kevin.say_28: The queen has sent me the samples we needed. The next part is tricky. We need theuniforms to emanate some odor that dogs hate.The dog with the best 'taste' in that field is Noodles,the dog of King Tibianus. Do you understand so far?
npc.kevin.say_29: Fine, fine. I think that should do it. Tell Hugo that we order those uniforms. The completed dress pattern will soon arrive in Venore. Report to me when you have talked to him.
npc.kevin.say_3: Excellent, you got it fixed! This will teach this mailbox a lesson indeed! Are you interested in another assignment?
npc.kevin.say_30: You are worthy indeed. Do you want to advance in our guild?
npc.kevin.say_31: You are worthy indeed. Do you want to advance in our guild?
npc.kevin.say_32: You are worthy indeed. Do you want to advance in our guild?
npc.kevin.say_33: You are worthy indeed. Do you want to advance in our guild?
npc.kevin.say_34: Hm, I might consider your proposal, but first you will have to prove your worth by doing some tasks for us. Are you willing to do that?
npc.kevin.say_35: Excellent! Your first task will be quite simple. But you should better write my instructions down anyways. You can read and write?
npc.kevin.say_36: So listen, you will check certain tours our members have to take to see if there is some trouble. First travel with Captain Bluebear's ship from Thais to Carlin, understood?
npc.kevin.say_37: Excellent! Once you have done that you will travel with Uzon to Edron. You will find him in the Femor Hills. Understood?
npc.kevin.say_38: Fine, fine! Next, travel with Captain Seahorse to the city of Venore. Understood?
npc.kevin.say_39: Good! Finally, find the technomancer Brodrosch and travel with him to the Isle of Cormaya. After this passage report back to me here. Understood?
npc.kevin.say_4: You truly got him? Quite impressive. You are a very promising candidate! I think I have another mission for you. Are you interested?
npc.kevin.say_40: Ok, remember: the Tibian mail service puts trust in you! Don't fail and report back soon. Just tell me about your {mission}.
npc.kevin.say_41: I am glad to hear that. One of our mailboxes was reported to be jammed. It is located on the so called 'mountain' on theisle Folda. Get a crowbar and fix the mailbox. Report about your mission when you have done so.
npc.kevin.say_42: For your noble deeds I grant you the title Assistant Postofficer. All Postofficers will charge you less money from now on. After every second mission ask me for an ADVANCEMENT. Your next task will be a bit more challenging. Do you feel ready for it?
npc.kevin.say_43: I need you to deliver a bill to the stage magician David Brassacres. He's hiding from his creditors somewhere in Venore. It's likely you will have to trick him somehow to reveal his identity. Report back when you delivered this bill.
npc.kevin.say_44: Ok, listen: we have some serious trouble with agressive dogs lately. We have accumulated some bones as a sort of pacifier but we need more. Collect 20 bones like the one in my room to the left and report here.
npc.kevin.say_45: You have collected all the 20 bones needed. Excellent! Now let's talk about further missions if you are interested.
npc.kevin.say_47: I grant you the title of postman. You are now a full member of our guild. Here have your own officers hat and wear it with pride.
npc.kevin.say_48: Since I am convinced I can trust you, this time you must deliver a valuable present to Dermot on Fibula. Do NOT open it!!! You will find the present behind the door here on the lower right side of this room.
npc.kevin.say_49: Ok. We need a new set of uniforms, and only the best will do for us. Please travel to Venore and negotiate with Hugo Chief acontract for new uniforms.
npc.kevin.say_5: Do you bring all bones for our officers' safety fund at once?
npc.kevin.say_50: Good. Go there and find out what taste he dislikes most: mouldy cheese, a piece of fur or abananaskin. Tell him to SNIFF, then the object. Show him the object and ask 'Do you like that?'.DONT let the guards know what you are doing.
npc.kevin.say_51: Good, so listen. Hugo Chief informed me that he needs the measurements of our postofficers. Go and bring me the measurements of Ben, Lokur, Dove, Liane, Chrystal and Olrik.
npc.kevin.say_52: From now on it shall be known that you are a grand postman. You are now a privilegedmember until the end of days. Most captains around the world have an agreement with our guild to transport our privileged members, like you, for less gold.
npc.kevin.say_53: Ok but your next assignment might be dangerous. Our Courier Waldo has been missing for a while. I must assume he is dead. Can you follow me so far?
npc.kevin.say_54: Find out about his whereabouts and retrieve him or at least his posthorn. He was looking for a new underground passage that is rumoured to be found underneath the troll-infested Mountain east of Thais.
npc.kevin.say_55: Thank you. We will honour this. Your next mission will be a very special one. Good thing you are a special person as well. Are you ready?
npc.kevin.say_56: From now on you are a grand postman for special operations. You are an honoured member of our guild and earned the privilege of your own post horn. Here, take it.
npc.kevin.say_57: So listen well. Behind the lower left door you will find a bag. The letters in the bag are for none other than Santa Claus! Deliver them to his house on the isle of Vega, {use} thebag on his mailbox and report back here.
npc.kevin.say_58: Excellent. Here is a letter for you to deliver. Well, to be honest, no one else volunteered. It's a letter from the mother of Markwin, the king of Mintwallin. Deliver that letter to him, but note that you will not be welcome there.
npc.kevin.say_59: I grant you the title of Archpostman. You are a legend in our guild. As privilege of your newly aquired status you are allowed to make use of certain mailboxes in dangerous areas. Just look out for them and you'll see.
npc.kevin.say_6: Splendid, I knew we could trust you. I would like to ask for your help in another matter. Are you interested?
npc.kevin.say_60: Your eagerness is a virtue, young one, but first let's talk about advancement
npc.kevin.say_7: Once more you have impressed me! Are you willing to do another job?
npc.kevin.say_8: First you need to complete your current mission.
npc.kevin.say_9: Excellent! Another job well done! Would you accept another mission?

npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_14: Honour the Gods and above all pay your {taxes}.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_15: Please ask a priest about the gods.

npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_18: He is the owner of Frodo's Hut and a faithful tax-payer.

npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_20: He was once my greatest general. Now he is very old and senile so we assigned him to work for the Royal Tibia Mail.

npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_29: Feel free to buy it in our town's fine shops.

npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_30: Ask the royal cook for some food.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_31: That tax collector is the bane of my life. He is so lazy. I bet you haven't payed any taxes at all.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_32: I am the king, so watch what you say!
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_34: Visit the shops of our merchants and craftsmen.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_35: The four major guilds are the knights, the paladins, the druids, and the sorcerers.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_36: Vile monsters, but I must admit they are strong and sometimes even cunning ... in their own bestial way.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_37: The forces of good are hard pressed in these dark times.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_38: We need all strength we can muster to smite evil!
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_4: It is said that he lives on a small island near Edron. Maybe the people there know more about him.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_41: It's the sword of the Kings. If you return this weapon to me I will {reward} you beyond your wildest dreams.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_42: Well, if you want a reward, go on a quest to bring me Excalibug!
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_43: A very competent person. A little nervous but very competent.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_44: This organisation is an essential tool for holding our enemies in check. Its headquarter is located in the bastion in the northwall.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_45: Soon the whole land will be ruled by me once again!
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_46: Harkath Bloodblade is the general of our glorious {army}.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_47: I will call for heroes as soon as the need arises again and then reward them appropriately.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_48: To pay your taxes, visit the royal tax collector.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_5: Awesome! Please pay a visit to www.otserv.com.br!
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_50: Our enemies are numerous. The evil minotaurs, Ferumbras, and the renegade city of Carlin to the north are just some of them.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_51: They dare to reject my reign over the whole continent!
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_52: Our beloved city has some fine shops, guildhouses and a modern sewerage system.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_54: The paladins are great protectors for Thais.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_55: The brave knights are necessary for human survival in Thais.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_56: The magic of the sorcerers is a powerful tool to smite our enemies.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_6: Baah is awesome dude that rewrote my outfit script.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_7: I am your sovereign, King Tibianus III, and it's my duty to uphold {justice} and provide guidance for my subjects.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_8: I try my best to be just and fair to our citizens. The army and the {TBI} are a great help in fulfilling this duty.
npc.king_tibianus.stdmod_9: Preposterous! You must know the name of your own King!
npc.kjesse.greet_msg_1: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
npc.kjesse.keyword_1: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.kjesse.stdmod_1: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.kjesse.stdmod_11: You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.kjesse.stdmod_12: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.kjesse.stdmod_13: Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.kjesse.stdmod_14: There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.kjesse.stdmod_15: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.kjesse.stdmod_16: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.kjesse.stdmod_17: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.kjesse.stdmod_18: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.kjesse.stdmod_19: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.

npc.kjesse.stdmod_22: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.kjesse.stdmod_23: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.

npc.klaus.farewell_msg_1: Whenever your throat is dry, you know where to find my tavern.
npc.klaus.say_1: Hmm, you look like a seasoned seadog. Kill Captain Ray Striker, bring me his lucky pillow as a proof and you are our hero!
npc.klaus.say_3: You DID it!!! Incredible! Boys, lets have a PAAAAAARTY!!!!
npc.klaus.say_4: Come back when you have his lucky pillow.
npc.klom_stonecutter.greet_msg_1: [EN] Greetings. A warning straight ahead: I don't like loiterin'. If you're not here to {help} us, you're here to waste my time. Which I consider loiterin'. Now, try and prove your {worth} to our alliance. ...

npc.klom_stonecutter.multi_10: Prepared to get rid of some seriously foul creepers for us?

npc.klom_stonecutter.say_26: Alright, good. Those things are strolling about and I ain't gonna have that. If it moves more than two legs, destroy it. If it moves legs and tentacles, destroy it again.

npc.klom_stonecutter.stdmod_1: Well, the biggest problem we need to address are the ever charging {subterraneans} around here. And on top of that, there's the threat of the Lost, who quite made themselves at {home} in these parts.
npc.klom_stonecutter.stdmod_10: Well, the biggest problem we need to address are the ever charging {subterraneans} around here. And on top of that, there's the threat of the Lost, who quite made themselves at {home} in these parts.
npc.klom_stonecutter.stdmod_11: Maintainin' this whole operation, the dwarven involvement 'course. Don't know about them gnomes but if I ain't gettin' those dwarves in line, there'll be chaos down here. I also oversee the {defences} and {counterattacks}.
npc.klom_stonecutter.stdmod_7:
The attacks of the enemy forces are fierce but we hold our ground. ...  \z
	I'd love to face one of their generals in combat but as their masters they cowardly hide far behind enemy lines and I have other duties to fulfil. ...  \z
	I envy you for the chance to thrust into the heart of the enemy, locking weapons with their jaws... or whatever... and see the fear in their eyes when they recognise they were bested.
npc.klom_stonecutter.stdmod_8:
I welcome a fine battle as any dwarf worth his beard should do. As long as it's a battle against something I can hit with my trusty axe. ... \z
	But here the true {enemy} eludes us. We fight wave after wave of their lackeys and if the gnomes are right the true enemy is up to something far more sinister.
npc.klom_stonecutter.stdmod_9:
I have no idea what kind of creeps are behind all this. Even the gnomes don't and they have handled that stuff way more often. ... \z
	But even if we knew nothing more about them, the fact alone that they employ the help of those mockeries of all things dwarfish, marks them as an enemy of the dwarves and it's our obligation to annihilate them.
npc.kroox.greet_msg_1: Welcome to Kroox Quality Armor, |PLAYERNAME|! Wanna take a look, ask me for a trade.
npc.kroox.multi_1: Oh, so its you, he wrote me about? Sadly I have no dwarven armor in stock. But I give you the permission to retrive one from the mines. ...
npc.kroox.multi_2: The problem is, some giant spiders made the tunnels where the storage is their new home. Good luck.
npc.kroox.say_1: Hm, well I guess its ok to tell you ... <tells you about Lokurs measurements>
npc.kulag_the_guard.say_1: You adventurers become more and more of a pest.
npc.kulag_the_guard.say_2: They should throw you all into jail instead of giving you all those quests and rewards an honest watchman can only dream about.
npc.kulag_the_guard.stdmod_1: It's my duty to protect the city.
npc.lailene.greet_msg_1: What do you want in my magical robe store? I doubt I have anything that's of interest to you.
npc.lailene.stdmod_1: ... what?! Uh - no, no. Of course I wouldn't have anything to do with... them.
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.greet_msg_1: Since you are obviously not one of my relatives who pays me a long overdue visit, we should get {work} right away. We'll see if you can prove your {worth} to our alliance.
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_1: I can't explain that stuff, even the gnomes don't know what grows in those caves. All we know is that this stuff brought about all the diremaws we are now facing. ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_10: We built an iron fence around it and added a mechanism to quickly get barrel if need be. Then an... accident happened to our guard down there and ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_11: [EN] Well, to make a long story short, the barrels are unguarded right now and the diremaws are now too numerous and we are in desperate need of volunteers. ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_12: [EN] We need someone to take those barrels to the source of the ever growing sponge and burn it down. All of it. There should be at least five locations. Are you up for that?
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_13: The gnomes say that these creatures seem to thrive on mushroom sponges. But not only that, apparently they also lay eggs in their own cadavers to breed even faster. ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_14: [EN] Yes, disgusting. I guess it provides everything their offspring needs... well, we probably shouldn't go into that much further. Instead we should focus on preventing that from happening. ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_15: [EN] If I understood that correctly, the gnomes 'grew' a device to completely neutralise diremaw corpses. Acting as a very effective counter measure. ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_16: [EN] A lot of corpses are lying around wherever these creatures are being hunted. Now all we need are, you guessed it, volunteers to clean up as many of those remains as possible ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_18: The gnomes say that these creatures seem to thrive on mushroom sponges. But not only that, apparently they also lay eggs in their own cadavers to breed even faster. ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_19: [EN] Yes, disgusting. I guess it provides everything their offspring needs... well, we probably shouldn't go into that much further. Instead we should focus on preventing that from happening. ...
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.multi_2: This vermin is somehow attracted to this sponge, my guess is they use it as a nourishment, too. We need to get rid of the stuff regularly to reduce their numbers to a manageable level. ...

npc.lardoc_bashsmite.stdmod_1: Here's the situation: a tide of hazardous bugs, the gnomes named them {diremaws}, threatens our base. Then there is some kind of {growth} which seems connected to them somehow. We need to get rid of both.
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.stdmod_2: Bashsmite. That's all you need to know.
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.stdmod_3:
You're already known amongst the gnomes, member of the Bigfoot Brigade. I will make sure that the alliance learns of your deeds but you'll still need to help the dwarves and gnomes of this outpost to show your worth. ... \z
	We also found suspicious devices carried by all kinds of creatures down here. Down here, they are of extreme worth to us since they could contain the key to what's happening all around us. ...  \z
	If you can aquire any, return them to me and I make sure to tell the others of your generosity. Return to me afterwards to check on your current {status}.
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.stdmod_4:
