npc.sebastian_nargor.stdmod_1: Do you want to sail {0} for {1}?
npc.sebastian_nargor.stdmod_2: We would like to serve you some time.
npc.sebastian_nargor.stdmod_3: Where do you want to go? To {Liberty bay} or to {Meriana}?
npc.sebastian_nargor.stdmod_4: I am the captain of this ship.
npc.sebastian_nargor.stdmod_5: I am the captain of this ship.
npc.ser_tybald.greet_msg_1: Welcome, child. Have you come to learn about {magic}? Then you are in the right place. I can teach you many useful {spells}.
npc.ser_tybald.say_1: Spells are very useful in combat - not only for mages, though of course we particularly rely on them for much of our damage output. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_10: Ah, the beauty of our world! It is vast and extraordinarily diverse. Strange islands, beautiful cities and fierce monsters that roam the wildernesses. Mysteries, adventures, danger around every corner. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_11: Once you have reached level 8, you are ready to choose a vocation and go to the Tibian Mainland.
npc.ser_tybald.say_12: Your choice of vocation will determine your life in Tibia, and the skills and fighting techniques you may use. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_13: There are four vocation: knight, druid, paladin and sorcerer. If you want to know more about them, talk to Oressa in the temple. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_14: I myself teach try-out spells for both the magical classes, whereas Tybald in the next room specialises in knight and paladin spells.
npc.ser_tybald.say_15: A very intelligent girl. Prefers to listen to wild animals' noises instead of humans', which is quite understandable when you think about it. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_16: However, she's also a very apt healer and can give you advice on your choice of vocation.
npc.ser_tybald.say_2: There's a broad variety of what spells can do, as you will see as you progress further. The next spells you can buy with level 8 and on. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_3: Some attack spells can be directed at a single target while others affect an area, having an effect either over time or instantaneous. Even other spells protect you, or can be used to create runes. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_4: Each vocation has its own individual spells that none of the other vocations can use. You can only learn spells at a spell trainer of your vocation. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_5: The spells here on Dawnport are for trying out only, and you will forget them once you choose your definite vocation and leave for the Mainland. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_6: There, you can go to a spell teacher in a city to permanently learn a spell.
npc.ser_tybald.say_7: The Mainland offers many more adventures, dangers and quests than this small isle, and also has spell teachers where you can permanently learn a spell for your vocation. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_8: Once you reach level 8 you may choose your definite vocation and leave for Main. Go to a city and seek out the spell trainer of your vocation to learn a spell. And make sure you have enough gold! ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_9: The art of spell teaching is complex and dangerous, and we will only impart our valuable knowledge of a spell to a novice if they can pay the price.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_1: In this category I have '{Lighthealing}', '{Healfriend}', and '{Curepoison}'.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_10: Roughened and toughened by life's tragedies. A good man, but somber.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_11: Yes, child. If you wish to learn a spell, tell me.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_12:
A very headstrong young man, though I appreciate his devotion to the craft of potion-making. \z
		No respect for senior authority or age at all! Except maybe for a little soft spot for Mr Morris.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_13:
A strange young man. He seems driven, to my mind. By what force, I do not know. \z
		I take it the world needs adventurers such as him.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_14:
Redeeming one's soul by becoming a clerk? Not very likely. Once a pirate, always a pirate. \z
		But he's a charming old rogue.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_15:
Not a half bad cook, truly. Must have been that squirrel diet, \z
		it seems to have lead him to discover a new cuisine - everything to forget the bad taste of squirrels, he said.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_16:
He is proficient in the martial arts. A very skilled teacher of spells for knights and paladins. \z
		If that is your vocation, you should talk to Ser Tybald.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_17:
Ah, yes. Travelled with Plunderpurse a lot as I recall. Captain Plunderpurse, then. \z
			Got his head full of numbers and statistics, that boy.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_2:
In this category I have '{Findperson}', '{Magicrope}', '{Levitate}', '{Light}', \z
		'{Greatlight}', '{Haste}', '{Poisonfield}', '{Firefield}', '{Lightmagicmissile}' and '{Energyfield}'.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_4:
I can teach you {healing spells}, {support spells} and {attack spells}. \z
		What kind of spell do you wish to learn?
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_6:
Did you not listen? I am the teacher of druid and sorcerer spells for level 8 to 18. \z
		I teach young adventurers spells they can use once they have the proper vocation - druid or sorcerer.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_7: I have an old friend there. Haven't heard from him in a while.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_8:
Oh, it's not too bad here, believe me. At least I always get young and enthusiast disciples! \z
		Though I must confess I miss the vastness of the Tibian plains. <sighs>
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_9:
A kind old hunter. He loves to see young life around, taking on the ways and lays of the land. \z
		If you have any question, ask Inigo for help.
npc.serafin.greet_msg_1: Welcome to my fruit and vegetable store, |PLAYERNAME|! Ask me for a {trade} if you'd like to see my wares.
npc.serafin.say_1: Oh, no I don't sell cookies. Or, do you mean you'd like to give me one?
npc.serafin.say_2: It'd be better for you to leave now.
npc.serafin.say_3: COUGH?! What kind of a mean trick is that? Get out of my shop!
npc.serafin.stdmod_1: There's something about these words which makes me feel awkward. Or maybe it's you who causes that feeling. You better get lost.
npc.servant_sentry.greet_msg_1: The. Slime. Has. Entered. Our. Master. Has. Left! We. Must. Help.
npc.servant_sentry.say_4: The. {Slime}. Has. Entered. Our. {Master}. Has. Left! We. Must. {Help}.
npc.servant_sentry.say_5: Defeat. {Slime}. We. Will. Why. Did. You. Kill. Us? Do. You. Want. To. Rectify. And. Help?
npc.servant_sentry.say_6: Then. Take. This. Gobbler. Always. Hungry. Eats. Slime. Fungus. Go.
npc.seymour.farewell_1: Good bye, |PLAYERNAME|! And remember: No running up and down in the academy!
npc.seymour.greet_1: Hello, |PLAYERNAME|. Welcome to the Academy of Rookgaard. May I sign you up as a {student}?
npc.seymour.say_1: Have you brought {0} dead rats to me to pick up your reward?
npc.seymour.say_2: Hmmm, let me look at you. You got that intelligent sparkle in your eyes and you'd love to handle great power - that must be a future sorcerer!
npc.seymour.say_3: Hmmm, let me look at you. You have an aura of great wisdom and may have healing hands as well as a sense for the powers of nature - I think you're a natural born druid!
npc.seymour.say_4: Hmmm, let me look at you. You seem to have keen eyes and a steady hand - I bet you'd make an excellent paladin!
npc.seymour.say_5: Hmmm, let me look at you. Strong and sturdy, with a determined look in your eyes - no doubt the knight profession would be suited for you!
npc.seymour.stdmod_1: Newcomers - visit me! I'll answer your questions!
npc.seymour.stdmod_10: Thank you! Here is your reward.
npc.seymour.stdmod_100: Dixi sells and buys {armors}, {shields}, {helmets} and {legs}. You can find her shop south of the academy, just go up the stairs in {Obi}'s shop.
npc.seymour.stdmod_101: A mysterious druid who lives somewhere in the wilderness. He sells small health {potions} just like {Lily}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_102: Lee'Delle's shop is in the western part of town, on the {premium} side. She sells everything cheaper.
npc.seymour.stdmod_103: In the southern part of town, Lily sells {potions} which might come in handy once you are deep in a dungeon and need {health}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_11: HEY! You don't have so many!
npc.seymour.stdmod_12: Go and find some rats to kill!
npc.seymour.stdmod_13: Have you brought a dead rat to me to pick up your reward?
npc.seymour.stdmod_14: Thank you! Here is your reward.
npc.seymour.stdmod_15: HEY! You don't have one! Stop playing tricks on me or I'll give you some extra work!
npc.seymour.stdmod_16: Go and find some rats to kill!
npc.seymour.stdmod_17: Do you have a suitable present box for me?
npc.seymour.stdmod_18: THANK YOU! Here is a helmet that will serve you well.
npc.seymour.stdmod_19: HEY! You don't have one! Stop playing tricks on me or I'll give you some extra work!
npc.seymour.stdmod_2: Get some training in the academy!
npc.seymour.stdmod_20: Well, I would like to send our king a little present but I do not have a suitable box. If you find a nice box, please bring it to me.
npc.seymour.stdmod_21: You are pretty inexperienced. I think killing rats is a suitable challenge for you. For each fresh {dead rat} I will give you two shiny coins of gold.
npc.seymour.stdmod_22: For this remark I will wash your mouth with soap, young lady!
npc.seymour.stdmod_23: For this remark I will wash your mouth with soap, young man!
npc.seymour.stdmod_24: This is an island with {vocation} teachers. You can learn all about the different vocations there once you are level 8.
npc.seymour.stdmod_25: It's |TIME|, so you are late. Hurry!
npc.seymour.stdmod_26: My name is Seymour, but for you I am 'Sir' Seymour.
npc.seymour.stdmod_27: At least you know how to address a man of my importance.
npc.seymour.stdmod_28: I'm the master of this fine {academy}, giving {lessons} to my students.
npc.seymour.stdmod_29: Oh, which lesson did you want to attend again? Was it {Rookgaard}, {fighting}, {equipment}, {citizens}, the {academy} or the {oracle}?
npc.seymour.stdmod_3: Feeling lost? Ask me for help!
npc.seymour.stdmod_30: In a bank you can deposit your earned gold coins safely. Just go downstairs to {Paulie} and ask him to {deposit} your money.
npc.seymour.stdmod_31: Yes, depositing your money will keep it safe, so it is a good idea to store it in the bank. Of course, you can always withdraw it again.
npc.seymour.stdmod_32: Well, the {king} doesn't send troops anymore, the {academy} is dreadfully low on money, and the end of the world is pretty nigh. Apart from that I'm reasonably fine, I suppose.
npc.seymour.stdmod_33: Most of the citizens here are {merchants}. You can give me the name of any non-player character and I will tell you something about him or her.
npc.seymour.stdmod_34: Merchants buy and sell goods. Just ask them for a {trade} to see what they offer or buy from you.
npc.seymour.stdmod_35: Trolls are quite nasty monsters which you shouldn't face before level 3 or 4 depending on your {equipment}. Ask the bridge {guards} for their locations!
npc.seymour.stdmod_36: The guards {Dallheim} and {Zerbrus} protect our village from {monsters} trying to enter. They also mark useful {dungeon} locations on your map.
npc.seymour.stdmod_37: There are four vocations: {knights}, {paladins}, {sorcerers} and {druids}. You can choose your vocation once you are level 8 and have talked to the {oracle}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_38: Sorcerers are talented elemental magicians. You will learn all about them once you are level 8 and reached the Island of {Destiny}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_39: Knights are strong melee fighters. You will learn all about them once you are level 8 and reached the Island of {Destiny}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_4: Gain some knowledge in the academy!
npc.seymour.stdmod_40: Druids are nature magic users and great healers. You will learn all about them once you are level 8 and reached the Island of {Destiny}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_41: Paladins are swift distance fighters. You will learn all about them once you are level 8 and reached the Island of {Destiny}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_42: We have a {weapon} and an {armor} shop south of the academy. {Equipment} such as {ropes} are sold to the north-west. {Potions} can be bought to the south. And then there are the {farms}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_43: The world of Tibia is very large with tons of places to explore. Vast deserts, Caribbean islands, deep jungles, green meadows and jagged mountains await you!
npc.seymour.stdmod_44: The temple is the place to go when you are very low on {health} or poisoned. Ask {Cipfried} for a heal - he usually notices emergencies by himself.
npc.seymour.stdmod_45: Your current health is shown by the red bar on the right side. {Death} awaits you if it goes down to zero.
npc.seymour.stdmod_46: Dying in Tibia is painful, so try to avoid it. You will lose part of your {experience} points and also equipment. Make sure your {health} always stays up!
npc.seymour.stdmod_47: You gain experience when fighting {monsters}. You can take a look at your skill window to check your progress.
npc.seymour.stdmod_48: Good monsters to start hunting are {rats}. They live in the {sewers} below the village.
npc.seymour.stdmod_49: One entrance to the sewers is south of this {academy}. Look for a sewer grate, then use it to climb down.
npc.seymour.stdmod_5: Hello, |PLAYERNAME|. Welcome to the Academy of Rookgaard. May I sign you up as a {student}?
npc.seymour.stdmod_50: The academy is the building you are standing in. We have a {library}, a {bank} and the room of the {oracle}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_51: There are many books in the bookcases around you, unless some naughty kids stole them again. Read them for more and detailed information.
npc.seymour.stdmod_52: Don't go hunting without proper equipment. You need at least a suitable {weapon}, {armor}, {shield}, {rope} and {shovel}. A {torch} is also good as well as {legs}, a {helmet} and {shoes}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_53: Make money by killing {monsters} and picking up their {loot}. You can sell many of the things they carry.
npc.seymour.stdmod_54: Once a monster is dead, you can select 'Open' on the {corpse} to check what's inside. Sometimes they carry {money} or other items which you can sell to {merchants}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_55: You can even sell some corpses! For example, you can sell fresh dead rats to {Tom} the tanner or me. He also buys other dead creatures, just ask him for a {trade}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_56: You definitely need a rope to progress in dungeons, else you might end up stuck. Buy one from {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_57: A shovel is needed to dig some {dungeon} entrances open. 'Use' it on a loose stone pile to make a hole large enough to enter.
npc.seymour.stdmod_58: You should not descend into dungeons without proper {equipment}. Once you are all prepared, ask the bridge {guards} for suitable {monsters}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_59: A torch will provide you with light in dark {dungeons}. 'Use' it to light it. You can buy them from {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_6: Brilliant! We need fine adventurers like you! If you are ready to learn, just ask me for a lesson. You can always ask for the differently coloured words - such as this one - to continue the lesson.
npc.seymour.stdmod_60: Well, I could give you valuable {lessons} or some general {hints} about the game, or a small {quest} if you're interested.
npc.seymour.stdmod_61: The starter armor, a coat, does not protect you well. First of all, earn some money and try to get a sturdy leather armor from {Dixi}'s  or {Lee'Delle}'s shop. Simply ask for a {trade}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_62: The starter weapon, a club, won't get you far. You should earn some {money} and buy a better weapon such as a sabre from {Obi}'s or {Lee'Delle}'s shop. Simply ask for a {trade}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_63: A sturdy leather helmet is a good choice for a beginner. You can either buy it from {Dixi} and {Lee'Delle}, or, once you are strong enough, {loot} them from {trolls}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_64: I fear you have to buy your first shield by yourself. A wooden shield from {Dixi} or {Lee'Delle} is a good choice.
npc.seymour.stdmod_65: Leather boots are basic shoes which will protect you well. You can either buy them from {Dixi} and {Lee'Delle}, or, once you are strong enough, {loot} them from {trolls}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_66: Leather legs might be a good basic protection. You can buy them from {Dixi} or {Lee'Delle}. Or, once you are strong enough, hunt {trolls}. They sometimes carry them in their {loot}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_67: Many monsters, such as rabbits or deer, are excellent food providers. You can also buy food from {Willie} or {Billy}, the farmers.
npc.seymour.stdmod_68: Paying for your Tibia account will turn it into a premium account. This means access to more areas and functions of the game as well as other neat features.
npc.seymour.stdmod_69: Hail to King Tibianus! Long live our king! Not that he cares for an old veteran who is stuck on this godforsaken island...
npc.seymour.stdmod_7: Brilliant! We need fine adventurers like you! If you are ready to learn, just ask me for a lesson. You can always ask for the differently coloured words - such as this one - to continue the lesson.
npc.seymour.stdmod_70: Use a small health potion in case of emergencies to fill up around 75 health points. You can buy them at {Lily}'s shop. She also has {antidote} potions.
npc.seymour.stdmod_71: Some monsters poison you. To heal poison, use an antidote potion on yourself. Buy them at {Lily}'s store.
npc.seymour.stdmod_72: Rookgaard is the name of this {village} as well as of the whole {island}. It belongs to the kingdom of {Thais}, in our world which is called {Tibia}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_73: The island is separated into a {premium} side and a non-premium side. On both sides you will find {dungeons}, but the premium side tends to be a little less crowded with other players.
npc.seymour.stdmod_74: The city of Thais is reigned by King Tibianus. Of course, there are many other cities but you will learn about them later.
npc.seymour.stdmod_75: The most important places in this village are the {temple}, the different {shops}, the {academy} and the {bridges}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_76: There is a bridge to the north and one to the west which lead outside the village. You should only leave once you are well {equipped} and at least level 2.
npc.seymour.stdmod_77: You can leave for mainland once you are level 8. To do so talk to the {oracle}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_78: You have to fight {monsters} to train your {skills} and {level}. If you lose {health}, eat {food} to regain it or use a {potion}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_79: The more you fight with a weapon, the better will be your skill handling this weapon. Don't worry about that right now though, this will become important once you have a {vocation}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_8: Only nonsense on your mind, eh?
npc.seymour.stdmod_80: Once you gained enough experience for a level, you will advance. This means - among other things - more {health} points, a faster walking speed and more strength to carry things.
npc.seymour.stdmod_81: The farms are west of here. You can buy and sell {food} there which you need to regain {health}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_82: To attack a rat, simply click on it in your battle list. Make sure that you have proper {equipment}, though! Also, I give you 2 gold coins for each {dead rat}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_83: I personally don't have anything to trade, but you can ask {merchants} for a trade. That will open a window where you can see their offers and the things they buy from you.
npc.seymour.stdmod_84: Well, I could give you valuable {lessons} or some general {hints} about the game, or a small {quest} if you're interested.
npc.seymour.stdmod_85: Shall I try and take a guess at your destiny?
npc.seymour.stdmod_86: Well, like I told you before, I really think you got that spirit of a sorcerer in you. But of course it's completely up to you!
npc.seymour.stdmod_87: Well, like I told you before, I really think you got that spirit of a druid in you. But of course it's completely up to you!
npc.seymour.stdmod_88: Well, like I told you before, I really think you got that spirit of a paladin in you. But of course it's completely up to you!
npc.seymour.stdmod_89: Well, like I told you before, I really think you got that spirit of a knight in you. But of course it's completely up to you!
npc.seymour.stdmod_9: Good bye, |PLAYERNAME|! And remember: No running up and down in the academy!
npc.seymour.stdmod_90: Obi sells and buys {weapons}. You can find his shop south of the academy.
npc.seymour.stdmod_91: Norma has recently opened a bar here meaning she sells drinks and snacks. Nothing of importance to you, young student.
npc.seymour.stdmod_92: Oh, let's not talk about Loui.
npc.seymour.stdmod_93: A fine and helpful man. Without him, many new adventurers would be quite clueless.
npc.seymour.stdmod_94: This is Tom the tanner's mother. Other than that, I don't think she is of importance.
npc.seymour.stdmod_95: Al Dee has a general {equipment} store in the north-western part of the village. He sells useful stuff such as {ropes}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_96: A traveller from the {main} continent. I wonder what brought her here. No one comes here of his own free will.
npc.seymour.stdmod_97: Billy is {Willie}'s cousin, but he has his farm on the {premium} side of the village.
npc.seymour.stdmod_98: Willie is a fine farmer, although he is short-tempered. He sells and buys {food}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_99: A humble monk living in the {temple} south of here. He can heal you if you are wounded or poisoned.
npc.seymour.voice_1: Newcomers - visit me! I'll answer your questions!
npc.seymour.voice_2: Get some training in the academy!
npc.seymour.voice_3: Feeling lost? Ask me for help!
npc.seymour.voice_4: Gain some knowledge in the academy!
npc.seymour.walkaway_msg_1: Good bye! And remember: No running up and down in the academy!
npc.shanar.voice_1: Fine elven armor and weapons. Have a look.
npc.shanar.voice_2: Looking for protective spells for druids? I can teach you.
npc.shauna.multi_2: I think he was some guy from Darama. Can't remember his name. ...
npc.shauna.multi_3: He was here just for one night, because he got drunk and annoyed our citizens. ...
npc.shauna.multi_4: Obviously he wasn't pleased with this place, because he headed for Thais the next day. ...
npc.shauna.multi_5: Something tells me that he won't stay out of trouble for too long.
npc.shauna.multi_6: Oh, there's a waterpipe in one of my cells? ...
npc.shauna.multi_7: I guess my last {prisoner} forgot it there.
npc.shauna.say_1: What do you think? I am the sheriff of Carlin.
npc.shauna.stdmod_10: The Bonecrusher family is ideally suited for military jobs.
npc.shauna.stdmod_11: If you have a crime to report and clues, then do it, but don't waste my time.
npc.shauna.stdmod_12: If you have a crime to report and clues, then do it, but don't waste my time.
npc.shauna.stdmod_13: If you have a crime to report and clues, then do it, but don't waste my time.
npc.shauna.stdmod_14: If you have a crime to report and clues, then do it, but don't waste my time.
npc.shauna.stdmod_15: The castle is one of the safest places in Carlin.
npc.shauna.stdmod_16: Our people are fine and peaceful.
npc.shauna.stdmod_17: I bet they spy on us... not my business, however.
npc.shauna.stdmod_18: I scared this bigmouth so much that he left the town by night. HO, HO, HO!
npc.shauna.stdmod_19: The city is is a peaceful place, and it's up to me to keep it this way.
npc.shauna.stdmod_20: He is the guy responsible to keep the sewers working. Someone has to do such kind of jobs. I can't handle all the garbage of the city myself.
npc.shauna.stdmod_21: Rowenna is one of our local smiths. When you look for weapons, look for Rowenna.
npc.shauna.stdmod_22: Rowenna is one of our local smiths. When you look for weapons, look for Rowenna.
npc.shauna.stdmod_23: Cornelia is one of our local smiths. When you look for armor, look for Cornelia.
npc.shauna.stdmod_24: Cornelia is one of our local smiths. When you look for armor, look for Cornelia.
npc.shauna.stdmod_25: She has the sharpest eye in the region, I'd say.
npc.shauna.stdmod_26: Her peacefulness is sometimes near stupidity.
npc.shauna.stdmod_28: For me, he's the god of justice.
npc.shauna.stdmod_29: His cult is forbidden in our town.
npc.shauna.stdmod_30: Wouldn't wonder if some males worship him secretly. HO, HO, HO!
npc.shauna.stdmod_31: I deal more with the human mosters, you know? HO, HO, HO!
npc.shauna.stdmod_32: Would certainly make a good butterknife. HO, HO, HO!
npc.shauna.stdmod_33: The only thing that rebels here now and then is the stomach of a male after trying to make illegal alcohol. HO, HO, HO!
npc.shauna.stdmod_34: For obvious reasons it's forbidden in our city.
npc.shauna.stdmod_5: Would you like to buy the general key to the town?
npc.shauna.stdmod_6: Yeah, I bet you'd like to do that! HO, HO, HO!
npc.shauna.stdmod_7: If they make trouble, I'll put them behind bars like all others.
npc.shauna.stdmod_8: If they make trouble, I'll put them behind bars like all others.
npc.shauna.stdmod_9: The Bonecrusher family is ideally suited for military jobs.
npc.sherry_mcronald.farewell_msg_1: Grace our home with another visit soon, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.sherry_mcronald.greet_msg_1: Hello |PLAYERNAME|! Welcome to our humble farm.
npc.sherry_mcronald.voice_1: Isn't this a beautiful day? Perfect for farming.
npc.shiantis.greet_msg_1: Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What can I do for you? If you need adventure equipment, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.shiantis.say_1: Do you want to buy a football for 111 gold?
npc.shiantis.sendtrade_msg_1: Of course, just browse through my wares.
npc.shiantis.voice_1: Containers, decoration and general goods, all here!
npc.shimun.say_1: Could you help me do a ritual?
npc.shimun.say_2: Here is the list with the missing ingredients to complete the ritual.
npc.shimun.say_4: Did you bring all the materials I informed you about?
npc.shimun.say_5: Thank you this stage of the ritual is complete.
npc.shiriel.say_1: Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
npc.shirith.say_1: Do you want to buy a key for 50 gold?
npc.shirtalis_of_the_summer_court.greet_: Hello fighter. I guess you are here to {fight} for our noble {cause}.
npc.shirtalis_of_the_summer_court.say_1: We allow able champions of all races to fight for our cause against the challenges of the {arena}. So are you interested? I'm not interested in fancy'wordplay, so a simple {yes} or {no} will suffice!
npc.shirtalis_of_the_summer_court.say_2: You are now able to enter the teleport.
npc.shirtalis_of_the_summer_court.say_4: This place has always been a site where the champions of summer and winter have clashed in battle. Over the centuries this spectacle has drawn many creatures here to watch, participate and indulge in less savory activities.
npc.shoddy_beggar.greet_msg_1: What do you want? Listen to the old madman? If you have nothing to spare, leave me alone.
npc.shoddy_beggar.no_money_pre: Is that all you have? That would be less than I have... *mumbles*
npc.shoddy_beggar.no_money_quest: Mh, it seems you don't have any coins.
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_1: Hmm, if you can spare a coin... we can talk. What do you say?
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_10: Pah!! You have NO idea, leave me alone now.
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_11: Right... I'm glad everything was destroyed. I don't even know why I kept the remaining copy of the plans all those years... oh, did I say this aloud?
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_12: Yes, well... I do have one remaining copy of the plans. I will keep them as a... reminder. Such ill-fated devices only cause trouble and despair. Mankind would be better off, without them, right?
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_13: Ah, you think you are wise but you know nothing, nothing about science, nothing about the opportunities it offers... You will never understand scientists like me.
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_14: Well, to be honest, I envy him a little. He can continue his research in his laboratory. He still has working equipment... I sometimes read his publications. He is an able man, but completely on the wrong track... give these plans to him.
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_15: Mean, heartless... go and leave me be.
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_19: Yes and I, I... you mean what? Can't imagine? Well, then there is no purpose to continue telling you this story.
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_2: Persistent little nuisance, aren't we? Well, I like your spirit so I will tell you a secret. I may not look the part but I was once a {scientist}. The academy seemed to not like my... attitude and never actually invited me.
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_21: Thought so. It means starting anew, without any home, money or goal in your life. However, it also opens up opportunities... don't you agree?
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_22: No, no, you are right, I should have tried to rebuild it, I should have been more careful, I should... ah, why did I even tell you this.
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_23: Phew... alright, it was nice talking to you.
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_24: Hm, maybe you are right. You could give these plans to someone who might be able to finish this project. Someone who will not make the mistakes I made. Someone... hm, do you know the astronomer Spectulus?
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_25: Hmm, if you can spare a coin... we can talk. What do you say?
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_26: Persistent little nuisance, aren't we? Well, I like your spirit so I will tell you a secret. I may not look the part but I was once a {scientist}. The academy seemed to not like my... attitude and never actually invited me.
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_27: Indeed, I was one myself a long time ago. I may seem a little... distracted by now, but I was working on many important projects. I even created a device to... well, it will cost you another gold coin if you want me to tell you the whole story. You're in?
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_28: Well, if that is all you can spare... better keep it.
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_29: Alright, it seems you are serious about this. I will tell you about my device. Every night I looked up to the stars and wondered what worlds we would be able to find if we could just look where we wanted to. So... hey are you still listening?
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_3: Indeed, I was one myself a long time ago. I may seem a little... distracted by now, but I was working on many important projects. I even created a device to... well, it will cost you another gold coin if you want me to tell you the whole story. You're in?
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_30: Good, good. So eventually I found a way and invented a magic device I called the Lightboat. It was a large construction you could sit in and... well, judging by your looks you don't believe a word. Do you want to hear the story or not?
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_31: Fine. For years I gathered all the necessary items to build the device. I travelled, traded and took advantage of some rare opportunities. With luck and patience I eventually got every component I needed. Can you imagine the excitement I experienced?
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_32: And there I stood before my greatest invention. Door to unknown places, mysterious worlds... yet one of my components was flawed. A small crack in a vital element of my construction quickly led to the failure of the whole project. Still following?
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_33: The device was ultimately destroyed. I barely escaped the chaos with my life. My laboratory was shattered, as were all the components of the cursed device. With nothing left, I started to lead a new, different life. Do you know what that means?

npc.shoddy_beggar.thanks_pre: Very kind indeed. Maybe you are not such a bad guy after all. Maybe I can even give it back to you one day... you know I was not always like that *mumbles*.
npc.shoddy_beggar.thanks_quest: Thank you very much... plans you say? I don't know what you are talking about. Plans for a magic... device? And the people call ME crazy.
npc.shoddy_beggar.voice_2: That astronomer of the academy simply has no idea what he is dealing with...
npc.shoddy_beggar.voice_3: Some secrets should better be left uncovered.
npc.sholley.multi_1: A transporter dead? This is more then alarming. It seems Harsin is up to something and whatever it is, it's nothing good at all. But not all is lost. A local medium, Barnabas, has truly the gift to speak to the dead. ...
npc.sholley.multi_2: I'll mark his home on your map. He should be able to get the information you need to locate Harsin.
npc.sholley.multi_3: So you have proven yourself a true friend of our city. It's hard to believe but I think your words only give substance to suspicions my heart had harboured since quite a while. ...
npc.sholley.multi_4: So Harsin is probably not the person he appeared to be. Actually I haven't heard from him for quite a while. He was resident in the local bed and breakfast hotel. You should be able to find him there or at least to learn about his whereabouts.
npc.sholley.say_1: Already clicked the body on the house Roswitha ?
npc.siestaar.greet_msg_1: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
npc.siestaar.voice_1: Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Tibian Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.siflind.greet_msg_1: Be greeted, |PLAYERNAME|. If you are in need of potions or magical equipment, just ask me about my {offers}.
npc.siflind.multi_1: I am pleased to hear that. On the isle of Tyrsung foreign hunters have set up camp. They are hunting the animals there with no mercy. We will haveto find something that distracts them from hunting ...
npc.siflind.multi_2: Take this jug here and travel to the jungle of Tiquanda. There you will find a race of wood eating ants called termites. Use the jug on one of their hills to catch some of them ...
npc.siflind.multi_3: Then find someone in Svargrond that brings you to Tyrsung. There, release the termites on the bottom of a mast in the hull of the hunters' ship. If you are done, report to me about your mission.
npc.siflind.say_1: I heard you have already helped our cause. Are you interested in another mission, even when it requires you to travel to a distant land?
npc.siflind.say_10: The next things needed are 2 fish fins. Bring them to me and Ill tell you the next ingredients we need.
npc.siflind.say_11: Do you have the 2 fish fins I requested?
npc.siflind.say_12: The last thing needed is a green dragon scale. Bring them to me and Ill tell you the next ingredients we need.
npc.siflind.say_13: Do you have the green dragon scale I requested?
npc.siflind.say_14: I have now no mission for you.
npc.siflind.say_15: Do you want to buy a jug for 1000 gold?
npc.siflind.say_17: Good! Now listen. To protect the animals there, we have to harm the profit of the hunters. Therefor, I ask you to ruin their best source of earnings. Are you willing to do that?
npc.siflind.say_18: So let's proceed. Take this vial of paint. Travel to Tyrsung again and ruin as many pelts of baby seals as possible before the paint runs dry or freezes. Then return here to report about your mission.
npc.siflind.say_2: Well done. The termites caused just the distraction that we needed. Are you ready for the next step of my plan?
npc.siflind.say_27: Thank you very much. This will help us to defend Svargrond. But I heard young Nilsor is in dire need of help. Please contact him immediately.
npc.siflind.say_29: You want to buy animal cure for 400 gold coins?
npc.siflind.say_3: You saved the lives of many innocent animals. Thank you very much. If you are looking for another mission, just ask me.
npc.siflind.say_32: You dont have enough of gold coins.
npc.siflind.say_4: Our warriors need a more potent yet more secure berserker elixir to fight our enemies. To brew it, I need several ingredients. The first things needed are 5 bat wings. Bring them to me and Ill tell you the next ingredients we need.
npc.siflind.say_5: Do you have the 5 bat wings I requested?
npc.siflind.say_6: The second things needed are 4 bear paws. Bring them to me and Ill tell you the next ingredients we need.
npc.siflind.say_7: Do you have the 4 bear paws I requested?
npc.siflind.say_8: The next things needed are 3 bonelord eyes. Bring them to me and Ill tell you the next ingredients we need.
npc.siflind.say_9: Do you have the 3 bonelord eyes I requested?
npc.sigurd.greet_msg_1: Welcome to the magic store, |PLAYERNAME|! Ask me for a trade if you need something.
npc.sigurd.say_1: Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
npc.sigurd.voice_1: Hiho adventurers, get your runes, potions, wands and rods here!
npc.simon_the_beggar.greet_msg_1: Hello |PLAYERNAME|. I am a poor man. Please help me.
npc.simon_the_beggar.multi_1: That's great! I have stolen something from Dermot.
npc.simon_the_beggar.multi_10: Even if it worked on girls, I'd rather not be responsible for you ruining your pretty face. I have an idea though. If you help me brew one of these potions, I will sell something nice to you. ...
npc.simon_the_beggar.multi_11: I still have a pretty gypsy dress and a pearl necklace somewhere, which you could wear instead of this ragged skirt. For the small fee of 20000 gold pieces, it'd be yours. ...
npc.simon_the_beggar.multi_12: You only have to bring me 100 pieces of ape fur, so I can brew the potion. Do we have a deal?
npc.simon_the_beggar.multi_13: I can mix a secret potion which will increase your facial hair growth enormously. I call it 'Instabeard'. However, it requires certain ingredients. ...
npc.simon_the_beggar.multi_14: For the small fee of 20000 gold pieces I will help you mix this potion. Just bring me 100 pieces of ape fur, which are necessary to create this potion. ...
npc.simon_the_beggar.multi_2: You can buy it for 200 gold. Do you want to buy it?
npc.simon_the_beggar.multi_3: Well, it's the least you can do for those who live in dire poverty.
npc.simon_the_beggar.multi_4: A single cookie is a bit less than I'd expected, but better than ... WHA ... WHAT??
npc.simon_the_beggar.multi_5: MY BEARD! MY PRECIOUS BEARD! IT WILL TAKE AGES TO CLEAR IT OF THIS CONFETTI!
npc.simon_the_beggar.multi_6: When I was wandering around in Tibia, I lost my favourite staff somewhere in the northern ruins in Edron. ...
npc.simon_the_beggar.multi_7: Uh, don't ask me what I was doing there... sort of a pilgrimage. Well anyway, if you could bring that staff back to me, I promise I'll give you my current one. ...
npc.simon_the_beggar.multi_9: I can mix a secret potion which increases facial hair growth enormously. I call it 'Instabeard'. However, I fear it works only for men. ...
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_1: Haha, that beard is - well, not fake, but there's a trick behind it. I noticed people tend to be more generous towards a poor gramps. Want to know my trick?
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_10: Ahh! Very good. I will start mixing the potion immediately. Come back later. Bye bye.
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_11: You do not have all the required items.
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_12: You do not have all the required items.
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_13: It seems you already have this addon, don't you try to mock me son!
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_14: No, no. Our deal is finished, no complaining now, I don't have time all day. And no, you can't have my staff.
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_15: I said, no! Or well - I have a suggestion to make. Will you listen?
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_16: Good! Come back to me once you have retrieved my staff. Good luck.
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_17: Did you bring my favourite staff??
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_18: Yes!! That's it! I'm so glad! Here, you can have my other one. Thanks!
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_19: You do not have the staff.
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_2: Have you brought me the 100 pieces of ape fur and 20000 gold pieces?
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_20: You do not have the staff.
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_21: Sorry, but you need to have a premium account!
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_22: Have you brought a cookie for the poor?
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_23: I need gold. Can you spare 100 gold pieces for me?
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_24: You have no cookie that I'd like.
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_25: You haven't got enough money for me.
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_26: Thank you very much. Can you spare 500 more gold pieces for me? I will give you a nice hint.
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_28: Pah! I said 200 gold. You don't have that much.
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_29: Now you own the hot key.
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_3: Hmm, I'm not done yet with your potion. But here, let me sprinkle a few drops of my own potion on your face... there you go. Now you just have to wait.
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_4: Aha! I can see it! Now that you've waited patiently without shaving, your beard is perfect! All thanks to my, err, potion. Yes. Goodbye!
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_5: Hmm, it seems you need to wait a bit longer for the potion to take full effect. Please be patient.
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_6: Aha! I can see it! Now that you've waited patiently without shaving, your beard is perfect! All thanks to my, err, potion. Yes. Goodbye!
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_7: Hmm, it seems you need to wait a bit longer for the potion to take full effect. Please be patient.
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_8: Oh, I'm sorry... I almost forgot! Okay, okay... here is your promised dress. I'm sure it will look so much better on you than on me- I mean, my, err, sister.
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_9: Great! Come back to me once you have the 100 pieces of ape fur and I'll do my part of the deal.
npc.simon_the_beggar.voice_2: Sir, Ma'am, have a gold coin to spare?
npc.simon_the_beggar.voice_3: I need help! Please help me!
npc.sinatuki.say_2: Jinuma, suvituka siq chuqua!! Nguraka, nguraka! <happily takes the food from you and gives you five glimmering crystals>
npc.sinatuki.say_3: Jinuma, suvituka siq chuqua!! Nguraka, nguraka! <happily takes the food from you>
npc.sinclair.greet_msg_1: Greetings |PLAYERNAME|. I have - very - little time, please make it as short as possible. I may be able to help you if you are here to help us with any of our tasks or missions.
npc.sinclair.multi_1: We are still in need of more research concerning environmental as well as psychic ecto-magical influences. Besides more common ghosts we also need some of the harder to come by nightstalkers and - if you're really hardboiled - souleaters. ...
npc.sinclair.multi_10: Alright, the device is holding it. The magical barrier should be able to contain nearly 20 times the current load. That's a complete success! Spectulus, are you seeing this? We did it! ...
npc.sinclair.multi_11: Well, you did! You really helped us pulling this off. Thank you Lord Stalks! ...
npc.sinclair.multi_12: I doubt we will have much time to hunt for new specimens ourselves in the near future. If you like, you can continue helping us by finding and capturing more and different ghosts. Just talk to me to receive a new task.
npc.sinclair.multi_13: Excellent. Now we need to concentrate on testing that thing. The spirit cage has been calibrated based on some tests we made - as well as your recent findings over at the graveyard. ...
npc.sinclair.multi_14: Using the device on the remains of a ghost right after its defeat should capture it inside this trap. We could then transfer it into our spirit chamber which is in fact a magical barrier. ..
npc.sinclair.multi_15: At first, however, we need you to find a specimen and bring it here for us to test the capacity of the device. Are you ready for this?
npc.sinclair.multi_2: We will of course pay for every ghost you catch. You will receive more if you hunt for some of the tougher fellows - but don't overdue it. What do you say?
npc.sinclair.multi_3: Magnificent! Alright, we will at least need 5 caught ghosts. We will pay some more if you can catch 5 nightstalkers. Of course you will earn some more if you bring us 5 souleaters. ...
npc.sinclair.multi_4: I heard they dwell somewhere in that new continent - Zao? Well anyway, if you feel you've got enough, just return with what you've got and we will see. Good luck! ...
npc.sinclair.multi_5: Keep in mind that the specimens are only of any worth to us if the exact amount of 5 per specimen is reached. ...
npc.sinclair.multi_6: Furhtermore, to successfully bind Nightstalkers to the cage, you will need to have caught at least 5 Ghosts. To bind Souleaters, you will need at least 5 Ghosts and 5 Nightstalkers. ...
npc.sinclair.multi_7: The higher the amount of spirit energy in the cage, the higher its effective capacity. Oh and always come back and tell me if you lose your spirit cage.
npc.sinclair.multi_9: Amazing! I will transfer this to our spirit chamber right about - now! ...
npc.sinclair.say_1: So, did you find anything worth examining? Did you actually catch a ghost?
npc.sinclair.say_10: Alright you found something! Are you really finished hunting out there?
npc.sinclair.say_11: So, did you find anything worth examining? Did you actually catch a ghost?

npc.sissek.greet_msg_1: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
npc.sissek.voice_1: Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.sister_of_jack.greet_msg_1: Mh hello there. What can I do for you?
npc.sister_of_jack.multi_1: Yesss! So this time he will get it for a change! And he lived there...? He helped whom? Ha! He won't get away this time! What did he do there? I see... interesting! ...
npc.sister_of_jack.multi_2: Wait till mother hears that! Oh he will be in for a surprise, I can tell you that. Ma!! Maaaaa!!
npc.sister_of_jack.multi_3: I knew it! He likes taking extended walks outside, leaving all the cleaning to me - especially when he is working on this sculpture, this... 'thing' he tries to create. ...
npc.sister_of_jack.multi_4: What did he do? Since you look like a guy from the city, I bet he went to Edron in secrecy or something like that, didn't he? And you are here because of that?
npc.sister_of_jack.say_1: Why are you asking, he didn't get himself into something again did he?
npc.sister_of_jack.say_2: Spelltolust?! That sounds awfully nasty! What was he doing there - are you telling me he lived an alternate life and he didn't even tell {mother}?
npc.sister_of_jack.say_3: What?! And what did he do there? Who did he visit there?
npc.sister_of_jack.voice_1: Where did I put my broom? Mother?
npc.sister_of_jack.voice_2: Mother?! Oh no, now I have to do this all over again
npc.skjaar.greet_msg_1: Another creature who believes thinks physical strength is more important than wisdom! Why are you disturbing me?
npc.skjaar.say_1: I will give the key to the crypt only to the closest followers of my master. Would you like me to test you?
npc.skjaar.say_2: Before we start I must ask you for a small donation of 1000 gold coins. Are you willing to pay 1000 gold coins for the test?
npc.skjaar.say_3: All right then. Here comes the first question. What was the name of Dago's favourite pet?
npc.skjaar.say_5: Perhaps you knew him after all. Tell me - how many fingers did he have when he died?
npc.skjaar.say_6: Also true. But can you also tell me the colour of the deamons in which master specialized?
npc.skjaar.say_7: It seems you are worthy after all. Do you want the key to the crypt?
npc.snake_eye.say_1: So you're the delivery boy? Go ahead, but I warn you, it's quite heavy. You can take it from the box over there.
npc.snake_eye.say_2: Funny thing that everyone thinks we have forgers for fake documents here. But no, we don't. The best forger is old Ahmet in Ankrahmun.
npc.spectulus.greet_msg_1: Hello |PLAYERNAME|! You're late, do you have no concept of time? My mission is of utmost importance. If you are not interested in helping me, you might as well just leave.
npc.spectulus.greet_msg_2: Ah hello again |PLAYERNAME|! I still have one or two other {missions} for you. There are also some {tasks} someone needs to attend to.
npc.spectulus.greet_msg_3: Hello |PLAYERNAME|! You're late, do you have no concept of time? My mission is of utmost importance. If you are not interested in helping me, you might as well just leave.
npc.spectulus.multi_1: Well, if you really want to delve into this - I could use some help. So you have found my machine on that island? And you found the notes with the coordinates? Then you can find the entrance! ...
npc.spectulus.multi_10: [EN] At first, take this gold for the passage by ship and return to the Gray Island from where I started my expedition many years ago. From there you should find a way to reach the Gray Beach of Quirefang as no ordinary ship can land there. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_11: [EN] I will put this under your footgear. Here you go. And this in your nose. There. And there will be no further problems for you down there. Except- ah, well youll find out yourself soon enough, wont you?
npc.spectulus.multi_12: I will put this under your footgear. Here you go. And this in your nose. There. And there will be no further problems for you down there. Except- ah, well youll find out yourself soon enough, wont you?
npc.spectulus.multi_13: You do? Well, the end of this story was that I had to leave the place. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_14: I couldnt explore what lies below the stairs as there was an unpredictable stream. Diving into these waters would have been an uncontrollable risk, even with the means to survive without any air. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_15: So I used the portable teleporting device I installed into my machine in case of an emergency and went home. I could only take the most important research documents with me and had to leave most of my equipment in the cave. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_16: Of course I also left my final notes with the coordinates there. And for the life of me I cannot remember where I dug that stupid hole. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_17: When I arrived at home I immediately started looking for a way to manoeuvre in these chaotic conditions once I rediscovered the lost entrance. I never remembered it, but it seems you found it as you indeed have my original notes. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_18: Oh and just in case you want to complete what I have started - feel free to do so. Up to it?
npc.spectulus.multi_19: Ah, the machine you found at that island. Well, I built this thing to venture far beneath the very soil we walk on. I suspected something there. Something deep down below. Something evil. Even more so than the dreaded bugs which are crawling my study. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_2: Just look for a large staircase with sprawling steps. There is an unpassable stream there that will prevent you from venturing further on. But fear not, you can indeed travel down there - with these small enhancements I created. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_20: Drilling hole after hole only to get stuck in another hard, unbreakable sediment again and again, I was about to quit this pointless enterprise. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_21: However, the very last day I lingered on that island, I finally fell into a large hollow right under the beach. My drill was shattered and the machine was not mobile anymore. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_22: I am well aware that this may sound laughable now - at this part all of my colleagues burst into laughter anyway - but suddenly there were stairs. Incredibly large stairs that led to the underworld. A world deep under the sea - can you believe this?
npc.spectulus.multi_23: Well you know Jack - after all you talked to him in person. He will get over it. As for the real Jack, my former intern... I am glad that nothing serious happened to him. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_24: According to his letter, he did just fine so many years ago. He somehow managed to make a name of himself when he cast some magic we enhanced through our research - of course no one back then had ever seen such spells. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_25: Oh and he sends his regards to... how did he put it - 'whoever is currently helping me getting out of whatever mess I am currently in'. I... don't really know how this was meant but I guess this is directed at... you!
npc.spectulus.multi_26: Success!! Now it will be far easier to convince him of his true self! Excellent work. Now the only thing left to do is to separate him from whatever still binds him to that place. Did he develop any habits perhaps? ...
npc.spectulus.multi_27: A hobby or something! Yes, ask him about his hobbies! Convince him somehow that anything he is doing there does not match his true self - he didn't have any hobbies except a healthy interest in science - you MUST convince him, no matter what! ...
npc.spectulus.multi_28: Or everything we achieved would be in vain. We can still save Jack! Now go and do what you must do.
npc.spectulus.multi_29: Alright listen. As long as his social environment accepts him as the person he is now, he will never come free from the shackles that bind him to this alternate self. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_3: I will put this under your footgear. Here you go. And this in your nose. There. And there will be no further problems for you down there. Except- ah, well you'll find out yourself soon enough, won't you?
npc.spectulus.multi_30: Oh, he has a sister you say? And his mother is living with them? ...
npc.spectulus.multi_31: Hm... that's strange, I don't even recall his family. Never knew he had a mother and a sister. Tell them the truth about him - maybe they will understand and even help him getting this over with. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_32: But be careful, the {dimensional} shift could mean that they will not even know what you're talking about since they are more closely linked to him than anyone else.
npc.spectulus.multi_33: A trigger is needed to make him recall what happened. First thing should be to change his environment to be more... familiar. As soon as he will have the things he used to have around him, his memories will come back. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_34: I know that he used to have a very comfy red cushioned chair and an old globe which sat near the middle of the room. He also used a smaller telescope and he had that extremely large amphora in a corner. And... there was one other thing. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_35: A rocking horse. He just loved it! Find these items, buy them if you need to and place them where {Jack} lives. Ask him about the furniture and don't forget to tell me about his reaction!
npc.spectulus.multi_36: [EN] But {Jack} is not yet lost to us - if we can get him back to his former self! You have to tell him about his former life, convince him, change his environment. But at first you will need to talk to him and find out who exactly we are dealing with now. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_37: [EN] I will mark his current location on your map, just ask him about me and see what happens - good luck.
npc.spectulus.multi_38: I will mark his current location on your map, just ask him about me and see what happens - good luck.
npc.spectulus.multi_39: [EN] The bad news is, using the device at that state was not a good idea. We effectively caused a magical distortion in the fabric of time, space and thus folded infinity - just a little. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_4: Mh? Ah, yes yes. 'Njey' is the native-language term for a very old race of undersea creatures which ...
npc.spectulus.multi_40: [EN] The good news is that {Jack} is still on our world, and not even inconveniently far away. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_41: [EN] Unfortunately in the current state of time, he was never interested in attending Edron Academy, he never looked for a job to finance his studies and of course has never been one of my interns. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_42: [EN] Since he was in the magic sphere during the launch, the time fold only affected his own {dimensional} anchoring. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_43: [EN] The number of parallel {dimensions} is endless and the fold made him slip into one completely different course of time where he never was the person I once knew. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_44: [EN] Now you know it all. Still want to help?
npc.spectulus.multi_45: Now you know it all. Still want to help?
npc.spectulus.multi_46: [EN] He was as eager as you to help me - quite a nice person, really. At the time he was still around I was working on a device to transport its user to any specified point in time - be it back or to the future if you know what I mean. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_47: [EN] He was helping me quite a lot, no matter which task I applied to him. And one day we finally did it, our tempus machina was up and running. He was certainly all man of action when he actually stepped into the machine for our first run. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_48: [EN] The device was designed for one person with enough room for some provisions and one or two books for reading if one would land in some drab solitude. You never know, you know? So we fired it up and yes, it actually worked! ...
npc.spectulus.multi_49: [EN] He completely disappeared right before my eyes! Eureka! Well ahem, there was but one tiny little problem. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_5: ...hm, wait - only a select few of my colleagues even bothered studying their culture. They are a mere fantasy to the common man - is there anything of importance you want to tell me?
npc.spectulus.multi_50: [EN] As all magical calibration was done from my lab I never thought about adding some sort of control to its interior. In other words {Jack} has travelled in time, without any means to come back. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_51: [EN] Sleepless days of intensive research, however, brought me to the conclusion that he was not actually travelling to the future, but to another {dimension}, {parallel} to ours. There is still a chance to rescue him - and you can help me. What do you say?
npc.spectulus.multi_52: Sleepless days of intensive research, however, brought me to the conclusion that he was not actually travelling to the future, but to another {dimension}, {parallel} to ours. There is still a chance to rescue him - and you can help me. What do you say?
npc.spectulus.multi_53: I recently teamed up with a fellow scientist and friend Sinclair, who is also more of an explorer than me, to combine our discoveries in the field of complex phenomena not that easily to describe just by today's state of magic. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_54: Of course I am talking about ghosts. I know, I know. Hard to believe in those times of highly advanced magic we live in. Yet there are some things, we fail to explain. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_55: And that is exactly where we come in! Oh, and you of course. We will not only explain them - we will ''remove'' them. Just tell me whenever you are ready to help us with our research.
npc.spectulus.multi_57: Three: You can explain at least three of the following terms, infestations, collective apparitions, ectoplasmic segregations, ecto-magical field phenomena, neuro-speculative sub-conscious awareness of spirits, ghosts and/or ghasts.
npc.spectulus.multi_59: ...and how shiny it is, almost there ...
npc.spectulus.multi_6: There are rumours of aggressive fishmen in northern Tiquanda. We have to find out if this is even remotely connected to the Njey. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_60: ...now wh- no, NO, NOOO! It just ...
npc.spectulus.multi_61: ...slipped. And cracked. Don't look at me like that ...
npc.spectulus.multi_62: ...I need some time to get over this. What? Oh, yes you can take the remains if you like. Just get it out of my sight.
npc.spectulus.multi_63: A debacle, catastrophe, disaster - I need time to fully understand what chance just slipped through our hands here... hm? Oh yes, yes through my hands, my hands of course. Now would you please leave me alone?!
npc.spectulus.multi_64: Alright, now listen. West of Edron, near the ocean, you'll find the Lost Mines. Go down there to recover one of its rare crystals. But beware, people say the mine workers who died there years ago in an horrible accident are still digging. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_65: I will mark the location of the mines on your map. Be careful when entering these muddy depths and don't forget that you will need a pick to gather the crystals.
npc.spectulus.multi_66: That's the spirit! As time is of the essence, we should start right now. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_67: A beggar here in Edron brags about how smart he is and that he knows about a man who lost his sanity because of an experiment, but he won't tell anyone any details. Maybe he knows more.
npc.spectulus.multi_68: [EN] You remember me explaining the fold in time, causing a tiny disturbance in infinity? Well, as I already told you, {Jack} was indeed not transported to the future... but to the past. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_69: [EN] I received some kind of letter this morning that has been stored for me by the Academy for about 70 years now. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_7: What's puzzling me is that they were sighted above ground and then retreated into a temple ruin. If we find that ruin, we could find out if there's a relation. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_70: [EN] It said it should be opened at a specific day 20 years ago to prevent this whole incident but I wasn't even at the Academy by that time. Someone just found the letter earlier today and brought it to my attention. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_71: [EN] So our {Jack} here was in fact... a completely different person. Now, now... don't get upset, there was no chance for me to warn you earlier! ...
npc.spectulus.multi_72: [EN] And it wasn't all that bad, was it? Heh... I mean... everyone needs a change in life now and then! And he can still come here if he likes to! ...
npc.spectulus.multi_73: [EN] Or wait - erm... better not tell him where exactly I live, I have some kind of presentiment concerning that whole affair... yes, we should just leave everything as it is now, indeed we should. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_74: [EN] Anyway you did a great job and I thank you for... putting your hands into my fire Player... once again.
npc.spectulus.multi_75: Anyway you did a great job and I thank you for... putting your hands into my fire Player... once again.
npc.spectulus.multi_76: Did you find a rare crystal? Show me... Amazing, absolutely amazing. This crystal alone is worth a small fortune. Ahem, of course I'm glad you brought it to me for further research instead of bringing it to a merchant. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_77: Please return here if you want to continue helping me with another mission.
npc.spectulus.multi_78: Alright, now that we have enough results, the analysing can start. While I do this, I will need you to test the magically enhanced cage Sinclair developed to contain spirits effectively. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_79: Take the spirit cage from him and use it on the essence of a common ghost. Its essence will then be sucked into the cage and we can study him right here in the safety of the academy walls.
npc.spectulus.multi_8: Are you willing to help me?
npc.spectulus.multi_80: I fine-tuned another set of devices. You are the lucky candidate to first lay eyes on some revolutionary new concepts. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_81: Are you ready to help science once again?
npc.spectulus.multi_82: Alright. Let's go. At first we need to find out more about ghosts in general. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_83: I still need more information and values to properly calibrate the magical orientation of orange and turquoise sparkle attractors which we will need to actually contain ghost-emissions. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_9: [EN] Just look for a large staircase with sprawling steps. There is an unpassable stream there that will prevent you from venturing further on. But fear not, you can indeed travel down there - with these small {enhancements} I created. ...
npc.spectulus.say_1: You are back, how did the measurements go? Did you recognise anything of interest?
npc.spectulus.say_10: Well, the only thing left to do would be to offer the crystal at the well of the collector. There must be a pedestal near the well, where you need to put your donation. Ha, do you think you could do that?
npc.spectulus.say_11: Found the well yet? Look on one of the ice isles near Carlin. I'm perfectly sure that the well with the pedestal is located on one of them. And be careful with the carrying device, I only have this one prototype.
npc.spectulus.say_12: So have you found the well and entered the lair? I hope you can find the {mirror crystal} in there. It is the only way to finish the {Lightboat}.
npc.spectulus.say_13: Put the mirror crystal into the special carrying device I gave you and bring it directly to me.
npc.spectulus.say_14: Do you have the mirror crystal? Unbelievable! Alright I will extract the crystal from the device myself, would you please give me the device with the crystal and step back?
npc.spectulus.say_15: After the debacle with the crystal, I started focussing on other things. There are also some {tasks} that still need to be done. If you can spare the time to continue helping me, it shall not be to your disadvantage. So are you in for another mission?
npc.spectulus.say_16: So you found him? Have you talked to {Jack} yet?
npc.spectulus.say_17: You're back from {Jack}! Mh, by the looks of your face I doubt our little redecoration project yielded any success. But I had an even better idea while you were gone - ready to give it another try?
npc.spectulus.say_18: So, did you talk to his family? Were you able to convince them?
npc.spectulus.say_19: Did you find out what hobby {Jack} has? Did you separate him from this activity? Only if he has a free mind, he can truly get back to his former self! Now all you need to do is talk to him again!
npc.spectulus.say_2: Alright, you look bright enough to fulfil my requests - at least you do not fall asleep while standing there. Ahem... I heard about a certain inventor who created a {magic device} to actually sail the {sea of light}. Will you help me find him?
npc.spectulus.say_20: The device needs a special crystal. It's called {mirror crystal}. The inventor somehow damaged it - with fatal results. He had to give up, as no second crystal was left to try. I, however, know of another one... but are you up to the task?
npc.spectulus.say_21: One remaining mirror crystal is in the hands of a creature called the collector which collects all kinds of crystals. The only way to get access to its lair is to donate a very rare crystal to a secret well. I need you to get one, will you help me?
npc.spectulus.say_22: Good, because if you wouldn't do it... listen, this well is on one of the isles near Carlin. There you offer the crystal. Once you get access to its lair, find the collector and... convince it to give you the mirror crystal. Understood?
npc.spectulus.say_23: To collect the unbelievably rare, practically unique mirror crystal, you will need to use this special carrying device I developed. If you find the crystal, use it to store it and transport it safely to me. There is no second one.
npc.spectulus.say_24: Of course you are. And here we go. I have to ask some questions first. One: You aint afraid of no ghost, right?
npc.spectulus.say_25: Good. Two: You know that ghosts exist and/or have found and/or defeated one or more of them?
npc.spectulus.say_26: Good. Take this wand - we call it a spirit meter - and go to the graveyard I have marked on your map and take a few measurements on the graves.
npc.spectulus.say_27: Let me see the spirit meter. Hmmm... those are grave news you bring - uhm, you know what I mean. But this is awesome! Now I know for sure that the calibration is only some short bursts of magically enhanced energy away.
npc.spectulus.say_28: Yes? And he didn't remember anything? Not even me? That's not good. Then we will have to do everything ourselves. Are you ready to continue?
npc.spectulus.say_29: Ah well, let's forget about the scientific details - you will do just fine as long as you do exactly what I say. Ready for me to go on with your task?
npc.spectulus.say_3: You should find the beggar somewhere in Edron. Stay persistent, I'm sure he knows more than he wants to tell us.
npc.spectulus.say_30: Yes, maybe it was the right decision. Astronomical research is nothing for the faint-hearted.
npc.spectulus.say_31: Well, the... what? You... mean you're no longer interested? I see, well maybe I overestimated your spirit after all.
npc.spectulus.say_32: Alright, alright. You'll never find out the true secrets of life with such attitude, hm.
npc.spectulus.say_33: Come on, this is our only chance to finish the Lightboat.
npc.spectulus.say_34: Thought so. Well, no reason to be ashamed. I'll have to find help elsewhere now, though.
npc.spectulus.say_35: Come back if you made up your mind.
npc.spectulus.say_37: Then off you go! Im sorry that I cannot offer you any further help but Im sure you will find support along your way. And - be careful. The sea can appear pitch black down there.
npc.spectulus.say_38: Excellent, excellent. The rumours pointed to the north of Tiquanda, a sunken temple probably half drowned in water. Return to me if you find anything interesting!
npc.spectulus.say_39: Then off you go! I'm sorry that I cannot offer you any further help but I'm sure you will find support along your way. And - be careful. The sea can appear pitch black down there.
npc.spectulus.say_4: [EN] o have you talked to the beggar? What did he tell you? Where are the plans...? Wh...? He did? He is?  You've already got the plans? Beautiful!! Amazing! Alright it will take some time to recapitulate these plans.
npc.spectulus.say_5: So have you talked to the beggar? What did he tell you? Where are the plans...? Wh...? He did? He is? You've already got the plans? Beautiful!! Amazing! Alright it will take some time to recapitulate these plans.
npc.spectulus.say_6: It will take some time to work out the initial problem of the device. Come back when I've found the component needed to finish it. Alright, B connects to D and another two nails marked with S go... hmmm.
npc.spectulus.say_7: ...connects to N942. Alright!! That's it! I just finished a prototype device! And it looks like I figured out the initial failure. A very special crystal is needed for the device to work. Aren't you as curious as me to know what went wrong?
npc.spectulus.say_8: Did you enter the Lost Mines yet? They are west of Edron, close to the sea. You will also need a pick once you get to the crystal deposit.
npc.spectulus.say_9: Hm, so did you find a rare crystal? Show me... hey! That's not a rare crystal. What... where did you get that anyway? Please return to me with the right crystal.
npc.spectulus.stdmod_2: So my initial calculations had been correct!
npc.spectulus.stdmod_3: Looks like I have to find another way then.
npc.spectulus.stdmod_4: Hm, I need to recapitulate my equipment...

npc.storkus.multi_1: Ding, dong, the vampire is dead, eh? So I guess ye' can return to Henricus and tell him that ye' finished your job here. I'm quite sure he has some more challenging task up his sleeve. ...
npc.storkus.multi_2: One more thing before ye' leave: I already mentioned the master vampires. ...
npc.storkus.multi_3: They are quite hard to find. If ye' stumble across one of them and manage to kill him, he will surely drop some token that proves his death. Bring me these tokens. ...
npc.storkus.multi_4: If ye' kill enough of them, I might have a little surprise for ye'.
npc.storkus.multi_5: While ye' were keeping the lower ranks busy, I could get valuable information about some vampire lords. ...
npc.storkus.multi_6: One of them is hiding somewhere beneath the Green Claw Swamp. I expect ye' to find him and kill him. ...
npc.storkus.multi_7: But be warned: Without good preparation, ye' might get into trouble. I hope for ye' he will be sleeping in his coffin when ye' arrive. ...
npc.storkus.multi_8: Before ye' open his coffin and drag that beast out to destroy it, I advise ye' to place some garlic necklaces on the stone slabs next to his coffin. That will weaken him considerably. ...
npc.storkus.multi_9: Bring me his ring as proof for his death. And now hurry and good hunt to ye'.
npc.storkus.say_1: [EN] So far ye've brought me {} of 20 {vampire dusts}. Do ye' have any more with ye'?
npc.storkus.say_10: Ye' brought the token needed to advance to the first vampire hunter rank. I consider that a fluke, but still, congrats! Let me share some of my experience with ye'.
npc.storkus.say_12: Ye' brought the four tokens needed to advance to the second vampire hunter rank. Pretty lucky ye' are! Let me share some of my experience with ye'.
npc.storkus.say_14: Ye' brought the five tokens needed to advance to the third vampire hunter rank. Wow, you're pretty determined! Let me share some of my experience with ye'.
npc.storkus.say_16: Ye' brought the ten tokens needed to advance to the fourth vampire hunter rank. You're absolutely painstaking! Let me share some of my experience with ye'.
npc.storkus.say_18: Ye' brought the thirty tokens needed to advance to the fifth vampire hunter rank. You're completely obliterative, kid! Let me share some of my experience with ye'.
npc.storkus.say_2: Fine, you're done! Ye' should talk to me about your {mission} again now.
npc.storkus.say_20: Ye' brought the fifty tokens needed to advance to the last vampire hunter rank. Now that's something. You're razing-amazing! Let me share some of my experience and a little something with ye'!
npc.storkus.say_22: As they might have told ye', I'm a vampire hunter. If ye' want to be of any help, ye' can assist me with some of my tasks and bring me 20 ounces of vampire dust. This gives me some time to concentrate on a bigger project.

npc.strange_pipe.stdmod_3: The creature is powerful but not very clever. It seems it can be easily {enraged} and then it would likely let slip all caution and would relentlessly attack without regard for its safety.
npc.strange_pipe.stdmod_4: I used the time to prepare. You'll find my talking tubes all the {way} to his lair, and I can provide you with vital information about the things ahead.

npc.strange_pipe3.multi_11: He is an old enemy of the city and I've battled him often in the past. ...
npc.strange_pipe3.multi_12: Now he has returned for vengeance, he reclaimed an old abandoned underground {laboratory} and he has acquired new powerful {allies}.
npc.strange_pipe3.multi_2: As in the past, our enemy still uses a series of machines to open the way to the next section of his lair. You have to turn them all on to proceed. ...
npc.strange_pipe3.multi_3: They will only work for a certain amount of time though, so you will have to hurry or some of the machines will turn inactive again.
npc.strange_pipe3.multi_4: While it's buried, it only uses his tentacles to attack. If one is destroyed it will simply use another set of tentacles and its supply seems endless. ...
npc.strange_pipe3.multi_5: If you manage though to kill all the tentacles it is using within a few heartbeats, it will become confused by its momentary helplessness and will probably attack with its main body. ...
npc.strange_pipe3.multi_6: That is when you have a chance to destroy it. Pass through its chamber and look for another of my tubes to contact me. Please hurry! End of communication.
npc.strange_pipe3.multi_7: It's a fearsome subterranean beast like nothing I've ever encountered. It is dangerous and almost unbeatable because its main body is hidden beneath the ground ...
npc.strange_pipe3.multi_8: And it has an endless supply of tentacles. But not all is lost, as I have devised a {plan} to battle the beast.
npc.strange_pipe3.multi_9: His allies are an enigma even to me. It seems they belong to some unknown race that lives deep under the earth. ...
npc.strange_pipe3.stdmod_1: I can't reveal much to you right now as time is of the essence. I can tell you though that the glooth plant and the whole town are in danger and we have to act to stop a {madman} and his schemes.
npc.strange_pipe3.stdmod_2: I defeated him there in the past. It has been abandoned for many {years}, but I suspected him to return from the dead eventually, as he has done so often before.
npc.strange_pipe3.stdmod_3: The creature is powerful but not very clever. It seems it can be easily {enraged} and then it would likely let slip all caution and would relentlessly attack without regard for its safety.
npc.strange_pipe3.stdmod_4: I used the time to prepare. You'll find my talking tubes all the {way} to his lair, and I can provide you with vital information about the things ahead.

npc.stricken_soul.multi_5: I was one of them and ordered to hold contact to the outside woooorld. But then, something... happened. ...
npc.stricken_soul.multi_6: Outsiders managed to sneak in, infiltrate and influence the society... for the worse. Who knows for what ends. They chaaaaanged... ...

npc.stricken_soul.multi_8: Find the three passages... one is right here in the cellars, one in the jungles of Tiquanda and one in the deserts of Darama. ...
