npc.uncle.multi_1: Some dwarven criminal called Blowbeard dares to blackmail our city. He threatens to destroy the whole city and demands an insane amount of gold ...
npc.uncle.multi_10: In some ruin in the midst of the Green Claw Swamp, a dark knight had fancied himself as the lord of the swamp for quite a while ...
npc.uncle.multi_11: For some years, we had some sort of gentleman's agreement. In exchange for some supplies and luxuries, the deranged knight used his ominous influence over the local bonelord species to supply us with ... certain goods ...
npc.uncle.multi_12: However, lately the black knight has proven himself to be no gentleman at all. In a fit of unprovoked rage, he slew our emissary and almost all of his henchmen ...
npc.uncle.multi_13: Even though we can live with this loss, it becomes obvious that the knight's madness gets worse which makes him unbearable as a neighbour. Find him in his hideout in the Green Claw Swamp and get rid of him.
npc.uncle.multi_14: The oppression of Carlin's men by their lunatic women is unbearable to some of our authorities. We see it as our honourable duty to support the male resistance in Carlin ...
npc.uncle.multi_15: The poor guys have some speakeasy in the sewers. Bring them this barrel of beer with our kind regards to strengthen their resistance.
npc.uncle.multi_16: Our Thaian allies are sometimes a bit forgetful. For this reason we are not always informed timely about certain activities. We won't insult our great king by pointing out this flaw ...
npc.uncle.multi_17: Still, we are in dire need of these information so we are forced to take action on our own. Travel to the Thaian castle and 'find' the documents we need. They have the file name AH-X17L89. ...
npc.uncle.multi_18: Now go to Thaian castle and get the File.
npc.uncle.multi_19: Well, well, well! As you might know, we are entrusted by the Venorean tradesmen to ensure the safety of their ventures ...
npc.uncle.multi_2: Of course we are not willing to give him a single gold coin. It will be your job to get rid of this problem. Go and kill this infamous dwarf ...
npc.uncle.multi_20: This task often puts our representatives in rather dangerous and challenging situations. On the other hand, you can expect a generous compensation for your efforts on our behalf...
npc.uncle.multi_21: Just keep in mind though that we expect quick action and that we are rather intolerant to needless questions and moral doubts ...
npc.uncle.multi_22: If you join our ranks, you cannot join the service of another city! So do I understand you correctly, you want to join our small business?
npc.uncle.multi_23: You have proven yourself as very efficient. The future may hold great things for you in store ...
npc.uncle.multi_24: Take this token of gratitude. I hope you can use well what you will find inside!
npc.uncle.multi_3: His laboratory is near the technomancer hall. Bring me his beard as proof of his demise.
npc.uncle.multi_4: We try to establish new trade agreements with various potential customers. Sometimes we have to offer some presents in advance to ensure that trade is prospering and flourishing. It will be your task to deliver one of those little presents ...
npc.uncle.multi_5: The northern barbarians are extremely hostile to us. The ones living in Svargrond are poisoned by the lies of agitators from Carlin. The barbarians that are also known as raiders are another story though ...
npc.uncle.multi_6: Of course they are extremely wild and hostile but we believe that we will sooner or later profit from it when we are able to improve our relations. Please deliver this chest of weapons to the barbarians as a sign of our good will ...
npc.uncle.multi_7: Unfortunately, most of them will attack you on sight. It will probably take some time until you find somebody that is willing to talk to you and to accept the weapons.
npc.uncle.multi_8: As you know, our lovely city is a bastion of civilisation surrounded by numerous hazards. The nearby Plains of Havoc and the hostile elven town Shadowthorn are only a few of the obstacles we have to overcome on an almost daily basis ...
npc.uncle.multi_9: Against all odds, we managed to gain some modest profit by exploiting these circumstances in one way or the other. Recently though, one of our neighbours went too far...
npc.uncle.say_10: Please bring me proof of the mad technomancers defeat!
npc.uncle.say_12: Let's start with a rather simple job. There is a contact in Thais with that we need to get in touch again. Deliver this note to Gamel in Thais. Get an answer from him. If he is a bit reluctant, be 'persuasive'.
npc.uncle.say_13: Do you have news to make old Uncle happy?
npc.uncle.say_14: Do you have news to make old Uncle happy?
npc.uncle.say_15: Do you have news to make old Uncle happy? Don't tell me you need another barrel of beer, though.
npc.uncle.say_16: Do you have news to make old Uncle happy?
npc.uncle.say_17: I need you to locate a lost ring on the Isle of the Kings for me, get back to me once you have it.
npc.uncle.say_18: Do you have news to make old Uncle happy?
npc.uncle.say_19: Do you have news to make old Uncle happy?
npc.uncle.say_2: I hope you did not make this little pest too nervous. He isn't serving us too well by hiding under some stone or something like that. However, nicely done for your first job.
npc.uncle.say_20: Do you have news to make old Uncle happy?
npc.uncle.say_3: Ah, yes. This will be a most interesting lecture.
npc.uncle.say_4: Please bring me the file AH-X17L89.
npc.uncle.say_5: Does it not warm up your heart if you can bring a little joy to the people while doing your job? Well, don't get carried away, most part of your job is not warming up hearts but tearing them out.
npc.uncle.say_6: Good work getting rid of that nuisance.
npc.uncle.say_7: Fine, fine. This will serve us quite well. Ah, don't give me that look... you are not that stupid, are you?
npc.uncle.say_8: Come back when you've found the ring.
npc.uncle.say_9: Even if the present has not improved our relations, the weapons will enable the barbarians to put more pressure on Svargrond and Carlin. So in any case we profited from the present.
npc.undal.greet_msg_1: Greetings hero. I guess you came to {talk}.
npc.undal.multi_1: You have to empower eight ward stones. Once charged with arcane energy, they will strengthen the Nightmare Beast's prison and at the same time weaken this terrible creature. We know about the specific location of six of those stones. ...
npc.undal.multi_10: There the nightmare beast can be challenged and defeated.
npc.undal.multi_11: So do you want to learn the story behind of this or rather talk about the {task} at hand?
npc.undal.multi_2: You can find them in the mountains of the island Okolnir, in a water elemental cave beneath Folda, in the depths of Calassa, in the forests of Feyrist and on the islands Meriana and Cormaya. ...
npc.undal.multi_3: The location of the other two ward stones is a bit more obscure, however. We are not completely sure where they are. You should make inquiries at an abandoned house in the Plains of Havoc. You may find it east of an outlaw camp. ...
npc.undal.multi_4: The other stone seems to be somewhere in Tiquanda. Search for a small stone building south-west of Banuta. Take this talisman to empower the ward stones. It will work with the six stones at the known locations. ...
npc.undal.multi_5: However, the empowering of the two hidden stones could be a bit more complicated. But you have to find out on yourself what to do with those stones.
npc.undal.multi_6: You empowered all eight ward stones. Well done! You may now enter the Dream Labyrinth via the portal here in the Court. Beneath it you will find the Nightmare Beast's lair. But the labyrinth is protected by seven so called Dream Doors. ...
npc.undal.multi_7: You have to find the Seven {Keys} to unlock the Seven Dream Doors down there. Only then you will be able to enter the Nightmare Beast's lair.
npc.undal.multi_8: You will have to re-empower several wardstones all over the world, to weaken the beast of nightmares. ...
npc.undal.multi_9: The next step would be to enter a place known as dream scar and participate in battles, to gain access to the lower areas. ...
npc.undal.say_1: So do you want to learn the {story} behind of this or rather talk about the {task} at hand?
npc.undal.say_10: Very good! You gained the second addon to the dream warrior outfit.
npc.undal.say_11: You do not have enough items.

npc.undal.say_13: You do not have enough items.
npc.undal.say_2: Do you prefer the {long} version or the {short} version?
npc.undal.say_3: The Nightmare Beast is slain. You have done well. The Courts of Summer and Winter will be forever grateful. For your efforts I want to reward you with our traditional dream warrior outfit. May it suit you well!
npc.undal.say_5: They are not literally keys but rather puzzles you have to solve or a secret mechanism you have to discover in order to open the Dream Doors. A parchment in the chest here can tell you more about it.
npc.undal.say_6: Are you interested in one or two addons to your dream warrior outfit?
npc.undal.say_7: You don't even have the outfit.
npc.undal.say_8: I provide two addons. For the first one I need you to bring me five pomegranates. For the second addon you need an ice shield. Do you want one of these addons?
npc.undal.say_9: What do you have for me: the {pomegranates} or the {ice shield}?
npc.urks_the_mute.greet_msg_1: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! Lovely steamboat, ain't it? I can even offer you a {passage} if you like.
npc.urks_the_mute.stdmod_1: <the dwarf quizzically raises his brow - the only destinations he accepts seems to be {Cormaya} or {Kazordoon}>
npc.urks_the_mute.stdmod_2:
Well, you might be just the hero they need there. To tell you the truth, some our most reliable ore mines have started to run low. ... \z
	This is why we developed new steamship technologies to be able to further explore and cartograph the great subterraneous rivers. Our brothers have established a base on a continent far, far away. ... \z
	We call that the far, far away base. But since it will hopefully become a flourishing mine one day, most of us started to call it {Farmine}. The dwarfs there could really use some help right now.
npc.urks_the_mute.stdmod_3: <the dwarf smiles slightly, shows you a piece of paper with |TRAVELCOST| written on it, as expecting a {yes} or {no}>

npc.uso.stdmod_2: In this category I have '{Light}', '{Find Person}', '{Magic Rope}', '{Levitate}', '{Haste}', '{Charge}' and '{Great Light}'.
npc.uso.stdmod_3: I can teach you {healing spells}, {attack spells} and {support spells}. What kind of spell do you wish to learn? You can also tell me for which level you would like to learn a spell, if you prefer that.

npc.ustan.say_1: I had some cough syrup a while ago. It was stolen in an ape raid. I fear if you want more cough syrup you will have to buy it in the druids guild in carlin.
npc.ustan.say_2: Would you like to wear bear paws like I do? No problem, just bring me 50 bear paws and 50 wolf paws and I'll fit them on.
npc.ustan.say_3: Have you brought 50 bear paws and 50 wolf paws?
npc.ustan.say_4: Excellent! Like promised, here are your bear paws.
npc.uzgod.say_1: You bringing me draconian steel and obsidian lance in exchange for obsidian knife?
npc.uzgod.say_10: To get into dwacatra you having to get several keys. Each key opening way to other key until you get key to dwarven prison ...
npc.uzgod.say_11: Last key should be in the generals quarter near armory. Only General might have key to enter there too. But me not knowing how to enter Generals private room at barracks. You looking on your own ...
npc.uzgod.say_12: When got key, then you going down to dwarven prison and getting me that brooch. Tell me that you got brooch when having it.
npc.uzgod.say_13: Thanking you for brooch. Me guessing you now want your pickaxe?
npc.uzgod.say_15: Ah, that's how me like me customers. Ok, me do this... <pling pling> ... another fine swing of the hammer here and there... <ploing>... here you have it!
npc.uzgod.say_16: Well. Thinking about it, me a smith, so why not. 1000 gold for your personal crimson sword. Ok?
npc.uzgod.say_17: Too expensive?! You think me work is cheap? Well, if you want cheap, I can make cheap. Hrmpf. I make cheap sword for 300 gold. Ok?
npc.uzgod.say_18: Cheap but good quality? Impossible. Unless... you bring material. Three iron ores, 250 gold. Okay?
npc.uzgod.say_4: True dwarven pickaxes having to be maded by true weaponsmith! You wanting to get pickaxe for explorer society?
npc.uzgod.say_6: You telling me to forge one?! Especially for you? You making fun of me?
npc.uzgod.say_8: Me order book quite full is. But telling you what: You getting me something me lost and Uzgod seeing that your pickaxe comes first. Jawoll! You interested?
npc.uzgod.say_9: Good good. You listening: Me was stolen valuable heirloom. Brooch from my family. Good thing is criminal was caught. Bad thing is, criminal now in dwarven prison of dwacatra is and must have taken brooch with him ...
npc.uzon.stdmod_1: Feel the wind in your hair during one of my carpet rides!
npc.uzon.stdmod_10: I would never transport this one.
npc.uzon.stdmod_11: So you heard about haunted Drefia? Many adventures travel there to test their skills against the undead: vampires, mummies, and ghosts.
npc.uzon.stdmod_12: Some people claim it is hidden somewhere under the endless sands of the devourer desert in Darama.
npc.uzon.stdmod_13: Thais is noisy and overcrowded. That's why I like Darashia more.
npc.uzon.stdmod_14: I have seen almost every place on the continent.
npc.uzon.stdmod_15: I could retell the tales of my travels for hours. Sadly another flight is scheduled soon.
npc.uzon.stdmod_16: Just another Thais but with women to lead them.
npc.uzon.stdmod_17: You can buy flying carpets only in Darashia.
npc.uzon.stdmod_18: I transport travellers to the continent of Darama for a small fee. So many want to see the wonders of the desert and learn the secrets of Darama.
npc.uzon.stdmod_19: I heard too many news to recall them all.
npc.uzon.stdmod_2: Never heard about a place like this.

npc.vascalir.greet_msg_1: Welcome, adventurer |PLAYERNAME|. These are dire times for Rookgaard... have you come to help in our {mission}?
npc.vascalir.greet_msg_10: Welcome back, |PLAYERNAME|! How about that studded armor - would you like to have it now?
npc.vascalir.greet_msg_11: |PLAYERNAME|! Thank the gods you are back! While you were gone, something horrible happened. Do you smell the fire?
npc.vascalir.greet_msg_12: Oh my, what happened to your hair? Your face is all black, too - it must have been a hell of flames down there. That's so brave of you. Did you get the book?
npc.vascalir.greet_msg_13: Are you prepared for your next mission, |PLAYERNAME|?
npc.vascalir.greet_msg_14: Now that you know how to store your money, it's time to go after the trolls. I'm even going to give you some more equipment as reward. Do you feel ready for that mission?
npc.vascalir.greet_msg_15: |PLAYERNAME|, welcome back! That was great work you did there. Let me give you something for your efforts - you deserve it. Here, want a helmet?
npc.vascalir.greet_msg_16: Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|. Do you have enough space for the brass helmet now?
npc.vascalir.greet_msg_17: Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|. Are you ready for your next mission?
npc.vascalir.greet_msg_18: Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|. I see you haven't explored the whole crypt yet - do you need explanations again?
npc.vascalir.greet_msg_19: Welcome back, |PLAYERNAME|! Did you find a nice, fleshy bone in the crypt?
npc.vascalir.greet_msg_2: Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|. Your task is still not done - do you remember everything you need to do?
npc.vascalir.greet_msg_20: Welcome back, |PLAYERNAME|! Do you have enough space for that sword now?
npc.vascalir.greet_msg_21: Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! I'm in a really good mood, I must say. We're almost able to infiltrate Kraknaknork's hideout. I have one last little favour to ask and then my plan is complete. Are you ready?
npc.vascalir.greet_msg_22: Welcome back, |PLAYERNAME|! But - back so soon? Please find the wasps' lair in the north-western region of Rookgaard and use the flask I gave you on its dead body. Or did you lose the flask?
npc.vascalir.greet_msg_23: Welcome back, |PLAYERNAME|! Were you able to bring back some wasp poison?
npc.vascalir.greet_msg_27: |PLAYERNAME| - a small word of advice before we continue this mission. You are level 8 now, while it is possible to reach higher levels while still on Rookgaard, you should consider leaving Rookgaard at about level 9. ...
npc.vascalir.greet_msg_28: You can still go on with this mission, but you won't be able to finish the quest once you've reached level 9. So only kill the monsters you absolutely have to kill - if you want to finish this quest! ...
npc.vascalir.greet_msg_29: If you don't care about that, you can also simply leave Rookgaard now and learn a vocation by talking to the oracle above the academy. It's up to you. Or - I could simply clean up your questlog, if you prefer. ...
npc.vascalir.greet_msg_3: Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|. I've heard a loud rumbling from the roof - I hope the stones didn't fall on your toes. Have you loaded at least two catapults?
npc.vascalir.greet_msg_30: What would you like to do? {Continue} the mission or {delete} the unfinished questline from your questlog?
npc.vascalir.greet_msg_4: Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|. Actually I have some more equipment I could give to you, but first I want to see how you fight. You have fought before, haven't you?
npc.vascalir.greet_msg_5: Welcome back, |PLAYERNAME|. Are you done with the 5 rats I asked you to kill?
npc.vascalir.greet_msg_6: Welcome back, |PLAYERNAME|. Glad to see you made it back in one piece. I hope you're not too exhausted, because I could use your {help} again.
npc.vascalir.greet_msg_7: Oh, hello |PLAYERNAME|! Have you made up your mind about sneaking into the tarantula's lair and retrieving a sample of her web? Are you up for it?
npc.vascalir.greet_msg_8: Do you need the instruction for the tarantula's lair again?
npc.vascalir.greet_msg_9: Oh, well done! Let me take that spider web sample from you - careful, careful... it's sturdy, yet fragile. Thank you! I should be able to make a great paralyse trap with this one. Here, I have something sturdy for you as well - want it?
npc.vascalir.say_1: Welcome, adventurer |PLAYERNAME|. Thank you for offering your help - but you are already too experienced to start this quest. Just go on hunting monsters, you'll be better off that way.
npc.vascalir.say_2: |PLAYERNAME|, the only thing left for you to do here is to talk to the oracle above the academy and leave for the Isle of Destiny. Thanks again for your great work and good luck on your journeys!
npc.vascalir.say_3: Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|. Right now I don't need your help. I heard that Lily south-west of here requires assistance though.
npc.vascalir.say_4: Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|. Right now I don't need your help. You should pay a visit to Tom the Tanner. His hut is south-west of the academy!
npc.vascalir.say_5: You can find the vault if you go down the stairs in the northern part of the academy. The book should be in a large blue chest somewhere down there - I hope it's not burnt yet.
npc.vascalir.say_6: I think it's a good idea to go see Paulie before you leave the village again. Just go downstairs and to the right to find the bank.
npc.vascalir.say_7: |PLAYERNAME|, you need to discover the troll tunnel and find a way to make it collapse. Maybe you're able to use some of the trolls' tools. Make sure they can't enter the village via that tunnel anymore!
npc.vascalir.say_8: |PLAYERNAME|, the air smells like victory. Head into the orc fortress and vanquish Kraknaknork once and for all. Don't forget to take the items from below the academy!
npc.vascalir.say_rats_remaining: You still need to kill {0} more rats. Come back once you've killed enough for some experience and equipment!
npc.vascalir.stdmod_1: Talk to me if you want to help protecting the village.
npc.vascalir.stdmod_10: Well, if you change your mind, let me know.
npc.vascalir.stdmod_11: Here, this studded armor will protect you much better. Fits you perfectly! Now - let's work on your footwear. Tom the Tanner can create great boots out of quality leather. You should pay him a visit!
npc.vascalir.stdmod_12: Seriously, don't reject that offer. I'm going to give you a studded armor. No one refuses free stuff! If you don't like it, you can sell it - I don't need it anymore. I promise it's not too used or smelly. Want it?
npc.vascalir.stdmod_13: Then do whatever you have to do first, but please hurry!
npc.vascalir.stdmod_14: Take a small break then and return to me when you have recovered... and cleaned your face.
npc.vascalir.stdmod_15: Alright, then just let me know when you're ready. Don't take too much time though.
npc.vascalir.stdmod_16: This brass helmet will make sure you don't hurt your head. I probably should have given that to you BEFORE you made a rocky tunnel collapse! Take your well-deserved break. Once you're ready for the next mission, talk to me again.
npc.vascalir.stdmod_17: Seriously, don't reject that offer. I'm going to give you a brass helmet. No one refuses free stuff! If you don't like it, you can sell it - I don't need it anymore. I promise there are no fleas in it. Want it?
npc.vascalir.stdmod_18: Let me know when you're ready. This should be fun.
npc.vascalir.stdmod_2: Rookgaard needs your help more than ever.
npc.vascalir.stdmod_20: Well done, this bone is exactly what I needed! Great. I have to do some preparations, but as reward for your great work, I have a shiny new weapon for you. Here, would you like to have this sword?
npc.vascalir.stdmod_21: Ah... well, if you lost that bone on the way, that's too bad. I just hope you didn't get hungry and nibbled on it. I wouldn't eat cursed flesh if I were you. Anyway, you can still have this old sword as reward, do you want it?
npc.vascalir.stdmod_22: This sword has helped me in many fierce battles. I hope you can put it to good use. Once you're ready for the next mission, talk to me again.
npc.vascalir.stdmod_23: Seriously, don't reject that offer. Just take that sword, it's free. If you don't like it, you can sell it - I don't need it anymore. I promise there are no blood stains on it. Want it?
npc.vascalir.stdmod_24: Well, then just let me know when you're ready.
npc.vascalir.stdmod_25: Alright. Here is the empty flask to use on a dead wasp. I also marked the wasps' nest on your map. Be careful and don't forget to wear your silver amulet for poison protection!
npc.vascalir.stdmod_27: Oh, but there you have it in your inventory! Yeah, your backpack is a bit of a mess. I understand you overlooked it. Dig deeper!
npc.vascalir.stdmod_28: No problem. Here's a new one. I can only give you one per hour though, so try not to lose it again this time.
npc.vascalir.stdmod_29: Great, then please find the wasps' nest, kill one and use the empty flask on its dead body.
npc.vascalir.stdmod_3: Well, if you change your mind you know where to find me. Remember that if you help Rookgaard, Rookgaard might be able to help you.
npc.vascalir.stdmod_30: Well, please come back with the poison soon. We won't have much time until Kraknaknork's next attack.
npc.vascalir.stdmod_31: Oh, but you don't carry any - did you lose the flask? I can give you a new empty one, but that will also reset your mission, meaning you have to extract new poison. Would you like that?
npc.vascalir.stdmod_32: Alright. Here is the empty flask to use on a dead wasp. Don't lose it this time!
npc.vascalir.stdmod_33: Great, then please find the wasps' nest, kill one and use the empty flask on its dead body.
npc.vascalir.stdmod_34: This brass shield is actually brand-new. It's never been used! I hope it will serve you well. Take a small break, regenerate your health, and then talk to me again for your final mission!
npc.vascalir.stdmod_35: Seriously, don't reject that offer. Just take that shield, it's free. If you don't like it, you can sell it - I don't need it anymore. I promise it's really brand-new. Want it?
npc.vascalir.stdmod_39:
Have you ever heard of Kraknaknork? He's a powerful orc shaman who has recently risen from the orc tribe and started to terrorise Rookgaard. Maybe we can kill several birds with one stone. Listen: ... \z
	What would you say about you defeat Kraknaknork, save Rookgaard and earn some experience and better equipment on the way? Sounds good?
npc.vascalir.stdmod_40:
Great. We best start by reinforcing our defences. There are four large catapults positioned on roofs high over the village. If you want to fight, you have to build up some muscles. ... \z
	Go into the barn just a few steps to the north-west of here and down the ladder into the cellar. You'll find a huge stone pile down there. Use it to pick up one of the big stones. ... \z
	They are really heavy, so make sure you have lots of space in your inventory. ... \z
	Carry one stone to at least two of the four catapults located on Norma's roof to the north, this academy and Obi's roof to the south. ... \z
	Use the stone on the catapult to load it. You can load each catapult only once, so try spotting two different catapults. Have you understood all of that?
npc.vascalir.stdmod_41:
Let me explain again then. We best start by reinforcing our defences. There are four large catapults positioned on roofs high over the village. If you want to fight, you have to build up some muscles. ... \z
	Go into the barn just a few steps to the north-west of here and down the ladder into the cellar. You'll find a huge stone pile down there. Use it to pick up one of the big stones. ... \z
	Carry one stone to at least two of the four catapults located on Norma's roof to the north, this academy and Obi's roof to the south. ... \z
	Use the stone on the catapult to load it. You can load each catapult only once, so try spotting two different catapults. Have you understood all of that?
npc.vascalir.stdmod_42:
Well done! The villagers are much safer now that the catapults are ready to fire. You also look like you've built some muscles. ... \z
	Great - so the piece of equipment I just gave you will not go to waste. Take this studded shield and put it to good use! ... \z
	Actually I have some more equipment I could give to you, but first I want to see how you fight. You have fought before, haven't you?
npc.vascalir.stdmod_43:
Ah, that came with confidence. Suited monsters to do some basic fighting would be rats - they actually fight back, but they don't hit that hard. Just make sure you wear your new studded shield and a sword. ... \z
	You can find rats in the sewers. In case you might think so, this task is not a lame excuse to help us with some rat infestation, we got the rat population quite under control. ... \z
	Also please don't come carrying their dead bodies - what adventurers somehow tend to do for some reason. Maybe they think they're cats? I'm going to believe you, promise. ... \z
	So, back to the topic - please kill 5 rats and then come back to me. Shouldn't be too hard, should it? Just pay attention they don't trap you in a narrow passage and take on one at a time. ... \z
	If you run low on health, go on full defence - click the little shield icon - and leave the dungeon. Nothing corwardish about running, because dying hurts. Are you ready to go?
npc.vascalir.stdmod_44:
Nice. I've marked two rat dungeons on your map. Kill 5 rats and return to me. If you should happen to forget how many you have killed in the meantime, simply check your questlog. ... \z
	I should also give you a small word of warning - once you reach level 8, you should leave this island. Thus you won't be able to continue this quest once you've reached level 9. ... \z
	It's not good to reach level 9 without having chosen a vocation - you'll be weaker than normal. ... \z
	No need to be scared, just saying you don't need to plan large hunting sessions while helping me with this mission or kill more rats than I've asked you to. So, good hunting!
npc.vascalir.stdmod_45:
I'll explain it again then. Suited monsters to do some basic fighting would be rats - they actually fight back, but they don't hit that hard. Just make sure you wear your new studded shield and a sword. ... \z
	You can find rats in the sewers. In case you might think so, this task is not a lame excuse to help us with some rat infestation, we got the rat population quite under control. ... \z
	So, back to the topic - please kill 5 rats and then come back to me. Shouldn't be too hard, should it? Just pay attention they don't trap you in a narrow passage and take on one at a time. ... \z
	If you run low on health, go on full defence - click the little shield icon - and leave the dungeon. Nothing corwardish about running, because dying hurts. Are you ready to go?
npc.vascalir.stdmod_46:
Good job. Here's your promised reward - a sabre. You can replace your wooden sword with it, if you still have it - the sabre does more damage. ... \z
	If you look at a piece of equipment, you can check its stats. By the way, if you use sword weapons such as sabres or swords, you are training your 'sword fighting skill'. ... \z
	This is quite important if you plan on becoming a melee fighter - the better your sword fighting skill, the higher the damage you do will be. ... \z
	There are also club and axe type weapons - they train different skills, so maybe you should choose one type of weapon you always want to use. It doesn't make that much difference, but swords often have a good balance between offence and defence. ... \z
	Anyway, I think you're well enough equipped now to leave the village of Rookgaard for another small task. Find Lily south-west of here, she will tell you what she needs done.
npc.vascalir.stdmod_47:
That's the spirit Rookgaard needs. Listen, while you were gone I thought about a way to weaken and fight Kraknaknork - that orc shaman who terrorises Rookgaard. ... \z
	Even if we could make our way into his stronghold past all his minions, we cannot hope to defeat him as long as he is powerful enough to summon demons and access other dimensions. ... \z
	While studying the fauna of Rookgaard I came across an interesting specimen that might help us in our battle. Deep in the underground tunnels, there is a spider queen - a tarantula, who is bigger and deadlier than all the other spiders here. ... \z
	Her web is enormous - and causes a strong paralysis. If you could get a small sample of her web, I might be able to craft a trap that we can use to paralyse the orcs so you can get past their defences. ... \z
	Do you dare sneak into the tarantula's lair and retrieve a sample of her web?
npc.vascalir.stdmod_48:
That's very courageous. I'll mark the spider lair on your map. If you leave the village to the north again like before, but walk north-west and cross the bridge, you will find it. ... \z
	Listen, I have some more important information regarding your task. It will likely be dark in the cave, so maybe you'll want to buy a torch or two from Al Dee's shop to the left of the barn. ... \z
	The spider queen is far too strong for you to fight and if she catches you, you might end up in her stomach. The good news is that she is almost blind and relies on her sense of smelling to find her prey. ... \z
	Deep in her lair you'll find some blue greasy stones. If you use them, you'll rub some of the smelly grease on your body. From that moment on you'll be invisible to her, but only for a short time. ... \z
	If you run into her lair, you should have enough time to retrieve a sample of her web before she catches you. Just USE one of her intact cobwebs in her lair. Good luck!
npc.vascalir.stdmod_49:
Time is of the essence now. The library vault is on fire! It's where Rookgaard's oldest and most important books are stored. ... \z
	The trolls from the northern ruins somehow found their way into the vault by digging a tunnel from the other side and set everything on fire. ... \z
	You HAVE to go down there and look for our copy of the book of orc language - while I'm thinking of a reason why I can't go myself. ... \z
	Just kidding, I need to find out just how the trolls got in there before they wreak more havoc. I think there's something bigger behind all this. ... \z
	The vault is likely set on fire - be careful down there, and don't run into open fire, it can and will hurt you. There should be a rune in the vault that can at least weaken fire, just in case. ... \z
	Are you ready to go?
npc.vascalir.stdmod_5: Awesome! Off to work with you. I've marked the barn on your map.
npc.vascalir.stdmod_50:
You can find the vault if you go down the stairs in the northern part of the academy. The book should be in a large blue chest somewhere down there - I hope it's not burnt yet. ... \z
	Make sure you're healthy - if you are wounded, ask Cipfried in the temple for a healing first. Good luck!
npc.vascalir.stdmod_51:
What happened, you say? The book was already burnt to ashes? That's too bad... well, you deserve a reward for your courage anyway. Thanks for at least trying. ... \z
	I was trying to figure out a way to get into the orc fortress by maybe using their language... but that won't work now I fear. ... \z
	We do have to stop the trolls though before taking care of the orcs. I found their tunnel in the northern ruins. Are you prepared for your next mission?
npc.vascalir.stdmod_52:
Great job down there! You do deserve a reward for your courage. Here is a platinum coin for you, worth 100 gold coins. Let me take a look at the book... ... \z
	Argh... the pages are barely readable anymore. I was trying to figure out a way to get into the orc fortress by maybe using their language... but that won't work now I fear. ... \z
	We do have to stop the trolls though before taking care of the orcs. I found their tunnel in the northern ruins. Are you prepared for your next mission?
npc.vascalir.stdmod_53:
Oh, but you have it! <snags it from you> Great job down there! You do deserve a reward for your courage. Here is a platinum coin for you, worth 100 gold coins. Let me take a look at the book... ... \z
	Argh... the pages are barely readable anymore. I was trying to figure out a way to get into the orc fortress by maybe using their language... but that won't work now I fear. ... \z
	We do have to stop the trolls though before taking care of the orcs. I found their tunnel in the northern ruins. Are you prepared for your next mission?
npc.vascalir.stdmod_54:
First things first. I think by now you should have gathered some money, and it's better to play things safely instead of rushing into the trolls' lair. You might have seen the Bank of Rookgaard downstairs. ... \z
	Each Tibian inhabitant has a bank account where you can store your money safely - so in case you die, you won't lose it. ... \z
	You don't have to worry about item loss here on Rookgaard, but as soon as you grow stronger and learn a vocation, it can happen to you that you lose some of your items when dying. ... \z
	It's probably safer to get used to depositing all of your money on your bank account before you leave for a hunt. ... \z
	Go downstairs and talk to Paulie. I'm sure he can explain to you everything you need to know, and he might also give you a small bonus for your account.
npc.vascalir.stdmod_55:
Very well. What I know is the following: somewhere in the northern ruins, the trolls have found a way to dig a tunnel that leads to the library vault. That's how they were able to set fire to it. ... \z
	You need to discover that tunnel and find a way to make it collapse. Maybe you're able to use some of the trolls' tools. Make sure that they can't enter the village via that tunnel anymore! ... \z
	And please don't hurt yourself in the process. You'll probably have to fight them, so bring food and maybe a potion. If you need to buy something, don't forget that you can withdraw money from your bank account. Good luck!
npc.vascalir.stdmod_56:
Now that we got rid of the troll threat, it's about time we get back to the imminent danger coming from the orc side of Rookgaard. The spider web you retrieved was only the first step - I've thought of something else. ... \z
	To infiltrate the orc fortress, we're going to make use of a technique I've learnt on the battlefield - distraction! I'll explain the plan to you when everything's ready, but for now I have a small favour to ask. ... \z
	Please go to the graveyard east of the village, enter the crypt and retrieve a bone. Now I know this is a little morbid, but it would be best if it still had some meat on it. ... \z
	The graveyard hasn't been used by the villagers for a long time. It's cursed - skeletons are roaming around, so be careful. Take this garlic necklace just in case. ... \z
	Undead monsters tend to drain your life - because their own life force is gone. If you wear it, you'll be protected from it. Search around in the coffins in the crypt, one of them should hold a nice fleshy bone. See you soon!
npc.vascalir.stdmod_57:
Please go to the graveyard east of the village, enter the crypt and retrieve a bone. Now I know this is a little morbid, but it would be best if it still had some meat on it. ... \z
	The graveyard hasn't been used by the villagers for a long time. It's cursed - skeletons are roaming around, so be careful. ... \z
	Undead monsters tend to drain your life - because their own life force is gone. If you wear the garlic necklace I gave you, you'll be protected from it. Search around in the coffins in the crypt, one of them should hold a nice fleshy bone. See you soon!
npc.vascalir.stdmod_58:
I'm happy to hear that! <whistles> We already have the paralyse trap and the fleshy bone, and now we need one final ingredient to weaken Kraknaknork so that you stand a chance against him. ... \z
	Wasp poison! There are many toxic creatures - like snakes or poison spiders - but none is as deadly as the wasp. At least none on Rookgaard. If we could poison Kraknaknork with it, I think he won't be able to make use of his spells for quite a while. ... \z
	The only problem is - to get it, you need to get close to a wasp, kill it and extract some poison from its dead body. Wasps are located on the north-western side of Rookgaard, which is quite dangerous. ... \z
	However, I can give you something for protection - a silver amulet. As long as you wear it, poison can't harm you as much as it usually would do. I'll also give you the flask which you have to use on a fresh, dead wasp. Are you prepared for that mission?
npc.vascalir.stdmod_59:
|PLAYERNAME|, I must say I'm impressed. Not everyone would dare go into that region of Rookgaard and face creatures as strong as wasps. Wait, let me give something to you... ... \z
	Here, with a drop of the wasp poison this potion turned into an effective antidote. Should you get poisoned again and are losing a lot of health, use the antidote potion to cure yourself. ... \z
	There is also a rune and a spell to remove poison available once you leave this island and arrive on the mainland. It's always good to protect yourself! ... \z
	And I have a good shield for you, too. Here, can you carry it?
npc.vascalir.stdmod_6: Oh, but you have... you should say {yes}!
npc.vascalir.stdmod_60:
The air smells like victory today. I've kept the items you brought from your journeys safe - the time has come to use them. ... \z
	Enter the small treasure room under the academy - just down the stairs and to the right, near Paulie - and open the large blue chest to retrieve them. You'll find a rolling pin, the fleshy bone, the wasp poison and a tarantula trap. ... \z
	Now let me explain the plan in detail. Go to the orc fortress - you've already been nearby when hunting for the wasp poison, it's the same way, but I'll mark it on your map just in case. ... \z
	There you will have to find a way to sneak past the guards, they are much too strong for you. The rolling pin might come in handy during that part. Afterwards, the fleshy bone will help to create a distraction to get into the fortress. ... \z
	Once you're inside the fortress, find the orc kitchen and pour the wasp poison into Kraknaknork's soup! The tarantula trap will come in handy if you meet a guard who might seem simply too fast for you. You can use it on him to slow him down. ... \z
	|PLAYERNAME|, take the items and go claim your victory. I know you will do us proud. Good luck!
npc.vascalir.stdmod_61:
You DID kill him indeed! Incredible! This little village can finally live in peace again - and you've grown so strong, too. I'm proud of you, |PLAYERNAME|. My work here is done, and yours too. Thank you for all you've done for us. ... \z
	Now all that is left for you to do here is to talk to the oracle above the academy and travel to the Isle of Destiny. There, you will determine your future - which I'm sure is a bright one. ... \z
	What will become of you? A mighty sorcerer? A fierce knight? A skilled paladin? Or a powerful druid? Only you can decide. ... \z
	Rookgaard will miss you, but the whole world of Tibia is open to you now. Take care, |PLAYERNAME|. It's good to know you.
npc.vascalir.stdmod_7: No worries, let's refresh your memory. To fight a monster, click on it in the battle list and you'll automatically attack it. It's as easy as that! If you want to practice, just hunt a few harmless rabbits south of here. Remember it now?
npc.vascalir.stdmod_8: Actually I think you have killed enough. You should reply with {yes}!
npc.vascalir.stdmod_9: What do you mean? If you're ready to {help} me again, just say so.

npc.xorlosh.greet_msg_1: Who are you? Are you a genius in mechanics? You don't look like one.
npc.xorlosh.multi_1: There should be a book in our library about tunnelling. I don't have that much time to talk to you about that. ...
npc.xorlosh.multi_2: If you want to have some information, you'll just have to find that book. If you need some equipment, go ask Harog. You'll find the library in the north eastern wing of Beregar city.
npc.xorlosh.say_1: Hmmmm, you could indeed help me. See this mechanism? Some son of a rotworm put WAY too much stuff on this elevator and now it's broken. I need 3 gear wheels to fix it. You think you could get them for me?
npc.xorlosh.say_2: HOLY MOTHER OF ALL ROTWORMS! You did it and they are of even better quality than the old ones. You should be the first one to try the elevator, just jump on it. See you my friend.
npc.xorlosh.say_3: That would be great! Maybe a blacksmith can forge you some. Come back when you got them and ask me about your mission.
npc.xorlosh.say_4: The book about tunnelling is in the library which is located in the north eastern wing of Beregar city.
npc.yalahari.multi_1: Hm, no sign of any notes you say? That's odd - odd and a bit suspicious. I doubt you have tried hard enough. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_10: We need you to enter one of the lesser damaged factories. Go to the factory district and look for a pattern crystal used for weapon production. Use it on the factory controller. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_11: It will ensure that the factory will provide us with a suitable amount of weapons which we dearly need to reclaim and secure the most dangerous parts of the city. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_12: I will inform the guards that you are allowed to pass the centre gate to the factory quarter now. Just use the gate mechanism to pass.
npc.yalahari.multi_13: Recently, our fishermen have been attacked by a maritime race called the quara. They live in the sunken quarter and are a significant threat to our people. I ask you to enter the sunken quarter and slay all their leaders. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_14: We believe that there are three leaders in this area. Your task is simple enough, so you better don't fail! ...
npc.yalahari.multi_15: I will inform the guards that you are allowed to pass the centre gate to the sunken quarter now. Just use the gate mechanism to pass.
npc.yalahari.multi_16: Ah, what an unexpected sight. I can almost feel the energy of the charm. It will help to recover some of the past wealth. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_17: You did quite an impressive job. I'm considering to introduce you to my ma.. to my direct superior one day. But there are still other missions to fulfil.
npc.yalahari.multi_18: Destroyed you say? That's impossible! I'm not sure if I can trust you in this matter? One might assume, you fled from the ghosts in terror and left the charm there. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_19: You will have to work twice as hard on your next missions to restore the trust you have lost.
npc.yalahari.multi_2: There are only a few chances to impress us. For those who please us great rewards are in store. If you fail though, you might lose more than you can imagine.
npc.yalahari.multi_20: The old cemetery of the city has been abandoned decades ago when the activity of the various undead there became unbearable. The reason for their appearance was never found out or researched. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_21: However, those undead could be useful, at least some of them. Particular ghosts consist of a substance that is very similar to the energy source that powered some of our devices. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_22: Since we lack most of the original sources, some substitute might come in handy. Take this ghost charm and place it on the strange carving in the cemetery. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_23: Use it to attract ghosts and slay them. Then use the residues of the ghosts on the charm to capture the essence. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_24: Once it is filled, ghosts will not be attracted any longer. Then return the charm to me. I will inform the guards that you are allowed to pass the centre gate to the cemetery quarter now. Just use the gate mechanism to pass.
npc.yalahari.multi_25: So have you won us a new ally? Excellent. I knew you would not dare to ruin this mission. Soon we might be able to strengthen our defences and even relocate some of our guards. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_26: Perhaps some day soon, you lead your own unit of men. However, there are more missions that need to be accomplished. Let's talk about them.
npc.yalahari.multi_27: This druid dares to affront us? We will look into this when we have enough time. But there are other things that needs to be settled. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_28: Although, we probably should not do so after your last failure, we are willing to grant you another mission.
npc.yalahari.multi_29: As you probably noticed, once our city had a park and a zoo around a grand arena. It was a favourite pastime of our citizens to visit this quarter in their spare time. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_3: For your noble deeds, we would like to invite you to a special celebration ceremony. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_30: Nowadays, the quarter is lost. The animals are on the loose, and an attempt to revitalise the city with new arena games resulted in a revolt of the foreign gladiators. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_31: Now all kinds of beasts roam the park, and gladiators challenge them and visitors to test their skills. One of the residents is an ancient druid that rather cares foranimals than for people. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_32: It is said that he is able to use magic to breed animals with changed abilities and appearances. Such skills are of course quite useful for us. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_33: We lack the manpower to retake all quarters, or just to defend ourselves adequately. If he bred us some guards and warbeasts, we could strengthen our positionconsiderably. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_34: Travel to the arena quarter and gain his assistance for us. I will inform the guards that you are allowed to pass the centre gate to the arena quarter now. Just use thegate mechanism to pass.
npc.yalahari.multi_35: I hope you gave this criminal a real scare! I'm sure he'll remember what he has to expect if he arouses our anger again. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_36: You have proven yourself as quite valuable with this mission! That was just the first step on your rise through the ranks of our helpers. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_37: Just ask me for more missions and we will see what you are capable of!
npc.yalahari.multi_38: So he has been too uncooperative for you? Well, you weren't the first we have sent and you won't be the last. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_39: However, if you cannot even serve us as a bully, we might have to rethink if you are the right person for us. That was a bad job and we don't tolerate many of them.
npc.yalahari.multi_4: Only the most prominent Yalahari are allowed to join the festivities. I assume you can imagine what honour it is that you'vebeen invited to join us. Meet us in the inner city's centre. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_40: We surely cannot allow some underworld kingpin to rule a significant part of the city. Although, I have to admit that his firm grip on the former trade quarter might be useful....
npc.yalahari.multi_41: I expect you to fight your way through his minions and to show him that we are determined and powerful enough to retake the quarter, if necessary by force. Talk to himafter killing some of his henchmen. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_42: I'm sure he'll understand that he will succumb to a greater power. That's how his little empire has worked after all. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_43: Also, I will inform the guards that you are allowed to pass the centre gate to the trade quarter now. Just use the gate mechanism to pass.
npc.yalahari.multi_44: The former alchemist quarter was struck by even more disasters than the rest of the city. Fires, explosions, poisonous fumes - all sorts of catastrophes. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_45: The worst plague, however, are unknown diseases that have spread in this quarter and eradicated any human population. We must stop it before other quarters areafflicted. We already identified certain carriers responsible for spreading the plague. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_46: It will be your task to eliminate them. This spell will protect you from becoming infected yourself. Enter the alchemist quarter and kill the three plague carriers, and atbest anything else you might find there. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_47: Even more important, retrieve the last research notes that the local alchemists made before the plague killed them. They might be the key for a cure or something else. ...
npc.yalahari.multi_48: At least we have to make sure that these scientists did not die in vain, and honour their researches. So please bring us these research notes. ...

npc.zedrulon_the_fallen.greet_msg_1: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
npc.zedrulon_the_fallen.keyword_1: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.zedrulon_the_fallen.stdmod_1: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.zedrulon_the_fallen.stdmod_11: You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.zedrulon_the_fallen.stdmod_12: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.zedrulon_the_fallen.stdmod_13: Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.zedrulon_the_fallen.stdmod_14: There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.zedrulon_the_fallen.stdmod_15: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.zedrulon_the_fallen.stdmod_16: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.zedrulon_the_fallen.stdmod_17: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.zedrulon_the_fallen.stdmod_18: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.zedrulon_the_fallen.stdmod_19: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.zedrulon_the_fallen.stdmod_2: Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.zedrulon_the_fallen.stdmod_20: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.zedrulon_the_fallen.stdmod_21: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.zedrulon_the_fallen.stdmod_22: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.zedrulon_the_fallen.stdmod_23: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.zedrulon_the_fallen.stdmod_25:
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
npc.zedrulon_the_fallen.stdmod_4: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.zedrulon_the_fallen.stdmod_7: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.zedrulon_the_fallen.stdmod_9: Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.zedrulon_the_fallen.walkaway_msg_1: Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
npc.zerbrus.greet_1: Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! You're looking really bad. Let me heal your wounds.
npc.zerbrus.greet_2: <nods> At your service, |PLAYERNAME|, protecting the {village} from {monsters}.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_1: Are you injured or poisoned? I can help you.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_11: I'm the guard of this bridge. I defend Rookgaard against the beasts of the {wilderness} and the {dungeons}, and even of the stinking {sewers}.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_12: My duty is eternal. Time is of no importance.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_13: Before you fight monsters, deposit your money there. If you die, you won't lose it if it's save in the bank.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_15: I have to stay here, sorry. But I can {heal} you if you are wounded. I have also valuable information about {monsters}.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_16: I'm an expert concerning the wildlife and {monsters} on this island.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_17: I'm not a gossiper, but if you want to know something about a certain Rookgaardian, ask.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_18: They're not that dangerous, but don't let yourself get cornered by many of them. They still can hurt.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_19: There are two types of spiders on this island: normal spiders and poison spiders. As their name says, the latter ones can poison you which will cause a constant loss of your health. Beware of them!
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_20: Once you have upgraded your starter {equipment} a little - maybe leather stuff - and got a better weapon as well as a shield, you should be able to kill trolls.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_21: You need a stronger weapon than the starter club to kill wolves. Maybe a {sabre} or a short {sword} will do.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_22: The orcs have a hideout under the troll cave, just descend deep. Still, be very careful!
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_23: Minotaurs are very strong. You will need a group of people or at least level 6 and good equipment to be able to kill them.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_24: They are a little tougher than they look like, but they're still good beginner monsters.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_25: The skeletons on this island are usually fairly hidden. They are often found near graves and always underground. Beware of their evil life drain.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_26: There is a bear cave close to this bridge. Be careful, though, they hit hard!
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_27: Wasp hives exist only behind the north bridge, so ask {Dallheim} for information. I'm glad there are no wasps here. They always make me jump.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_28: Snakes can poison you, too, but their poison is usually not as dangerous as that of poison spiders. Just be careful and kill them fast.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_29: Premium warriors pay. They gain many advantages this way.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_3: No monster shall go past me.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_32: A place of protection. Nothing can harm you there.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_33: I can mark you some dungeons on your map if you ask me about {monsters} suited for your level.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_34: The sewers are crowded with {rats}. They make fine targets for young heroes.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_35: There are {wolves}, {bears}, {snakes}, {deer}, and {spiders} in the wilderness past this bridge.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_37: The heavenly warrior! Read {books} to learn about him.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_38: You will learn about magic soon enough.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_39: In the world of Tibia, many challenges await the brave adventurer.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_4: The premium side of Rookgaard lies beyond.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_40: There are many books in the {academy}. Theory can be just as important as practice.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_41: It's my duty to protect this village and its {citizens}.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_42: It looks like you have mastered the drill.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_43: Sorry, I don't trade. Ask the shop owners for a trade instead.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_44: I don't approve of her opening a bar. Those drunken adventurers stumbling over the bridge at nighttime are not especially helpful in improving the situation.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_46: He sells {weapons}. His shop is south west of town, close to the {temple}.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_47: He dedicated his life to welcoming newcomers to this island.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_49: There's something about this guy I don't like.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_5: Want to know what monsters are good for you at your level? Just ask me!
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_50: She's very attractive. Too bad my duty leaves me no time to date her.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_51: He guards the temple and can heal you if you are badly injured or poisoned, just like me.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_52: She's {Obi's} granddaughter and deals with {armors} and {shields}. Her shop is south west of town, close to the temple.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_54: Her shop is just north of the bridge. She really has good offers.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_55: Gentle girl, but a little to esoteric for my taste. However, her {potions} might come in handy.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_56: You can find the oracle on the top floor of the {academy}, just above {Seymour}. Go there when you are level 8.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_58: His job of teaching young heroes is important for the survival of all of us.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_6: Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! You're looking really bad. Let me heal your wounds.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_7: <nods> At your service, |PLAYERNAME|, protecting the {village} from {monsters}.
npc.zerbrus.stdmod_9: Hmm, |PLAYERNAME|. I really don't know if you should go into the wilderness without a shield. You should earn some money by hunting rats under the village first until you can afford at least a wooden shield.
npc.zerbrus.voice_1: Are you injured or poisoned? I can help you.
npc.zerbrus.voice_3: No monster shall go past me.

npc.zirella.greet_msg_7: Oh, sweetheart, is there a problem with the quest? Should I {explain} it again?
npc.zirella.greet_msg_8: Right, thank you sweetheart! This will be enough to heat my oven. Oh, and you are probably waiting for your reward, {yes}?
npc.zirella.greet_msg_9: Oh, welcome back, dear Isleth Eagonst! Are you here for a little chat? Just use the highlighted {keywords} again to choose a {topic}.
npc.zirella.multi_1: Well, you know that old women like me like to talk a lot. If you see three dots at the end of a sentence, I have still something to say and you should not interrupt, like now ...
npc.zirella.multi_2: Patience is a virtue, young adventurer! So, the quest was to go into the forest south of here and to find a dead tree. Wait, let me continue! ...
npc.zirella.multi_3: 'Use' a tree to break a dry branch from it. Afterwards, drag and drop the branch back to my cart and select 'Use with', then left-click on my cart. Thanks again for offering your help!
npc.zirella.multi_4: Thank you darling! My cart is right beside me. It's a little complicated: I need some firewood, but it's very difficult for my slightly advanced age. ...
npc.zirella.multi_5: Please go into the the forest southeast of here. You will find fine old rotten brown trees. Please RIGHT-CLICK in the lower right corner of that tree and choose 'USE'. That way, a branch should appear on the map. ...
npc.zirella.multi_6: Don't put it in your inventory like before, but instead DRAG it over the map by LEFT-CLICKING the loose branch, HOLDING the LEFT MOUSE BUTTON and moving it over the map. ...
npc.zirella.multi_7: When you are close to my cart, USE the branch WITH the cart: RIGHT-CLICK the branch on the floor and select 'USE WITH', Then LEFT-CLICK on the cart. Don't worry, you will see what I mean on the way. Thanks and {bye} for now!
npc.zirella.say_1: By the way, 'quest' is a keyword that many NPCs react to, especially those which have tasks for you. So darling, about that {quest}... are you listening?
npc.zirella.say_2: Thank you so much for your kindness. I'm an old woman and I desperately need firewood for my oven. Could you please help me?
npc.zirella.say_3: You're such a treasure. In the forest south of here, there are {dead trees} without any leaves. The first thing you have to do is search for one, {okay}?
npc.zirella.say_4: Splendid, once you've found one, 'Use' it to break a branch from it. Did you understand that so far?
npc.zirella.say_5: Good... so after you broke a branch, please push it here and select 'use with'. That will turn your mouse cursor into crosshairs. Then left-click on my cart. {Alright}?
npc.zirella.say_6: To push the branch, drag and drop it on the grass by holding the left mousebutton and moving the cursor to where you want to throw the branch. Just push it near my cart before you 'Use' it, {alright}?
npc.zirella.say_7: Oh, you deserve it. You really have earned some experience! Also, you may enter my little house now and take what's in that chest beside my bed. Good {bye} for now!
npc.zirella.say_8: Well then, I hope you find nice and dry branches for me! Good {bye}!
npc.zirella.voice_1: I wish someone could spare a minute and help me...
npc.zirella.voice_2: This is too hard for an old woman like me.
npc.zirella.voice_3: Hello, young adventurer, you look strong enough to help me!

npc.ztiss.multi_1: Excellent! Now you may leave ziz area zrough ze teleporter to ze norz. It will bring you to a hidden boat. Ziz boat will take you to ze tournament izle. ...

npc.ztiss.multi_3: You are zmart for a zoftzkin, but before you begin to feel too zmart, you should know zat we will zeal our deal wiz you drinking a ztrong poizon zat will inevitably kill you if you want to trick me and not attend ze tournament. ...
npc.ztiss.multi_4: Zo are you ready to drink ziz poizon here?

npc.zumtah.greet_msg_1: Another visitor to this constricted, cosy, calm realm, perfect except for an {exit}. Muhaha.
npc.zumtah.multi_1: Oh, excuse me of course, you... wanted to go. Like all... the others. I am sorry, so sorry. You... you can leave. Yes. You can go. You are free. I shall stay here and help every poor soul which ever gets thrown in here from this day onward. ...
npc.zumtah.multi_2: Yes, I will redeem myself. Maybe in another 278 years. ...
npc.zumtah.multi_3: If you want to go, just ask for an {exit} and I will transform you into a creature small enough to fit through that hole over there.
npc.zumtah.say_1: You are searching for the way out? Do you want to go home? Are you homesick, nostalgic, allergic? I am sorry. You will stay. Muhahahaha. Haha. Are you giving up then?
npc.zumtah.say_10: You are starting to get on my nerves. Is this the only topic you know?
npc.zumtah.say_11: But there is no escape, I said NO. You've already asked several times and my answer will stay the same. What is this? Are you trying to test me?
npc.zumtah.say_12: Muhahaha. Where? I can only see a dark cave with nothing than bones and a djinn in it. You mean that small hole there? Muhahaha.
npc.zumtah.say_14: [EN] Muhahaha. Then I will give you a test. How many years do you think have I been here? {89}, {164} or {278}?
npc.zumtah.say_15: Correct human, and that is not nearly how high you would need to count to tell all the lost souls I've seen dying here. I AM PERPETUAL. Muahahaha.
npc.zumtah.say_2: A what? I don't even know what you're talking about, human. If you aren't just giving up - will you kindly change the topic please?
npc.zumtah.say_3: Haha, no! No. Why don't you just stop asking me that and start enjoying your stay here?
npc.zumtah.say_4: Oh, you mean - if I have ever been out of here in those 278 years? Well, I - I can't remember. No, I can't remember. Sorry.
npc.zumtah.say_5: No, I really can't remember. I enjoyed my stay here so much that I forgot how it looks outside of this hole. Outside. The air, the sky, the light. Oh well... well.
npc.zumtah.say_6: Oh yes, yes. I... I never really thought about how you creatures feel in here I guess. I... just watched all these beings die here. ...
npc.zumtah.say_7: Alright, as I said you are free now. There will not be an outside for the next three centuries, but you - go. ...
npc.zumtah.say_8: It's you, why did they throw you in here again? Anyway, I will just transform you once more. I also recovered your crate which will wait for you at the exit. There, feel free to go.
npc.zumtah.say_9: I've already told you that you can't get out. What's the problem? Do you even see an exit?
npc.zumtah.stdmod_1: I wait. I wait for someone like you to come here. I wait for them to grow disconsolate. I wait for them to despair. And I wait for them to die. Muhahaha.
npc.zumtah.stdmod_2: I am Zumtah, Zumtah the impeccable, Zumtah the marvellous, Zumtah the... the... eternal.
npc.zumtah.stdmod_3: The land you are currently dwelling in, human. Don't you have any sense of your surroundings?
npc.zumtah.stdmod_4: I have seen many of them. I have seen many of them die. In here, with me. Perhaps you will be pleased to meet them. Not long and you will join their ranks. Muhaha.
npc.zumtah.stdmod_5: Pesky creatures. Many of them have been brought here, many of them died here. Humans, lizards, beasts, they all die the same. Down here, with me. Muhahaha.
npc.zumtah.stdmod_6: What? What do you mean by that?
npc.zumtah.stdmod_7: Hmm, an old one. I don't care much about politics or power, as here, he has none. Here, only I have power. Muhaha.
npc.zumtah.stdmod_8: What are you talking about, such things do not matter down here. Down here alone, isolated and broken. Muhaha.
